items.title: Iris Assistant
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: AI Assistant — Glass Iris chat dashboard

Build a single-file, one-screen **AI assistant chat dashboard** for a personal-finance app. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is near-black with a cool electric-blue light falling from the top centre onto a living glass orb. The orb is a clear glass sphere with a swirling blue-violet core that slowly turns and pulses in a looping video.

## Scale

- **Units:** every length is in reference pixels of a 1440×1008 artboard, multiplied by `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100dvh/1008)`.
- **Fill:** the rail, top bar and hero stretch into any spare space, so there are never letterbox bands.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Inter Tight 400/500/600.
- **Colours:** page `#0E0E0E`; tiles and surfaces `#151515` to `#1D1D1D`; text white, with greys `#8C8C8C` and `#6E6E6E` for secondary copy.
- **Top glow:** a radial `rgba(64,110,255,.78)` above the hero centre, a violet `rgba(124,72,240,.42)` lobe to its right, and a faint cyan lobe to its left.
- **Accents:** blue `#2F6BFF` to violet `#5A4CF5`.

## Shell

- **Left rail (48u):** a white logo tile, then grouped 32u icon tiles, with a user tile and a settings tile at the bottom.
- **Top bar:** a back tile, a forward arrow and breadcrumbs "Home › AI Assistant".
  - **Right side:** a glass search field "Search Anything..." with cool blue-grey text, a bell, and an avatar.
- **Under the top bar:**
  - **Left:** a segmented toggle, "Chat Mode" (white, active) / "Overview".
  - **Right:** a glass status pill, a blue dot, "AI Agents Running" and a count badge "17".

## Hero (centred column, 708u wide)

- **Orb:** a 145u square layer with a −30.5u margin, so it occupies the same space as an 84u orb. A still plate sits under a muted, looping, inline `<video>`; the video fades in on `loadeddata`. A radial mask (solid to 61%, clear at 76%) melts the plate's black into the page.
- **Text:**
  - "Good Morning, Jason" in grey 17u.
  - "WHAT'S ON YOUR MIND?" in white, 30u, uppercase, weight 500.
  - "Get personalized financial insights, smarter recommendations."
- **Composer:** 114u tall, `#151515`, 14u radius, with a 1.2u gradient hairline border running blue → indigo → violet → blue.
  - **Input:** "Ask Anything...".
  - **Chips:** +, Normal ▾, Deep Think ▾, then Voice and a blue-to-violet gradient send button.
- **Three quick-action cards:**
  - Smart Budget Plan / Create My Budget, with a blue icon.
  - Set a Saving Goal / Set a Goal, with a violet icon.
  - Track My Expenses / Monitor Spending, with an indigo icon.
- **Recent Conversations:** a tree line with four questions and their times, fading out downwards, then "See More →".

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline.
  - The rail tiles and the top-bar items rise in.
  - The orb opens with a circular clip and scales from .92 to 1.
  - The greeting appears, then the headline words rise out of masks.
  - The subline, composer and cards settle in, then the history.
- **Orb video:** a 4s loop of the glass orb slowly rotating, its core pulsing and light refracting through the glass. The end crossfades into the start, it has no audio, and it is hosted on a CDN.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video; only the still plate shows.

## Tablet and phone

- **Tablet:** the layout reflows with fluid units.
- **Phone:**
  - The top bar wraps into two rows.
  - The quick-action cards stack as full-width rows.
  - The conversation times move under their questions.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The glowing blue glass orb sits centred under a blue light from the top, with no visible square around it.
- All warm and red accents are now blue or violet.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Atlas Cognition "Lab" features section

Build a single-file **product features section for a fictional AI research company, Atlas Cognition**. Use plain HTML, CSS, inline SVG and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a quiet near-black lab: a big serif headline, small mono labels, and a bento of four dark graphite cards. Each card has a softly lit inner panel with a technical line illustration. There are no photos; everything is CSS gradients and SVG.

## Scale

- **Units:** card internals are sized in reference pixels times `--c`, a container-query unit (`100cqw / <card reference width>`), so each card scales as one piece.
- **Desktop (container width ≥ 1164px):** a reworked bento.
  - Environments and Inference are full-width rows, each with the panel on one side and the copy on the other. The two rows are mirrored, so Environments has its panel on the left and Inference has its panel on the right.
  - Evaluations and Hosted Training sit side by side between them.
- **Narrower:** the cards stack in one column with the panel above the copy.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:**
  - **Newsreader** ("News", 200–800): the headline and card titles, with "Lab." and "RL" in italic
  - **Inter** ("InterV"): body text
  - **JetBrains Mono** ("Mono"): labels, numbers and button text in small caps
- **Colours:**
  - page `#0F1112`
  - ink white
  - body text white at 58%
  - cards: graphite gradients from `#1B1D1E` to `#141617`, with a 1px white border at 6% and a soft top-left radial light

## Content

- **Headline:** "*Lab.* Post-train your own self / improving agents", centred.
- **Buttons:** two small mono buttons: a white "START TRAINING →" and a dark outlined "BOOK A DEMO".
- **Cards** (each has a title, a one-line description, three numbered points and a small mono button):
  1. ***RL* Environments:** "Turn any task into an RL environment. Init, develop, eval, and push with the Atlas CLI."
     - Points: 11. "Built on the open-source Verifiers library." 12. "One CLI loop: init, develop, eval, push." 13. "2,500+ community environments on the Hub".
     - Button: "CREATE ENVIRONMENTS →".
     - Panel: a diamond loop diagram (INIT, DEVELOP, EVAL, PUSH nodes with `$ atlas env …` captions) around a small × centre.
  2. **Evaluations:** "Hosted evaluations for you to benchmark the performance of your models."
     - Points: 21–23.
     - Button: "RUN YOUR FIRST EVAL".
     - Panel: a model picker reading "atlas-cognition/…", a white "EVALUATE →" bar and a faint results list.
  3. **Hosted Training:** "Train large-scale models optimized for agentic workflows."
     - Points: 31. "Train on 2,500+ RL environments." 32. "Managed training workflows with full visibility and control." 33. "Hands on support from our applied research team".
     - Panel: a jagged white reward curve rising left to right on a fine grid, with "Reward" and step labels.
  4. **Inference:** "Dedicated or serverless inference for your custom models, with native LoRA support."
     - Points: 41–43.
     - Button: "BOOK A CALL".
     - Panel: stacked deployment rows with a LoRA adapter tag.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** cards fade and rise once as they enter the viewport (IntersectionObserver plus Web Animations, a 90ms stagger). The headline words rise first.
- **Panels:** the inner panels have a slow drifting highlight (a radial gradient) and SVG strokes that draw in once.
- **Hover:**
  - Cards brighten their border.
  - Buttons swap to `#E9E9E9` (light) or `#2F2F2F` (dark).
- **Touch:** hover effects are off on touch screens (`hover: none`).
- **Reduced motion:** nothing animates.

## Acceptance check (1440×1080)

- The serif headline and two buttons are centred above a wide Environments card, with the panel on the left and the copy on the right.
- The Evaluations and Training cards sit below it, followed by a mirrored Inference row.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

# Prompt: Vertex3D log-in page

Build a single-file, responsive **log-in page for a fictional AI 3D-graphics tool, Vertex3D**. Use plain HTML, CSS, inline SVG and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's a dark split screen. The left half is a near-black log-in panel. The right half is a black showcase that fades to deep violet, with a glowing headline and an iridescent toy robot on a pedestal circled by a pink orbit ring.

## Media

- **Robot:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/3fd6651e-dc6b-4339-a93a-fb627c0109e0.png`, a transparent PNG of a cute robot made of iridescent holographic glass (pink, violet and blue reflections). It has a dark visor with two glowing lilac eyes, round ear discs and an antenna. It stands on a dark chrome cylindrical pedestal with a magenta rim light.
- **Placement:** inside the showcase SVG (viewBox 0 0 421 1200), the robot is an `<image>` 96 wide, bottom-anchored at y = 470 and centred at x = 216.5.
  - It sits between the back half of the orbit ellipse (drawn first) and the front half (drawn after), so the ring wraps around the pedestal.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** **Inter** 300/400/500/600.
- **Colours:** auth panel #090909, fields #080808 with faint borders, and a pink accent #E98AE0, with links in pink #F29AD9.

## Left: log-in

- **Header:** the logo (a pink-to-violet gradient flame) and "Vertex**3D**" (the light weight is on "3D"). A dark "English ⌄" language select sits at the right.
- **Form:**
  - "Welcome!" with "Log in to Vertex3D to continue to Vertex3D."
  - Two wide outline buttons, "Log in with Google" and "Log in with Apple", using the standard marks.
  - An "OR" divider.
  - The "Email" field.
  - The "Password" field, with "Forgot password?" (pink, underlined) beside its label and an eye toggle inside it.
  - A disabled dark "Log in" button, which becomes active once both fields are filled.
  - "Don't have an account? **Sign up**".

## Right: showcase

- **Headline:** about 31px Inter 500: "400K+ users. 50M+ AI" in white, then "generated graphics." in a pink-to-lilac gradient.
- **Join Now:** a small pink triangle pointer and a pink gradient "Join Now" pill.
- **Scene:**
  - a faint, ghosted giant "3D" outline behind
  - the robot on its pedestal
  - a thin pink orbit ellipse around the pedestal, with a glowing pink dot on the front
  - a soft magenta floor glow at the bottom

## Motion

- **Entrance (CSS keyframes, about 1.8s):** the brand and form rise in order, the headline types up, the scene fades up, and the Join Now pill pops in.
- **Focus:** fields show a pink ring.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance.

## Phone

- **Layout:** the showcase hides and the log-in panel fills the screen.

## Acceptance check

- **Showcase:** the iridescent robot stands on its pedestal, inside the pink ring, below the glowing headline.
- **Brand:** "Vertex3D" everywhere.
- **Content:** no real brands except the standard Google and Apple sign-in marks.

# Prompt: Zapline trading CTA hero ("Royal Violet")

Build a single-file, one-screen **trading-product hero** for a fictional on-chain trading tool, **Zapline**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a pure black starfield with the glowing violet rim of a giant planet arching across the top. A big bold headline sits under it, and a dark product dashboard rises from the bottom of the screen with a violet light line along its top edge.

## Media

- **Glow video:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e859f229-8ebd-43fb-a5a0-58006ba75327.mp4` (1460×624, 4s, muted, loops).
  - **Content:** the violet and magenta planet rim on black. The glow pulses, plasma ripples along the arc, light streaks race outward, and the camera pushes in slowly.
  - **Loop:** the last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - **Placement:** desktop only. Lay it over the star layer with `mix-blend-mode: screen` so its black stays transparent. It covers the top 1672×717 design px of the stage, and fades in (0.8s) when ready.
- **Fallback:** until then (and on phones), the rim is painted on a canvas from a small polar colour table, `panel-texture.png` / `chart-texture.png` (violet, embedded).
- **Stars:** procedural white dots on a canvas.
- **Dashboard glow:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e0e14572-12e1-4c08-b471-a21521844945.png`, a screen-blended strip above the dashboard.
- **Rule:** nothing in the sky is animated in code. Only the video moves it.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** a **1672×941 design stage**, scaled by `s = min(vw/1672, vh/941)` and centred.
- **Overflow:** the dashboard panel stretches to the bottom edge, and the sky and stars fill the whole viewport.
- **Below 900px or portrait:** a stacked mobile layout.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:** Inter 400/500/600 for the UI, and a heavy grotesk display (700) for the headline.
- **Colours:** background `#000`, text `#f7f7f8`, muted `#8b8988`, violet `#9312ff` with a button gradient `#a020ff` → `#7a1cf8`, green `#45b558`, red `#f03b2a`.

## Layout (design px)

- **Nav:** a violet lightning-bolt logo on the left; a centred menu "Home · Features · Zapline Advantage · Referral · FAQ" with Home in a dark pill; a violet "Get Started" pill on the right.
- **Hero:**
  - **Headline**, about 84px and centred: "**Zapline** Trade Smarter, / Faster, Safer.", with Zapline in a violet gradient.
  - **Lede:** "The first fully integrated on-chain trading experience. No dashboards, no delays — Zapline empowers you / to trade directly from your favorite DeFi apps and terminals."
  - **Buttons:** a violet "Get Started" pill and a dark "Learn More" pill.
- **Dashboard panel** (1204px wide, from y = 651, rounded 14px, dark glass with a violet border), with a thin glowing violet line along its top:
  - **Sidebar:**
    - "Zapline" with a gear
    - Search, Dashboard (active pill), Snipes, Disconnect
    - Wallets, Referral, Settings
    - a "Zapline Pro" promo card with an "Upgrade" pill
  - **Top bar:** small icons and the user "Alex T. 0x3f4…9c7e".
  - **Stats:** "Revenue generated (since inception) 214,402 +12.5%" and "Active wallets/users 6412 −3.1%".
  - **Chart:** "Daily dynamics of sales" with a violet area chart.
  - **Calendar:** "January 2024", then "Start date–Now (monthly)", then rows: Total snipes 1,284 +8.4%, Avg. execution 0.42s, Win rate 68.2% +2.1%, and a "Connected apps: Charting · Terminals" row.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one timeline.
  - The nav fades down.
  - The headline wipes up line by line, then the lede and buttons.
  - The dashboard rises; its sidebar, stats, chart and calendar settle in a stagger.
- **Hover:** buttons brighten with a violet glow.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Phones

- **Planet:** the rim is cropped to the screen width.
- **Nav:** collapses to a menu button.
- **Hero:** the headline wraps to three lines.
- **Dashboard:** becomes a scrolling column with sidebar chips.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The violet planet rim glows across the top and visibly pulses and streaks.
- The headline and buttons are centred.
- The violet-edged dashboard fills the lower half.
- **Content:** no real brands.

  - **Placement:** desktop only. Lay it over the star layer with `mix-blend-mode: screen` so its black stays transparent. It covers the top 1672×717 design px of the stage, and fades in (0.8s) when ready.

- **Stars:** procedural white dots on a canvas.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** a **1672×941 design stage**, scaled by `s = min(vw/1672, vh/941)` and centred.
- **Overflow:** the dashboard panel stretches to the bottom edge, and the sky and stars fill the whole viewport.
- **Below 900px or portrait:** a stacked mobile layout.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:** Inter 400/500/600 for the UI, and a heavy grotesk display (700) for the headline.
- **Colours:** background `#000`, text `#f7f7f8`, muted `#8b8988`, violet `#9312ff` with a button gradient `#a020ff` → `#7a1cf8`, green `#45b558`, red `#f03b2a`.

## Layout (design px)

- **Nav:** a violet lightning-bolt logo on the left; a centred menu "Home · Features · Zapline Advantage · Referral · FAQ" with Home in a dark pill; a violet "Get Started" pill on the right.
- **Hero:**
  - **Headline**, about 84px and centred: "**Zapline** Trade Smarter, / Faster, Safer.", with Zapline in a violet gradient.
  - **Lede:** "The first fully integrated on-chain trading experience. No dashboards, no delays — Zapline empowers you / to trade directly from your favorite DeFi apps and terminals."
  - **Buttons:** a violet "Get Started" pill and a dark "Learn More" pill.
- **Dashboard panel** (1204px wide, from y = 651, rounded 14px, dark glass with a violet border), with a thin glowing violet line along its top:
  - **Sidebar:**
    - "Zapline" with a gear
    - Search, Dashboard (active pill), Snipes, Disconnect
    - Wallets, Referral, Settings
    - a "Zapline Pro" promo card with an "Upgrade" pill
  - **Top bar:** small icons and the user "Alex T. 0x3f4…9c7e".
  - **Stats:** "Revenue generated (since inception) 214,402 +12.5%" and "Active wallets/users 6412 −3.1%".
  - **Chart:** "Daily dynamics of sales" with a violet area chart.
  - **Calendar:** "January 2024", then "Start date–Now (monthly)", then rows: Total snipes 1,284 +8.4%, Avg. execution 0.42s, Win rate 68.2% +2.1%, and a "Connected apps: Charting · Terminals" row.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one timeline.
  - The nav fades down.
  - The headline wipes up line by line, then the lede and buttons.
  - The dashboard rises; its sidebar, stats, chart and calendar settle in a stagger.
- **Hover:** buttons brighten with a violet glow.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Phones

- **Planet:** the rim is cropped to the screen width.
- **Nav:** collapses to a menu button.
- **Hero:** the headline wraps to three lines.
- **Dashboard:** becomes a scrolling column with sidebar chips.

- The violet planet rim glows across the top and visibly pulses and streaks.
- The headline and buttons are centred.
- The violet-edged dashboard fills the lower half.
- **Content:** no real brands.

# Prompt: Vexor signup CTA and footer

Build a single-file **signup call-to-action with a footer for a fictional global payments company, Vexor**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is pure black with one framed CTA card filled with slowly swirling coral and crimson smoke, a white headline, a dark waitlist input with a coral button, and a minimal footer underneath.

## Media

- **Still plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/03c58212-3a59-4c80-b19d-30d05a174563.webp`. Abstract coral, pink and crimson smoke on black, densest on the right and fading to black at the upper left, behind the copy.
- **Loop video:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/f6f4ec49-d5dd-4893-8eb4-fa0f932aceaf.mp4` (5s, muted). The same smoke curling and drifting. Its last second crossfades into its first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
- **Video behaviour:**
  - It covers the plate inside the card (object-fit cover, anchored right bottom) at 80% opacity.
  - It fades in on `loadeddata`.
  - It is hidden for reduced motion.

## Scale

- **Units:** desktop sizes are in reference pixels of a 1440 frame (`--u = 100cqw / 1440`). The card also respects the height (`--v = min(100cqw / 1240, 100dvh / 720)`), so it fits one screen.
- **Tablet and phone:** they use their own reference boxes (768×700, 768×612 and 390×655) and stack the footer.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Inter (variable 100–900, embedded as "Inter Vexor").
- **Colours:**
  - page `#000`
  - text white
  - placeholder `#808081`
  - input fill black with a 15% white border
  - accent gradient `#FF8A73` → `#F0605A`
  - card border: a coral gradient (`rgba(244,118,104,.67)` → `.29`)
  - dividers white at 20%

## Layout (1440 frame)

- **CTA card:** about 1380 × 340u with a 20u radius.
  - **Headline:** "Get your Vexor Account", centred, about 34u, semibold.
  - **Sub:** two lines: "Join 200+ businesses like yours, powering their global / transactions with Vexor."
  - **Waitlist field:** a pill (about 460u wide) with the placeholder "Enter your email to join the waitlist" and an inset coral "Get Free Access" pill button with a soft inner highlight.
- **Footer** (below the card, same side margins):
  - Left: a three-slash "W"-like Vexor mark and a four-line paragraph: "Get paid for free from countries in the EU, Asia, and the US. There are no deposit charges. Create an account in your preferred currency and share the details to get paid. We make it easy to go international."
  - Right: "Contact Us", then "+44 20 7946 0321", then "Vexor Labs Ltd, / 12 Harbour Row, / Bristol BS1 5TT, UK".
  - A thin rule, then "Copyright © Vexor Labs. 2025. All Rights Reserved." and "Email us: hello@vexor.example".

## Motion

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS sequence of about 1.4s:
  - the card rule draws
  - the title rises
  - the copy fades
  - the form expands from its centre, then the button pops
  - the footer mark fades last
- **Hover:**
  - The input border brightens.
  - The coral button lifts 1px and glows warmer.
  - The phone and email links underline.
- **Reduced motion:** static, with no video.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- A framed card of moving coral smoke with a centred white headline and waitlist pill.
- A clean two-column footer below, with even margins.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

# Prompt: MAREN fashion hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **fashion landing hero** for a fictional label, **MAREN**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is an editorial full-bleed portrait of a blonde model in a chunky lilac knit sweater against a dreamy lilac-and-peach sunset sky. Thin white grid lines divide the frame, there's a big mixed sans and italic serif headline, a tilted polaroid, and a giant italic watermark.

## Media

- **Hero photo:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/8c8bd1ea-b9f8-4755-b2db-ca972fa9a381.jpg` (1522×1033). A low-angle portrait: long wavy golden hair, one hand at a lilac turtleneck collar, and a soft lilac sky with glowing peach and coral streaky clouds. It covers the frame, drawn 1155×794 from the top-left of the 1155×767 frame.
- **Polaroid:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4612f265-40f3-4fc9-af4c-b03c289c2b75.jpg` (520×650). A blonde woman in sunglasses, a lilac tee and light jeans, sitting on stone steps before an old building.
- **Motion:** a muted, looping video of the same shot plays over the photo with the identical box and stretch: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/0b9dbcc0-b9fc-4c2c-9418-458e4e829c59.mp4` (1600×1084, 4s). A breeze moves her hair and the knit, the clouds drift and the warm light shifts, with a subtle slow push-in.
  - The loop crossfades its last second into its first, so it never jumps or plays in reverse.
  - It fades in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready and is hidden for reduced motion.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Type and colour

- **Inter Tight** 300/400/500 for the sans.
- **Playfair Display Italic** 400/500 for the logo, the "Modern You" line and the watermark.
- **Colours:** text white; grid lines `rgba(255,255,255,.24)`; glass tint `rgba(112,84,150,.34)`; peach star `#F4B8A2`; page fallback `#3B2F5C`.

## Layout (1155×767 frame, `--u = min(100vw/1155, 100vh/767)`)

- **Grid:** vertical lines at 200.6/1155 and 843.6/1155 of the width, a horizontal line at 405.2/767, and a top rule under the nav.
- **Nav:**
  - "MAREN" in italic serif at the top-left.
  - Right: SHOP · EDITORIAL · JOURNAL separated by vertical rules, then two round glass icon buttons (heart and bag).
- **Headline:** in the left/centre column: "Timeless / Style for" in Inter Tight 300, then "*Modern You*" in Playfair italic, very large.
- **Right column:** a peach star with "WINTER 2027".
  - Lower down: "Discover fashion that blends comfort, quality, and confidence. Crafted for your everyday moments and life's special ones."
  - A white "View Product" pill and a round arrow button.
- **Bottom-left:** "NEW / SEASON / COLLECTION".
- **Polaroid:** tilted −13°, white frame, the photo, and a handwritten "Stylist T-shirt" caption. It overlaps the left column line.
- **Watermark:** a giant italic "MAREN" across the bottom at low opacity, partly behind the model.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one CSS sequence.
  - The header items drop in, and each headline line rises in turn.
  - The supporting copy fades up.
  - The polaroid drops and settles to its tilt.
- **Reduced motion:** no background video.

## Phones (portrait)

- The photo covers the screen.
- The headline and copy re-flow over it, with the polaroid smaller and the watermark scaled.
- One screen, no scrolling.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The model in the lilac sweater fills the frame under a lilac-peach sunset.
- The white grid lines frame the "Timeless Style for *Modern You*" headline.
- The tilted polaroid sits lower-left, and "MAREN" appears as the faint watermark.
- **Content:** no real brands.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Halora — smart ring hero, Sage Studio

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a wellness smart ring**, **Halora**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a calm, sunlit editorial product photo: a real hand rises from the bottom edge against a pale sage wall, a rose-gold ring with a black inner band floats between its fingers, olive-leaf shadows fall across the right side, and a thin clear glass circle arcs behind the hand. Copy sits on the left and three frosted glass metric cards stand on the right.

## Scale

- **Units:** every stage measurement is a reference pixel of a 2048×1152 artboard, multiplied by `--s = min(100vw/2048, 100vh/1152)`, with a floor of 0.55px on desktop.
- **Photo:** fitted to the viewport height and anchored to the bottom, so the arm always leaves the frame at the bottom edge. Up to about 2:1 it behaves like cover; on ultra-wide screens it stops growing and its sides fade into the sage backdrop.
- **Fill:** the hero always fills the viewport, with no letterbox bands.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:** a neo-grotesk for the UI and copy, and a light geometric display face (300/400/500) for the metric numbers.
- **Colours:**
  - Page `#CBCFB8`, matching the photo's wall.
  - Ink: deep forest `#1E3227` for the logo, nav and headline; `#3F5447` for the eyebrow and paragraph.
  - Accent: olive gold `#9B8A3E` for GOOD and KCAL.
  - Buttons: solid `#1E3227`; the Cart pill is a translucent moss `rgba(62,86,70,.52)` with backdrop blur.

## Header

- **Left:** a six-petal dashed circle logo and "Halora" at 35s.
- **Centre:** links at 22s: Technology, Health, Activity, Insights.
- **Right:** a "Cart" pill with a cart icon, then a dark "Shop the Ring" pill.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Vocari AI assistant hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a fictional voice-AI platform, Vocari**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a deep navy night sky that glows into bright cyan at the horizon. A pixel-dot audio equaliser rises from that glow, and in front of it sits a dark side-profile silhouette of a man with curly hair, with two small floating UI cards.

## Media

- **Background gradient:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/35281788-af1d-4637-b2bf-24ebe55f11bb.png` (745×194). Navy #09131F at the top, through teal, to cyan #46DCEC and then white at the bottom.
  - The page uses it as a 3-slice: the top rows are anchored at the top, the middle row stretches, and the bottom rows are anchored at the bottom with a 40px feathered join.
- **Silhouette:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b5703dce-12a2-4177-8b07-8c158121d986.png`, a transparent PNG of a young man with thick curly hair and a beard in right-facing side profile. It's one flat navy-black shape (#0A0F15).
  - It's centred slightly right of the middle, rising from the bottom edge, with its head overlapping the equaliser.
- **Equaliser:** an inline SVG of about 2,000 small square dots in columns of different heights, spanning the full width. The dots are cyan to pale cyan and fade into the white glow.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** a light, condensed serif at weight about 330, around 82px: "Create reliable AI assistants / for daily challenges", in white.
- **Subline:** a grey-blue sans line: "Vocari improves LLMs with business logic for reliable AI conversations."
- **Buttons:** a warm-cream "Book a Demo" and a dark glass "Try Now".
- **Nav:** the logo (a cyan rounded tile with three dark bars) and "Vocari" at the left; "Products ⌄ · Developers · Resources · Use Case" in the middle; a two-line burger at the right.

## Cards (foreground)

- **"Create Agent" card:** on the left over the silhouette's neck. A pale cyan-tinted glass card with the logo, "Create Agent", a "Select model ⌄" field and a dark teal "Deploy" button with cyan text.
- **Chat card:** on the right. A dotted light-grey card with tool icons, a dark navy bubble ("Metro Suites Phase II is under construction, completion by Q4 2025."), an input reading "What is most ROI…", a send icon and a round dark mic button.

## Motion

- **Entrance (about 1.6s):** the nav and headline settle, the equaliser fades in, the silhouette rises 14px, and the cards slide in.
- **Live voice (starts about 1.1s in, loops forever):** the dot equaliser behaves like someone speaking.
  - **Columns:** each column of dots grows and shrinks from its own (slanted) baseline, snapping to whole dots. It can reach up to 4 dots taller than its resting height; new dots take the row colour of the nearest column.
  - **Speech rhythm:** phrases of 1.6–2.8s separated by 0.2–0.5s pauses. Within a phrase, syllable bursts come at about 6 per second with varying strength, and a slow spectral wobble gives each column its own band.
  - **Ripple:** the voice ripples outward from the speaker's head, so columns further from the centre react a little later.
  - **Mic:** the chat card's mic button gets a soft cyan ring and glow that swell with the same voice level.
  - **Timing:** everything is a pure function of the page clock (a long Web Animation used as the time source for requestAnimationFrame), so it can be recorded frame by frame.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no live voice; the equaliser stays static.

## Phone

- **Headline:** stacks into three lines.
- **Silhouette and equaliser:** scale down, with the cards overlapping the bottom of the silhouette.

## Acceptance check

- **Glow:** the navy-to-cyan glow and the equaliser read clearly, with the curly-haired profile centred over them.
- **Voice:** the equaliser visibly talks: columns bounce in syllable bursts with short pauses, and the mic ring pulses with them.
- **Content:** no real brands.

# Prompt: Vaultra crypto finance hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a fictional crypto finance platform, Vaultra**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a black night with a huge dotted particle globe rising from the bottom. Its rim glows red, blue and magenta, and it **slowly spins**. Thin straight light lines and small glass coin chips cross the dark sky, and a large gradient headline sits on top.

## Media

- **Globe still:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/f1631235-0a76-464d-8f1d-2c4b48a997d5.jpg` (1672×941). The dotted particle globe with latitude rings and coloured rim glows, plus the thin diagonal lines and nodes.
- **Globe video:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e71aea27-a808-4ae3-8231-a469d49285d4.mp4` (1280×720, 4s, muted, loops). The same globe rotating steadily left to right, with its particle rings sliding and its rim glows shimmering. The camera is still and the lines don't move.
  - The last second crossfades into the first, so it loops with no jump and never plays in reverse.
  - It sits over the still with identical geometry and fades in once its first frame is ready.
- **Masks:** both layers stretch to a plate that covers the hero. They're feathered at the sides on ultra-wide screens and at the top on phones.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** Inter Display 300, about 66px: "Innovative Crypto Financial Solutions / For Any Investment Challenge". It's white with a soft pink-to-lilac gradient at both ends.
- **Body:** **Poppins** 400/500 for the nav, buttons and body text.

## Layout

- **Nav:**
  - "Vaultra" with a double-slash logo mark at the left
  - "Home" (active, with a round icon) · Invest · Communit · Blog · For business · Membership
  - an "EN ⌄" globe selector
  - a white "Sign up" pill and an outline "Log In" pill
- **Centre:**
  - a small glass pill "⚡ Revolutionizing Crypto Finance"
  - the headline
  - "We Don't Just Focus On Investments, We Cover Your Entire / Financial Ecosystem, From Budgeting To Retirement."
  - a white "Get Started →" pill
- **Coin chips:** small round glass chips (₿, Ξ, ₮ and a hex token) riding the light lines at the edges. A mouse-scroll hint sits at the bottom with curved "USDT" and "ETH" labels.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** CSS, about 1.6s. The nav, pill and headline lines rise in, then the copy, the CTA and the chips.
- **Globe:** spins continuously via the video.
- **Reduced motion:** no video and no entrance.

## Acceptance check

- **Globe:** it visibly rotates, and the loop has no jump.
- **Brand:** "Vaultra" everywhere, and the "Sign up" typo is fixed.

items.title: Freight Scroll Hero
items.matchReason: headline quote ("logistics that works as hard as you ...")
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: freight scroll hero ("Logistics that works as hard as you do.")

Build a single-file **scroll-driven logistics hero** in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. A sticky, full-viewport top-down aerial video sits behind the content. Scrolling scrubs a continuous camera climb: it starts close over a red-and-white container freight train crossing black coal terrain, rises higher and higher as mist drifts across, and ends inside soft white cloud. Over it the content scrolls up normally: first only the scene, then a big 4-line headline rising up the train's axis, then a mirrored features block, and then the clouds take over and fade into a plain text testimonial section.

## Media

- **Pull-up clip:** one clip, 1920×1080, 24 fps, 5.04 s, no audio. Encoded with a keyframe every 4 frames so it seeks instantly.
  - **1080p:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e02bb27f-80d8-445f-a03e-1b609dac4261.mp4
  - **720p** (for screens ≤ 900px or Save-Data): https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e8eb434f-d097-4b1b-b9e6-c8b46fa43040.mp4
- **Poster:** the clip's first frame, https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5e018553-cb8a-420a-819f-fcdfa08e5df0.jpg
- **Clip content:**
  - 0–2.3 s: the camera climbs over the train, which stays on the vertical centre line, with wisps of mist.
  - From about 2.3 s: white clouds slide in from the edges.
  - Last frame: almost all white/grey cloud.
- **Rule:** the video is never played, looped or faded. It is only scrubbed (`currentTime`). Nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** Exo 2 ExtraBold 800, uppercase.
- **UI text:** Public Sans 700 for titles and the eyebrow, 400 for body.
- **Colours:**
  - cream `#F7F5EF` (headline, eyebrow)
  - white `#F9F9F9` (titles, icons)
  - body text white at 88%
  - page and track `#0a0b0c`
  - body background after the track `#e2dedd` (cloud grey)
- **Shadows:** soft text shadows on all type, for example a headline shadow of 0 12u 32u black at 50%.

## Scale and structure

- **Unit:** the design is drawn on a 1280×800 frame. `u = min(100vh/800, 100vw/716)`. 800 design px equals one viewport height, so vertical positions are written as `N/8 vh`.
- **Track:** `.track` (relative, height set by JS). Inside it:
  - `.scene`: `position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh` (100lvh). It holds the `<video>` (object-fit cover), and a very light top/bottom tint (black at 2–12%).
  - `.content`: an absolute layer the full height of the track, holding the scrolling blocks.

## Scrolling blocks (desktop, positions from the top of the track)

- **Intro, top 940/8 vh** (enters after 140 design px of scroll). Centred, 1280u wide:
  - eyebrow "WHY US": 7.4u, tracking .304em
  - headline "LOGISTICS / THAT WORKS / AS HARD AS / YOU DO.": 56u on a 62u line, one span per line, nowrap
- **Features:** each block is 300u wide. Each has:
  - a 34u white icon, 30u above the title, sitting on the inner side near the axis
  - an uppercase title, 19.6u on a 20u line, two lines
  - a body of 12.3u on a 15.4u line, three lines
- **Rows:**

  | Row | Top | Left column | Right column |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 1 | 1500/8 vh | right-aligned, right edge 78u left of the axis | left-aligned, 78u right of it |
  | 2 | 1759/8 vh | right-aligned, 88u left of the axis | left-aligned, 88u right of it |
  | 3 | 2063/8 vh | the fifth block, centred | |

  1. **One point of contact** (dotted ring around a white globe): "No more chasing multiple vendors. One / team manages your entire end-to-end flow, / origin to destination."
  2. **Full supply chain visibility** (three stepped container blocks): "Track your freight in real time and get / proactive updates before issues become / delays."
  3. **Compliance you can trust** (dotted ring around a white disc with a dark check): "Licensed customs brokers keep your / shipments moving within every regulatory / requirement, border to border."
  4. **Competitive, transparent pricing** (bold "$" stroke): "No hidden fees. Clear, competitive pricing / backed by responsive sales support / throughout the shipment."
  5. **Fast issue resolution** (double chevron): "When something unexpected happens, we / do not point fingers, we solve it. Our team / acts at once to protect your timeline."

## Scroll → clip mapping (JS)

- **Track length:** `end = lastBlock.bottom + 0.75 × viewport`, and track height = `end + viewport`.
- **Progress:** `p = clamp((scrollY − track.top) / end)`.
- **Two-part mapping:** `knee = lastBlock.bottom / end`.
  - While `p < knee`, clip progress = `p / knee × 0.46`, so the camera only climbs over the train while text is on screen.
  - After that, it runs from 0.46 to 1, so the clouds take over once the last block has left.
- **Time:** target time = progress × (duration − 1/48).
- **Smoothing:** each frame, `cur += (target − cur) × 0.22`. Set `currentTime` only when the video isn't already seeking and the difference is more than 1/60 s, and re-seek on `seeked`.
- **Recorder mode (`?rec=1`):** a 6.5 s Web Animation drives the progress: hold to 3%, one even ease (cubic-bezier .45,.05,.55,.95) to 94%, then hold. It runs past the end of the track by 0.9 viewport so the testimonial section scrolls in. `window.__recTime(video, t)` scrolls the page to that progress and returns the matching clip time, so a frame-by-frame recorder is deterministic.

## After the clouds: testimonial section (text only)

- **Placement:** a `<section class="trust">` right after the track, pulled up 34vh over the end of the sticky scene. It starts with a 34vh gradient from transparent to `#e2dedd`, so the white clouds run straight into the page. Ink `#141516`.
- **Container:** max 1120px wide, centred, 64px side gutters, 140px bottom padding.
- **Header:** a two-column grid (1fr and 300px).
  - Left: "TRUSTED / BY BUSINESSES / ACROSS THE REGION" in Display 800 at clamp(34px, 4.4vw, 60px), line-height 1. The last line is grey `#8f8b8a`.
  - Right: a 13px note at 70% ink: "From first-time importers to high-volume shippers, our customers stay because every consignment is treated like it matters."
  - A 1px rule (ink at 16%) under the header.
- **Quotes:** three rows, each a grid of 260px and 1fr, 44px vertical padding, with a 1px rule under each. No photos.
  - Left: the name in 13px bold uppercase, the role in 12px at 60% ink.
  - Right: the quote in UI 400 at clamp(17px, 1.6vw, 21px), line-height 1.42, max 680px.
  - Thomas Reid, Director, Harbour Fit Group: "My business would not function without this team. They treat every consignment on its own merits, and our account managers know our business well enough to answer before we ask. We have never had that from a bigger carrier."
  - Ana Park, Supply Chain Lead, Northline Projects: "As a first-time shipper on a major infrastructure job, we were in unfamiliar territory. They planned the whole route with us, flagged every risk early, and our first delivery reached site on the day they promised."
  - Liam Carter, Operations Manager, Coastline Foods: "One contact, one dashboard, no surprises. When a vessel slipped two days, we heard about it before our customers did, and the new plan was already in place."
- **Portrait:** the header and each quote stack to one column (18px and 14px gaps), 22px side gutters.

## Portrait (≤ 609px wide, or any portrait aspect)

- **Unit:** `u = min(100vw/390, 1.6px)`.
- **Content:** one centred column with 112vh top padding:
  - headline at clamp(34px, 46u, 72px)
  - each feature centred with its icon above, the first 24vh below the headline, then 16vh apart
  - title lines and body lines flow inline
- **Overflow:** no sideways scroll.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **On load:** only the train close-up.
- **Headline:** rises up the train's axis and exits the top.
- **Features:** the 2×2 block and the centred fifth block scroll through, mirrored across the train, while the camera climbs.
- **End:** once the last block has gone, clouds roll in, the frame ends in white cloud, and the testimonial section rises out of it.
- **Scrubbing:** scrolling back reverses everything smoothly.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.title: Freight Services Hero
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: KV freight services scroll hero

Build a single-file **scroll-driven freight hero** for a fictional freight group, **KV**, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's a clean product-render story on a white page.

1. A teal reach-stacker lifts a navy container off a stack, turns, and lowers it onto a black semi-truck's trailer.
2. The camera pulls back and a black band rises until the truck sits on its top edge.
3. Huge light-grey "OUR SERVICES" letters slide past *behind* the truck while a dark-band strip (a headline, then five service cards) slides in from the right.

Scrolling drives everything. The scene is one sticky viewport.

## Media

- **Handling clip:** one scrubbed clip, a continuous 4.04s shot at 24fps (97 frames), muted, every 4th frame a keyframe for fast seeking.
  - 1080p: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/409763c0-95f4-49d3-a601-dc564d55072b.mp4
  - 720p, used at 900px wide and below: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b3718419-7a0a-478d-bfb0-0ff8bef7f3f7.mp4
  - Poster (first frame): https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/2307e4bf-be39-42b4-b579-e168aeccabf0.jpg
- **Clip content:** pure white background with a flat near-black ground band (#111). Its top edge sits at 82.9% of the frame height until about 3.1s.
  - The stacker lifts, turns toward camera and lowers the container onto the arriving truck.
  - The spreader releases and leaves top-left.
  - The camera pulls back, and by 3.75s the band edge is at 44.8%, with the truck's wheels on it. The rig spans about 16–66% of the frame width.
  - The last ~0.3s holds.
- **Rule:** the vehicles are never drawn or moved in code; all their motion is in the clip. No opacity transitions on the video. It is never played, only scrubbed.

## Type and colour

- **Anton** for the big caps (headline, card titles, giant letters).
- **Archivo** (variable, 400–600) for body, nav and pill.
- **JetBrains Mono** 400 for the speed readout.
- Self-host latin woff2.
- **Colours:** white #fff, ink and band #111, cobalt #2f63ff, giant letters #e9e9e9.
- **Unit:** u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960).

## Structure

- **Track:** `.track` (white), whose height is set by JS to (1 + A + B) × viewport.
  - A = 2.4 viewports for the clip.
  - B = (strip width + 0.45 × vw) / vw × 1.1 viewports for the services strip.
- **Nav:** absolute at the top of the track, so it scrolls away.
  - Left: "KV" (Archivo 600, 30u, tracking −.06em).
  - Right: "→ Menu", "Follow", and an outline pill "Work with us" (Archivo 500, 10u, uppercase, tracking .1em).
- **Scene:** `.scene` is sticky at top:0, 100vh (100lvh), overflow hidden. Its background is white above and #111 below a line placed inside the clip, which only matters where the clip doesn't cover the screen.
- **Layers, bottom to top:**
  1. **The `<video>`**, absolutely sized by JS.
     - Wide screens: cover (scale = max(vw/1920, vh/1080), centred).
     - Portrait or narrow screens (below 768px, or vw ≤ vh): width 155vw, horizontally positioned so 40% of the frame sits at mid-screen, and vertically so the final band edge lands at 36% of the viewport.
  2. **Giant letters:** "OUR SERVICES" in Anton at 330u, line-height .8, #e9e9e9, nowrap. Its bottom sits on the final band edge (JS writes `--edge-px` = clip top + 0.448 × clip height). It has **`mix-blend-mode: darken`**, so it only shows where the clip is white. The truck and container, whose silver tops out around #e5, always win, so the letters read as behind the truck. Phones: 180u.
  3. **Speed readout:** top-left (26u, 52u), "NN KM/H" in mono at 10.5u. It shows the smoothed scroll speed (|Δy|/Δt ÷ 32, capped at 99, two digits) and appears once the truck has settled.
  4. **Band:** from `--edge-px` to the bottom, holding the horizontal strip and the "Our services" outline pill. The pill sits centred 36u from the bottom; once the truck settles it fades and rises 24px into place.

## The strip (dark band, slides left)

- **Placement:** a flex row, top 76u, gap 120u, white text.
- **Lead block** (gap 64u):
  - Headline "EVERYTHING YOUR / FREIGHT NEEDS. / UNDER ONE GROUP." in Anton 64u, line-height .98. The third line is cobalt.
  - Beside it, a 250u column of two small paragraphs (Archivo 12u, white at 62%):
    - "From air to sea, from customs clearance to the last mile, we bring decades of practice to every freight discipline."
    - "One integrated network means one partner, one point of contact and full visibility from origin to destination."
- **Five cards**, each 270u wide with 30u side padding and a 1px divider (white at 12%) on the left; the first has no divider. Each has a 38u white line icon, a two-line Anton title at 26u, and Archivo body at 12.4u:
  - **Air freight** (plane): "Express, priority and deferred options across global lanes, booked and tracked end to end."
  - **Ocean freight** (ship): "FCL and LCL sailings on every major trade lane, with carrier choice based on cost and transit time."
  - **Customs brokerage** (document with check): "Licensed in-house brokers for classification, duties and inspections, so goods clear first time."
  - **Warehousing and 3PL** (warehouse): "Bonded and general storage, pick and pack, and distribution that plugs straight into transport."
  - **Project cargo** (crane hook and load): "Oversized and heavy-lift moves, engineered, permitted and escorted from factory to foundation."
- **Card reveal:** title and body use a background-clip:text gradient: white up to (s − 34%), cobalt at (s − 6%), transparent at (s + 26%). Here s = clamp((0.98 − cardLeft/vw) / 0.3, −0.4, 1.6) × 100%, so each card's text sweeps in from blue to white as it travels in from the right.

## Scroll mapping (JS, one rAF loop)

- **Clip time:** q = clamp(scrollY / (A·vh)), and target time = q × (duration − 1/48). Ease toward it each frame (cur += (target − cur) × 0.2). Seek only when the video isn't already seeking and the difference is more than 1/60s, and re-seek on `seeked`.
- **Settled flag:** when q ≥ 0.94, set `--ph = 1`. This shows the readout and the pill.
- **Strip:** r = clamp((scrollY − A·vh) / (B·vh)).
  - Strip translateX = vw − r × (stripWidth + 0.45·vw).
  - Giant letters translateX = vw − r × (lettersWidth + vw).
- **Recorder mode (`?rec=1`):** an 11s Web Animation drives progress (hold to 4%, ease cubic-bezier(.4,.05,.55,.95) to 96%, then hold). `window.__recTime(video, t)` scrolls to that progress, updates the readout from the scripted speed, and returns the clip time, so a frame-by-frame recorder is deterministic.

## Phones (below 768px, or any portrait screen)

- u = min(100vw/430, 1.4px). The clip is framed as above, with white above and black below it.
- **Strip:** top 44u, gap 56u, 22px left padding. The lead block stacks the headline (46u) over the paragraphs (300u wide, 13u).
- **Cards:** 250u wide, titles 26u, body 13u.
- **Readout:** 11px at (20px, 22px). The nav hides "Follow".
- **Overflow:** no sideways scroll.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **On load:** the stacker holds the navy container over the stack, under the KV nav.
- **Handling:** scrolling lifts the container, turns the stacker, loads the truck, and pulls back until the truck sits on the black band.
- **Services:** "OUR SERVICES" then slides past behind the truck, with no letters showing through the container or cab. The headline enters from the right, followed by the five cards sweeping from blue to white. The KM/H number follows scroll speed.
- **Scrubbing:** scrolling back reverses everything.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

- **Handling clip:** one scrubbed clip, a continuous 4.04s shot at 24fps (97 frames), muted, every 4th frame a keyframe for fast seeking.
  - 1080p: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/409763c0-95f4-49d3-a601-dc564d55072b.mp4
  - 720p, used at 900px wide and below: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b3718419-7a0a-478d-bfb0-0ff8bef7f3f7.mp4
  - Poster (first frame): https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/2307e4bf-be39-42b4-b579-e168aeccabf0.jpg
- **Clip content:** pure white background with a flat near-black ground band (#111). Its top edge sits at 82.9% of the frame height until about 3.1s.
  - The stacker lifts, turns toward camera and lowers the container onto the arriving truck.
  - The spreader releases and leaves top-left.
  - The camera pulls back, and by 3.75s the band edge is at 44.8%, with the truck's wheels on it. The rig spans about 16–66% of the frame width.
  - The last ~0.3s holds.
- **Rule:** the vehicles are never drawn or moved in code; all their motion is in the clip. No opacity transitions on the video. It is never played, only scrubbed.

## Type and colour

- **Anton** for the big caps (headline, card titles, giant letters).
- **Archivo** (variable, 400–600) for body, nav and pill.
- **JetBrains Mono** 400 for the speed readout.
- Self-host latin woff2.
- **Colours:** white #fff, ink and band #111, cobalt #2f63ff, giant letters #e9e9e9.
- **Unit:** u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960).

## Structure

- **Track:** `.track` (white), whose height is set by JS to (1 + A + B) × viewport.
  - A = 2.4 viewports for the clip.
  - B = (strip width + 0.45 × vw) / vw × 1.1 viewports for the services strip.
- **Nav:** absolute at the top of the track, so it scrolls away.
  - Left: "KV" (Archivo 600, 30u, tracking −.06em).
  - Right: "→ Menu", "Follow", and an outline pill "Work with us" (Archivo 500, 10u, uppercase, tracking .1em).
- **Scene:** `.scene` is sticky at top:0, 100vh (100lvh), overflow hidden. Its background is white above and #111 below a line placed inside the clip, which only matters where the clip doesn't cover the screen.
- **Layers, bottom to top:**
  1. **The `<video>`**, absolutely sized by JS.
     - Wide screens: cover (scale = max(vw/1920, vh/1080), centred).
     - Portrait or narrow screens (below 768px, or vw ≤ vh): width 155vw, horizontally positioned so 40% of the frame sits at mid-screen, and vertically so the final band edge lands at 36% of the viewport.
  2. **Giant letters:** "OUR SERVICES" in Anton at 330u, line-height .8, #e9e9e9, nowrap. Its bottom sits on the final band edge (JS writes `--edge-px` = clip top + 0.448 × clip height). It has **`mix-blend-mode: darken`**, so it only shows where the clip is white. The truck and container, whose silver tops out around #e5, always win, so the letters read as behind the truck. Phones: 180u.
  3. **Speed readout:** top-left (26u, 52u), "NN KM/H" in mono at 10.5u. It shows the smoothed scroll speed (|Δy|/Δt ÷ 32, capped at 99, two digits) and appears once the truck has settled.
  4. **Band:** from `--edge-px` to the bottom, holding the horizontal strip and the "Our services" outline pill. The pill sits centred 36u from the bottom; once the truck settles it fades and rises 24px into place.

## The strip (dark band, slides left)

- **Placement:** a flex row, top 76u, gap 120u, white text.
- **Lead block** (gap 64u):
  - Headline "EVERYTHING YOUR / FREIGHT NEEDS. / UNDER ONE GROUP." in Anton 64u, line-height .98. The third line is cobalt.
  - Beside it, a 250u column of two small paragraphs (Archivo 12u, white at 62%):
    - "From air to sea, from customs clearance to the last mile, we bring decades of practice to every freight discipline."
    - "One integrated network means one partner, one point of contact and full visibility from origin to destination."
- **Five cards**, each 270u wide with 30u side padding and a 1px divider (white at 12%) on the left; the first has no divider. Each has a 38u white line icon, a two-line Anton title at 26u, and Archivo body at 12.4u:
  - **Air freight** (plane): "Express, priority and deferred options across global lanes, booked and tracked end to end."
  - **Ocean freight** (ship): "FCL and LCL sailings on every major trade lane, with carrier choice based on cost and transit time."
  - **Customs brokerage** (document with check): "Licensed in-house brokers for classification, duties and inspections, so goods clear first time."
  - **Warehousing and 3PL** (warehouse): "Bonded and general storage, pick and pack, and distribution that plugs straight into transport."
  - **Project cargo** (crane hook and load): "Oversized and heavy-lift moves, engineered, permitted and escorted from factory to foundation."
- **Card reveal:** title and body use a background-clip:text gradient: white up to (s − 34%), cobalt at (s − 6%), transparent at (s + 26%). Here s = clamp((0.98 − cardLeft/vw) / 0.3, −0.4, 1.6) × 100%, so each card's text sweeps in from blue to white as it travels in from the right.

## Scroll mapping (JS, one rAF loop)

- **Clip time:** q = clamp(scrollY / (A·vh)), and target time = q × (duration − 1/48). Ease toward it each frame (cur += (target − cur) × 0.2). Seek only when the video isn't already seeking and the difference is more than 1/60s, and re-seek on `seeked`.
- **Settled flag:** when q ≥ 0.94, set `--ph = 1`. This shows the readout and the pill.
- **Strip:** r = clamp((scrollY − A·vh) / (B·vh)).
  - Strip translateX = vw − r × (stripWidth + 0.45·vw).
  - Giant letters translateX = vw − r × (lettersWidth + vw).
- **Recorder mode (`?rec=1`):** an 11s Web Animation drives progress (hold to 4%, ease cubic-bezier(.4,.05,.55,.95) to 96%, then hold). `window.__recTime(video, t)` scrolls to that progress, updates the readout from the scripted speed, and returns the clip time, so a frame-by-frame recorder is deterministic.

## Phones (below 768px, or any portrait screen)

- u = min(100vw/430, 1.4px). The clip is framed as above, with white above and black below it.
- **Strip:** top 44u, gap 56u, 22px left padding. The lead block stacks the headline (46u) over the paragraphs (300u wide, 13u).
- **Cards:** 250u wide, titles 26u, body 13u.
- **Readout:** 11px at (20px, 22px). The nav hides "Follow".
- **Overflow:** no sideways scroll.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **On load:** the stacker holds the navy container over the stack, under the KV nav.
- **Handling:** scrolling lifts the container, turns the stacker, loads the truck, and pulls back until the truck sits on the black band.
- **Services:** "OUR SERVICES" then slides past behind the truck, with no letters showing through the container or cab. The headline enters from the right, followed by the five cards sweeping from blue to white. The KM/H number follows scroll speed.
- **Scrubbing:** scrolling back reverses everything.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: NORVA night-city staffing hero

Build a single-file, scroll-driven hero for a fictional crew-staffing company, **NORVA** ("The New Standard in Staffing"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a 3D isometric miniature city at night. Graphite clay buildings with warm lit windows, tiny workers in hi-vis vests and white hard hats, wind turbines and container stacks all sit on a deep slate-navy ground, joined by glowing cyan route lines. Scrolling glides the camera forward over the city to a hub building, while the headline lies back into the ground and a four-step process list takes over the bottom left.

## Media

- **Glide clip (desktop):** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/65fdef53-5686-4659-8761-52d61bf1a4f7.mp4`. 1920×1080, 60 fps, 5.04 s, no audio, a keyframe every 8 frames so it seeks instantly.
  - **Content:** one continuous camera glide at a fixed isometric angle.
  - **Start:** the night city sits in the lower 60% of the frame, with empty dark ground above it for the headline.
  - **During the glide:** the buildings slide up and out of view, cyan routes stream toward a hub building, workers walk, turbines turn and steam drifts.
  - **End:** the hub building with a glowing cyan dot halo, three parallel cyan routes running in from the top left, and two cooling towers with steam on the right.
  - The motion only moves forward and eases out at the end.
- **Glide clip (≤ 900 px wide):** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9a30e5e9-9f03-4755-9bc1-7bcf1510aab3.mp4`, the same clip at 1280×720.
- **Poster:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/33150b94-09f7-47da-a7c9-3ae76c2dd7eb.jpg`, the clip's first frame.
- **Rule:** nothing in the city is drawn or animated in code. All scene motion comes from the clip, and the clip has no opacity transitions.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Inter Tight (variable, self-hosted latin woff2).
  - Headline: 600 at 84u, line-height .96, tracking −.045em.
  - Body: 400 at 18u.
  - UI labels: 500/600 uppercase at 11–11.5u with .05–.06em tracking.
- **Unit:** `u = clamp(.72px, min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960), 1.5px)`.
- **Colours:**
  - night `#0f1626`
  - ink `#f4f6fa`, with 72% and 46% alphas for secondary text
  - pill grey `#2a3245`
  - lime `#c6ff2e` (dark text on it)
  - cyan `#3fd8ff` (loader mark)
  - hairlines in white at 22%

## Layout (1440×960)

- **Nav** (fixed, 58u tall, three columns):
  - left: "OUR INDUSTRIES", "OUR MISSION"
  - centre: the wordmark "NORVA" (700, 19u, .06em tracking)
  - right: a grey pill "APPLY" and a lime pill "REQUEST CREWS" (40u tall, fully rounded; they lift 1px on hover)
- **Hero copy** (fixed, centred, 92u from the top, inside a `perspective: 900u` stage):
  - "The New Standard / in Staffing"
  - three lines in 72% white: "AI driven speed. Expert curation. / We mobilize verified crews to protect your schedule and / your bottom line in high-consequence environments."
- **Scroll cue:** "SCROLL TO DISCOVER OUR PROCESS", centred 36u from the bottom, with a 1px underline.
- **Process list** (fixed, bottom left at 36u / 28u, 430u wide): four rows.
  - **Inactive row:** a 36u number cell and a 12.5u title, both at 72% white.
  - **Active row:** the number sits in a white rounded square with dark text, the title grows to 18u white, and a paragraph opens below it (`grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr`, .45s) with a hairline at its left.
  - **Rows:**
    - 01 "Activation, simplified": "One call starts mobilization. Craft, headcount and start date go straight to our vetted crews. No hand-offs. No escalations. Just boots on site within minutes."
    - 02 "Cleared to count": "Every worker is screened before dispatch: compliance, background, certifications and fitness for duty, so the whole crew clears the gate on day one."
    - 03 "Proven field match"
    - 04 "Seamless arrival"
- **Scene:** a light shade over the clip keeps the type readable: navy at 55% fading out by 34% from the top, and 50% fading out by 30% from the bottom.

## Scroll behaviour

- **Structure:** a 420vh track holding a sticky 100vh scene with the `<video>` (object-fit cover).
- **Progress:** `p = (scrollY − track.top) / (track.height − innerHeight)`, clamped to 0–1.
- **Clip:** target time = `p × (duration − 1/48)`. Each frame, `cur += (target − cur) × .2`. Set `currentTime` only when the video isn't already seeking and the difference is more than 1/60 s, and re-seek on `seeked`.
- **The rest of the UI is a pure function of p:**
  - **Headline block:** with `h = easeInOutQuad(p/.38)`, apply `translateY(−34h vh) rotateX(62h deg) scale(1 − .12h)` around its bottom edge, so it lies back into the city. Its opacity falls from 1 to 0 between p .10 and .24.
  - **Process list:** rises 40px and fades in between p .08 and .24. Step 01 is active below p .62, and step 02 above it.
  - **Scroll cue:** its underline drains over the first 10%, and the cue fades out between p .04 and .12.
- **Loader:** a full-screen night panel with two dotted ellipses (one wide, one circular) around the mark. The mark is six cyan squares in a ring and a lime chevron, spinning every 1.6 s on an ease. The loader fades out (.6s) 350ms after the clip's first frame loads, or after 3.5 s at most.
- **Reduced motion:** no loader spin and no transitions. The UI still follows scroll, without smoothing.
- **Recorder mode (`?rec=1`):** the loader is removed and a 6.5 s Web Animation drives p: hold 0.55 s, then a linear glide of exactly 5.04 s (one clip frame per frame at 60 fps), then hold. `window.__recTime(video, t)` scrolls to that p, updates the UI and returns the clip time.

## Phone (≤ 760px)

- **Unit:** u = 1px.
- **Nav:** the left links are hidden; the wordmark sits left and the two pills (34px) right.
- **Headline:** 96px from the top, clamp(38px, 11vw, 48px).
- **Subline:** 15px, flowing as one paragraph up to 34ch.
- **Process list:** spans the width with 18px gutters, 22px from the bottom.
- **Overflow:** no sideways scroll.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **On load:** the loader spins and then fades to the night city, with the headline over the dark ground.
- **Scrolling:** the headline tilts back into the ground and disappears while the camera glides over the city, and step 01 opens at the bottom left.
- **Further on:** the cyan routes lead to the glowing hub and step 02 takes over.
- **Scrolling back:** reverses everything smoothly.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Maya Lind profile page (bento)

Build a single-file **personal profile page for a product designer** with a short intro and a bento grid of live cards. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is calm and editorial: warm light grey, off-white rounded cards with hairline borders and soft shadows, tight neo-grotesk type, and one orange accent. Every card has a small piece of quiet, real UI motion.

## Fit: never cropped

- **Stage:** the whole page is drawn on one **1440×960** stage. It's scaled with `transform: scale(min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960))` and centred in a fixed full-window viewport. The intro and the complete grid are always fully visible, with even margins, on any desktop window.
- **Narrow screens (≤820px):** the stage becomes a normal column (intro, then the cards stacked full width) and the page scrolls.

## Media

All photos are generated and contain no logos.

- **Avatar (440×440):** a woman with dark tied-back hair in a black jacket, on a flat orange backdrop. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/60582a62-dbab-4bc1-9169-07db0fcb51b1.jpg`
- **Album cover (500×500):** a single pink gerbera on a soft pink ground. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/ed0c3ef0-5a75-4933-9f3c-6afbea39e2ec.jpg`
- **Book (503×700):** a red hardcover, "THE PATIENT BUILDER / ADA MARSH", on white. It's shown with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so the white drops out on the card. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b820bd2c-7312-4ac3-8162-76f6d97d4de4.jpg`
- **Football photo (960×645):** a coach kneeling with a ball among kids in red kits on a pitch. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9f4e5ca0-844d-4c0a-8665-5cc5024e3281.jpg`
- **Map (960×645):** a very light grey street map of Lisbon with the estuary. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4f3be2d6-3848-493b-b3d7-5880dac21a63.jpg`

## Type and colour

- **Type:** Inter (variable, self-hosted).
  - Headline 39.5px / 46px, weight 520, tracking −0.021em.
  - Bio 20.5px / 31px.
  - Card titles 15.5–29px; chips 12.5px.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#EEECE8`, cards `#F5F3EF`, hairlines black at 7%
  - ink `#1E1C1A`, secondary `#77736E`, muted `#A7A39D`
  - chips `#E9E6E1`, orange `#EE6A1F`, green `#3BC45E`, dark segment `#2A2624`

## Layout (stage pixels)

- **Avatar:** 145px square at (136, 82), radius 11.
- **Headline** at (321, 92), 900px wide: "Hi I’m Maya Lind — I’m a Product Designer at / Fieldnote." followed by " Previously at Orbit." in the muted colour.
- **Bio** at (321, 203), 790px wide, two lines: "I am a seasoned product designer with 5 years of experience specializing in / crafting creative tools solutions and empowering creatives."
- **Voice-note pill** at (321, 287), 495×53, fully rounded, a white-ish fill with a hairline border:
  - a 29px orange round play/pause button
  - 78 waveform bars, 2px wide, with seeded heights and two loud bursts
  - a timer, right-aligned
- **"Available for Work" pill** at (841, 287), 174×53: a green dot with a pulsing halo.
- **Grid:** cards with radius 14, gaps of 17px, outer margins of 76px.
  - **Row 1** (top 390, height 258): Experience 370px · What I’m listening 513px · What I’m reading 371px.
  - **Row 2** (top 665, height 242): Map 370px · Photo 330px · How I work 554px.
- **Chips:** each card has a small rounded label at its top left (line icon plus text): "Experience", "What I’m listening", "What I’m reading", "Map", "How I work".

## Cards

- **Experience:** a vertical timeline with a 1.5px dark line, 8.5px dots, a title at 15.5px and the years in muted grey.
  - Items: Studio Kettle & Co (2020 – 2023), Product Designer (2020 – 2023), Freelance (2023), Orbit — Design Lead (2018 – 2020), Fieldnote — Product Designer (2023 – now), Speaker, Form Conf (2024).
  - The list is doubled and drifts upward at 9px/s, inside a top/bottom fade mask, as a seamless loop.
- **What I’m listening:**
  - Album 165×173 on the left.
  - "SLOW BLOOM" at 18px weight 500 and "Juno Vale" in muted grey.
  - A 243px progress bar (3.5px) with a dark fill and an mm:ss time that advances from 00:34 through a 3:12 track.
  - Prev / play-pause / next and a volume icon; play-pause toggles.
- **What I’m reading:** "The Patient Builder" at 25.5px / 35px, "Ada Marsh" in muted grey, and the book at the right, tilted 5° and bleeding to the bottom edge.
- **Map:** the map fills the card with an 11px inset, radius 9. "Lisbon" sits centred at 27px in grey, with a small "Lisbon" label at the bottom left.
- **Photo:** the football photo inset 11px, with a white pill at the bottom left reading "I love teaching football" with a small orange ball icon.

items.title: Vela Terms Hero
items.prompt_text: # Prompt: Vela "in your terms" hero Build a single-file, one-screen hero for a fictional privacy app, **vela**: a secure messaging app, crypto wallet and Web3 browser. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is soft and warm: a grainy pastel gradient panel and a huge tight grotesk headline. The first word cycles through four verbs, each with its own glossy 3D icon, and the panel's colour changes with every word. A cream stats strip with a curved notch sits underneath. ## Media Four glossy 3D icons, each a 320×320 webp with transparency, in a soft inflated candy material. The files are orange, but the page shows each icon in its own word's hue (see **Icon tint** below). | Word | Icon | File | |---|---|---| | Message | rounded chat bubble with three embossed dots | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/83de7c35-dd91-4e56-bfb8-0ffafc83d0e0.webp` | | Browse | four-pointed sparkle star with two small orbiting spheres | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4d952211-0474-48cc-af48-58f68b3b7525.webp` | | Transact | two curved arrows cycling around a $ coin | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e2e91fca-5b3f-4e0e-a437-8a581592e407.webp` | | Build web | a globe of rounded hexagon-like cells with meridian grooves | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/6b32bb47-4ad6-4938-a637-c997b373c68b.webp` | ## Scale and type - **Unit:** every size is in px of a 1440×960 frame, multiplied by `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960)`. The page fills the viewport. - **Font:** **Inter Tight** (variable, self-hosted latin), 500 for the headline, numbers and lead, and 400/500 for UI. - **Colours:** - ink `#0D0D0C` - secondary text at 56% ink, the scroll hint at 42% - strip and page cream `#FBF6EF` ## Layout (1440×960) - **Hero panel:** the top 75% of the screen. - It's made of four stacked gradient layers, one per word. Each layer has a vertical base gradient, a large radial glow at about 86% / 76% (bottom right), and a softer radial glow at about 32% / 105% (bottom left). - **Message**, lemon cream: base `#F2ECDF` → `#F4EBC6`, glow `rgb(246,222,104)`. - **Browse**, peach and apricot: base `#F8DCC7` → `#F9CBA9`, glow `rgb(249,150,84)`. - **Transact**, warm sage mint: base `#E9EBE0` → `#DFE9D4`, glow `rgb(150,206,150)`. - **Build web**, rose lilac: base `#F0E4E6` → `#ECD6E2`, glow `rgb(222,150,200)`. - A fine SVG fractal-noise grain sits on top at 18% opacity with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. - **Nav:** 80u tall, with a hairline under it. - **Left:** a 13u black dot and "vela", 600 weight at 25u. - **Right:** "Products / Company / Docs", each with a small chevron (17u, 42u gaps), then an outlined "Join Vela" button (48u tall, 7u radius, 1.4px border). The button fills black on hover. - **Headline:** - **Position:** left 112u, top 190u. - **Size:** 172u on a 0.86 line height, tracking −0.032em. - **Line 1:** the cycling slot, an icon at 1em square followed by the word. - **Line 2:** "in your terms", which never changes. - **Row:** at top 578u. - Two outlined store buttons, 58u tall: "App Store" with a fruit glyph and "Google Play" with a play-triangle glyph. Use neutral line icons, not official badges. - Beside them, a 2-line caption at 18.5u: "Vela is a secure messaging app, crypto wallet, and / Web3 browser built with state of the art technology." - **Stats strip:** the bottom 25% of the screen, in cream. - **Notch:** its top edge rises over the right side in a smooth S-curve. The SVG path is `M0 62 H1062 C1092 62 1098 54 1116 34 C1138 9 1146 1 1178 1 H1440 V62 Z` in a 1440×62 box, stretched to the width. - **Scroll hint:** "↓ Scroll to learn more" at 15u sits on the raised part. - **Content:** - "Nothing great is / made alone" at 29u, 500 weight - three stats at 54u: **11.5M+** "Active accounts", **$0.0002** "Average cost per transaction", **80+** "Dapps integrations", with labels at 16.5u - a thin line-art sprout (two leaves on a stem, a little ground line) on the far right ## Icon tint (in code) Each icon takes the hue of its word's panel, so the icon and background read as one colour family: - **Wrapper:** each icon sits in a 1.02em square wrapper with `isolation: isolate`. - **Base:** the `` is turned grey with `filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.1) contrast(1.08)`. - **Tint layer:** a colour layer sits on top, `background: var(--tint)` with `mix-blend-mode: color`, clipped to the icon's own shape with `mask: url() center/contain no-repeat`. The grey icon's shading and speculars survive, and only the hue and saturation change. - **Tints:** Message `#E9C22E` (yellow), Browse `#F2772F` (orange), Transact `#3FB874` (green), Build web `#C564C4` (rose violet). - **Motion:** the transforms (bob, pop-in) go on the wrapper. ## Motion (one clock) - **Clock:** everything reads one clock, a long Web Animation's `currentTime`, so a frame-by-frame recorder can seek it. - **Slots:** each word has a 1.75 s slot, in the order Message → Browse → Transact → Build web, looping. - **Enter, over 0.5 s:** opacity 0→1, rising from +0.32em, blur 10px→0, scale 0.96→1, ease-out cubic. The icon follows 60 ms later, scaling 0.7→1 and untwisting from −14°. - **Leave, the last 0.42 s:** fade out while drifting up 0.16em and blurring to 8px, ease-in cubic. - **Panel colour:** crossfades over a 0.77 s window that straddles each word change, so it passes through a soft muted mix as in the reference. - **Idle motion:** the icon floats gently (±0.028em, ±3°). The gradient layers drift slowly (±2.2% / ±1.6% at scale 1.08), so nothing is ever frozen. - **App Store:** while "Build web" holds, the App Store button fills to black with white text and then releases. - **Live first word:** Message also fades in on load. - **Reduced motion:** a still "Browse" state. - **Hidden tab:** the clock pauses. ## Phones (≤ 760px) - The panel flows in normal order. - The headline is at `clamp(52px, 15.5vw, 88px)`. - The store buttons wrap, and the caption sits under them. - The strip's stats wrap into two columns with the sprout on the right. - No sideways scroll. ## Acceptance check (1440×960) - "Browse in your terms" sits on a warm peach panel with the glossy star tinted orange; each icon always matches its panel's hue. - Every 1.75 s the word blurs up and out, and the next rises in with its own icon while the panel shifts to lemon, sage or rose. - The App Store button flashes black during "Build web". - **Content:** no real brands or logos.

The SVG path is `M0 62 H1062 C1092 62 1098 54 1116 34 C1138 9 1146 1 1178 1 H1440 V62 Z` in a 1440×62 box, stretched to the width. - **Scroll hint:** "↓ Scroll to learn more" at 15u sits on the raised part. - **Content:** - "Nothing great is / made alone" at 29u, 500 weight - three stats at 54u: **11.5M+** "Active accounts", **$0.0002** "Average cost per transaction", **80+** "Dapps integrations", with labels at 16.5u - a thin line-art sprout (two leaves on a stem, a little ground line) on the far right ## Icon tint (in code) Each icon takes the hue of its word's panel, so the icon and background read as one colour family: - **Wrapper:** each icon sits in a 1.02em square wrapper with `isolation: isolate`. - **Base:** the `` is turned grey with `filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.1) contrast(1.08)`. - **Tint layer:** a colour layer sits on top, `background: var(--tint)` with `mix-blend-mode: color`, clipped to the icon's own shape with `mask: url() center/contain no-repeat`. Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Arceage Testimonial"** in the **Testimonials** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `arceage-testimonial`
- **Category:** Testimonials (testimonials)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/animated%20(24).webp
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/animated%20(24).webp
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Arceage Testimonial"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/animated%20(24).webp) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Arceage Testimonial"** (Testimonials) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Arceage Testimonial"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).
