items.title: Veyra Electric
items.prompt_text:
# Recreate VEYRA — complete coding-agent prompt

You are an implementation agent with access to a terminal, filesystem and browser. Create and run the approved VEYRA automotive website in my local workspace. Complete the implementation and verification; do not stop at a plan.

## Objective and source of truth

Reproduce the finished interactive scene from this public release:

- Repository: https://github.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car
- Approved tag: `v1.0.0`
- Source ZIP: https://github.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.0.zip
- Desktop reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/v1.0.0/docs/images/desktop.png
- Phone reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/v1.0.0/docs/images/mobile.png
- Asset base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/v1.0.0/public/media/

The reference source, media and stylesheet are authoritative. This is a faithful reproduction task. Obtain the pinned release and reuse its implementation. Do not substitute a freshly invented landing page, a different car, a simulated video, a new UI system or newly generated imagery. Do not claim that a text-only generative reconstruction is identical to the reference.

If Git/network tools are unavailable, explain the precise blocker and ask me to provide the release ZIP. Do not make a visually unrelated placeholder and call the task complete.

## Bootstrap

1. Inspect the current directory. If it already contains this project, read its instructions and check the working tree before making changes. Preserve local work. If the directory contains a different project, create a clearly named child directory; do not overwrite it or reset its Git history.
2. In a clean workspace, clone the tag:

```sh
git clone --branch v1.0.0 https://github.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car.git
cd veyra-interactive-car
git switch -c my-veyra
```

3. Read `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/MEDIA.md` and `docs/VERIFICATION.md`. Inspect both reference screenshots.
4. Use Node.js 22 or later and pnpm 10.15.1. Install pnpm if needed with the environment's normal package-manager mechanism. Keep the release dependency versions and lockfile. Do not introduce new application libraries.
5. Run:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm verify:reference
pnpm build
pnpm dev
```

6. Use http://127.0.0.1:5220/ as the local preview. If another process occupies it, identify the process and reuse it only if it serves this exact project. Do not kill unrelated processes. Use one deliberate alternate port only if necessary and report it clearly.

If adapting into another toolchain is explicitly required by my environment, first get the original Vite release running. Preserve the same React components, CSS, content and asset bytes; isolate framework plumbing from the reference behaviour. Report that the result is an adaptation if any reference files differ.

## Product and page

VEYRA is a fictional independent electric-vehicle design study. The page title is `VEYRA — Electric, inside out.` It is a single interactive scene with a lightweight header, title row, framed media, four hotspots, contextual menus, two technical detail views and a compact footer.

The header shows the `VEYRA` wordmark, `Electric vehicle design` on sufficiently wide screens, and `Independent concept`. The overview title is `Electric, inside out.` Supporting copy reads `Explore beneath the surface.` and `Select a point to begin.`

The footer has four aligned text groups: Electric drive, Battery architecture, Body finishes, Wheel designs. Preserve their exact text from App.tsx. A slim baseline shows `VEYRA — Design study` and the current scene's supporting sentence. Appearance menus temporarily replace the footer notes visually, leaving the car unobstructed.

Do not add buy buttons, prices, range estimates, performance specifications, brand claims, navigation sections, testimonials, cards or a contact form. Do not turn the page into a multi-screen marketing site. There is no runtime 3D model, no scroll-scrubbing timeline and no looping autoplay background.

## Visual contract

- Font: Space Grotesk, weight 400 only. Use the release font import. No synthetic bold.
- Primary colours: studio `#6b879d`, sky `#708fa2`, white `#ffffff`, muted text `#e1eaf0`, panel `#35586e`, electric green `#edff39`, dark accent text `#10190c`, thin white-alpha lines.
- The wordmark has restrained kerning. The title hierarchy comes from size and spacing, not heavier font weights.
- One shared image plane holds media and hotspots at a nominal 1672:941 ratio. Preserve the existing measurement formula and CSS variables.
- One white 3px outer frame encloses all media states; radius 16px on larger screens and 12px on phones. It must not alter media coordinates. No feather masks, background recolouring or duplicated blurred car silhouettes.
- Preserve the full visible car, both wheels, open hood and ground shadow.
- Hotspots are 48px interaction targets with compact electric-green discs, dark thin plus icons and restrained hover labels. Keep keyboard focus visible.
- Appearance panels use a consistent blue surface, 12px radius, thin border and readable labels. The panel stays outside the vehicle image, below the frame.
- Desktop header/title/media/footer align to the same measured width. At widths at most 900px, use the release stacked layout, 20px side margins and a two-column text footer.
- At desktop heights at most 780px, technical descriptions flow below the media. Do not shrink or move the image during entry/return to accommodate them.

Reuse `src/index.css` in full. These notes explain its intent; they do not replace the precise reference rules.

## Asset contract

Use the release's `public/media` directory with unchanged bytes. All assets are supplied. Keep filenames and nested paths case-exact.

Active exterior: `exterior-polished.png`.

Hover pairs:

- Drive: `hood-hover-forward.mp4`, `hood-hover-reverse.mp4`.
- Battery: `battery-hover-forward.mp4`, `battery-hover-reverse.mp4`.

Active technical images: `drive-blue.png`, `battery-blue.png`.

Paint: original exterior for Studio Silver; `config/electric-green.png`, `config/lime-green.png`, `config/sky-blue.png`, `config/graphite.png` for the remaining four choices.

Wheels: original exterior for Multi-spoke; `config/wheels-aero.png` for Aero Disc; `config/wheels-forged.png` for Sport Forged.

Keep earlier/dormant stills in the release too. `optics` and disabled detail-flight clip metadata in `content.ts` are not active features. Do not enable them or fabricate their missing videos.

Do not resize, recompress, retime, recolour or regenerate approved media. Do not send assets to an external generation provider during reproduction. Prefer local files served by Vite; do not leave playback dependent on temporary provider URLs.

## Interaction contract

There are exactly four overview points:

- Drive at x=25%, y=48%: hover/focus opens the hood; click enters the drive detail.
- Battery at x=64%, y=72%: hover/focus reveals the battery; click enters its detail.
- Paint at x=55%, y=51%: opens body-colour selection.
- Wheels at x=48%, y=71%: opens wheel selection.

Coordinates are image-relative. Do not position them against the whole screen.

### Hover playback

Retain `HoverVideo.tsx` exactly. It uses four off-DOM video elements and one canvas. Show frames only after decoding. Hold the last displayed frame at every handoff. Distinguish the currently settled pose from the latest desired hotspot.

items.title: Vertex
items.prompt_text:
Build a single, self-contained, production-ready `index.html` — one file, no build step, no frameworks, no local assets. It renders a full-viewport dark hero section for a fictional e-commerce SaaS called "Vertex Shops". Every image loads from the absolute CloudFront URLs in §8. There is NO video anywhere in this page. Two components below are marked PIXEL CONTRACT. Those are the most commonly botched parts of this design. Implement them exactly as written, including the DO-NOT lists. Do not "improve" them, do not substitute a more conventional button/pill pattern, do not add glows or centring that is not specified. ===================================================================== 0. GLOBAL SHELL ===================================================================== , . Vision — Streamline the shop virtual FONTS — exactly these three tags in , in this order: Reset: *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box} html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} /* page never scrolls */ body{font-family:Poppins,Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased} a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit} /* REQUIRED - button labels must never underline */ ===================================================================== 1. CORE ARCHITECTURE — A FIXED DESIGN CANVAS THAT IS SCALED ===================================================================== The single most important idea: the desktop composition is authored at a fixed 1172 x 657 px design canvas. EVERY element is absolutely positioned in raw design pixels — there is no flow layout, no flexbox column, no auto-centring on desktop. The whole canvas is then scaled by ONE transform to fit the viewport. Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Orla Fashion"** in the **Fashion** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `orla-fashion`
- **Category:** Fashion (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/cooraldfashionArea.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260914_051133_318774e7-6f37-421b-8425-9c9150ea61e8.png&w=1920&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity

items.title: Atelier Unit
items.prompt_text:
Build one standalone HTML file, a single full-viewport hero for Atelier Unit. No external CSS, no frameworks, no extra sections, no headings outside the page itself. Output only the complete document. Use these values exactly. Do not round, rename classes, restack the layout, or substitute a different video.

Document
- lang="en"
- charset utf-8
- viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover
- theme-color #0d0905
- title: Atelier Unit — Craftwork, Technology, Design
- html and body: margin 0, padding 0, height 100%, background #130e09

Fonts
- Family name "AU Grotesk"
- Regular: @font-face src url(assets/au-grotesk-regular.woff2) format("woff2"), weight 400, font-display:block
- Bold: @font-face src url(assets/au-grotesk-bold.woff2) format("woff2"), weight 700, font-display:block
- These are a Latin subset of TeX Gyre Heros (Helvetica / Neue Haas grotesque). Do not swap in Inter, Roboto, or a Google font.
- Body stack: "AU Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
- color #ffffff
- -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; text-rendering: geometricPrecision; font-kerning: normal
- links and buttons inherit color and font; links have no underline; buttons have no background, border, or padding, cursor pointer
- :focus-visible is a 1px solid white outline, offset 3px

Scale
Design frame is 1280 × 800. One design pixel equals --u, the largest uniform scale that fits the whole frame in the viewport.
- --vh: 1vh, and 1dvh where supported
- --ink: #ffffff
- --base-bot: #130e09
- --rule: rgba(255,255,255,0.115)
- --grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.0265)
- --menu-bg: #fcfcfc
- --menu-ink: #141414
- --small-min: 10px; at min-height 480px, --small-min becomes 11.28px
- --u: min(100vw / 1280, var(--vh) * 100 / 800)
- --small: max(var(--small-min), 12.6 * var(--u))
Heights map 1:1 to the screen. Extra width is absorbed by edge-anchored elements and the extended backdrop. Box-sizing border-box on everything.

Stage
.hero is position relative, isolation isolate, overflow hidden, width 100%, height 100vh and 100dvh, min-height 320px.
Its background is this exact vertical gradient:
linear-gradient(180deg, #0d0905 0%, #0f0a05 15%, #0d0a05 30%, #0d0905 45%, #0e0a06 60%, #0f0c07 75%, #130e08 90%, #130e09 100%)

Background video
Use this CloudFront URL and no other asset, local or remote:
https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_143740_52dbf3ef-ea20-4594-a1ad-91d6c2970159.mp4
It is a muted, looping, autoplaying, playsinline video of a figure seen from behind in a dark coat and a polished black mirrored helmet, with a thin amber arc behind the shoulders and low haze. Do not replace it with an image.

.hero__photo is role="presentation", position absolute, z-index -3.
- --pw: max(min(100vw, 1536 * var(--u)), var(--vh) * 160)
- --fade: clamp(0px, 100vw - var(--pw), var(--pw) * .08)
- top: var(--photo-top, 0px)
- left: (100vw - var(--pw)) * .5293, so the helmet stays at 52.93% across
- width var(--pw), aspect-ratio 16/10
- horizontal mask: transparent, black at --fade, black until 100% - --fade, transparent
The video fills the plate: display block, width and height 100%, object-fit cover, object-position center center.

Grid
48 hairline columns over the whole hero, z-index -1, pointer-events none.
Each column is an empty <i>. A 2px line sits at left: calc(75% - .5px), full height, color var(--grid). The first line is at three quarters of a column (20px at 1280).
Mask the grid with radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 95% at 50% 62%, rgba(0,0,0,0.83) 0%, #000 100%) so the lines recede behind the subject and headline.

Top bar
Logo: an <a href="#" class="logo" aria-label="Atelier Unit — home"> containing an inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 142.60 30.00, shape-rendering geometricPrecision, fill var(--logo-ink, #ffffff). Seven white squares, each 8.2 × 8.2:
- 0.00, 0.00
- 19.20, 0.00
- 76.80, 0.00
- 115.20, 0.00
- 57.60, 10.90
- 134.40, 10.90
- 0.00, 21.80
Logo position: left 20.65 * --u, top 12.8 * --u, width max(142.60 * --u, 96px).

Small type: font-size var(--small), line-height 1, weight 400, margin 0. Default letter-spacing --ls is -0.051em. Apply -webkit-text-stroke 0.022em currentColor on .small and .actions.

Tagline, class "tagline small", three stacked spans, left at 100% * 386.5 / 1280, top 12.6 * --u:
1. "Craftwork and brand systems." --ls -0.045em
2. "Shaped by culture. Built with detail" --ls -0.051em
3. "and technology." --ls -0.045em

Contact is an <address class="contact small">, font-style normal, left at 100% * 798.5 / 1280, top 12.5 * --u:
- mailto:hello@atelierunit.com, text hello@atelierunit.com, --ls -0.047em
- "Milano, EST 2013", --ls -0.069em

Actions, right 32 * --u, top 13 * --u, flex, align center, gap 1.22em, font-size var(--small):
- button.lang, type button, aria-label "Language: English", text EN, --ls -0.064em, line-height 1, translate(0em, 0.139em), text-stroke width 0.01em
- button.menu, type button, aria-expanded false, text "Menu" inside a span, --ls -0.055em. The button is 6.349em wide, 1.508em tall, background #fcfcfc, color #141414, text-align left, padding-left 0.33em, line-height 1.508em. The span is translated 0 on Y. On hover-capable devices the background becomes #fff.

Services and rule
A ul.services.small, aria-label Services, no list style, absolute, full width, top 211.75 * --u. Font size max(var(--small-min) * 1.06, 13.3 * --u), line-height 1. Each li is absolute, nowrap, text-stroke width 0.008em, and the words sit in a span.rv:
1. "Brand Direction", left 20 * --u, --ls -0.047em
2. "Digital Products", left 50% - 3 * --u, translateX(-50%), --ls -0.0485em
3. "Advanced Tech", right 33.25 * --u, --ls -0.064em
A .rule div, aria-hidden, full width, top 239 * --u, height 1px, background var(--rule), z-index -1, box-shadow 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.038), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.014).

Headline
An h1.hl, aria-label "Craftwork, technology, design". Position absolute, left 50%, bottom 0.49140em, margin 0, width 0, height 0, font-size 170.94 * --u, weight 700, line-height 1, letter-spacing 0, nowrap.
Each line is a span.hl__line containing span.hl__clip containing span.hl__track containing one span per letter. Lines are aria-hidden because the h1 already has the accessible name.
Letter placement is in em. Each letter is position absolute, left var(--x), top -0.909em, transform-origin 0 0, and this exact transform:
translateY(calc(0.909em + var(--dy, 0em))) scale(var(--sx), var(--sy)) translateY(-0.909em) translateY(0.5445em) scaleY(var(--k, 1)) translateY(-0.5445em)

Line 1, CRAFTWORK, --b 1.56780em, --dy -0.00275em, --sy 1.0063
C -3.04844em sx 1.0769 k 1.0055
R -2.35055em sx 1.0093
A -1.68881em sx 1.0542
F -1.00202em sx 0.9712
T -0.41697em sx 0.9516
W 0.15715em sx 0.9612
O 1.01367em sx 0.9833 k 1.0055
R 1.69181em sx 1.0093
K 2.33501em sx 0.9371

Line 2, TECHNOLOGY, --b 0.78390em, --dy 0.00059em, --sy 0.9950
T -3.16648em sx 0.9516
E -2.64032em sx 0.9875
C -2.06523em sx 1.0678 k 1.0055
H -1.36691em sx 1.0031
N -0.71845em sx 1.0161
O -0.05103em sx 0.9833 k 1.0055
L 0.62228em sx 0.9965
O 1.14822em sx 0.9833 k 1.0055
G 1.85243em sx 1.0231 k 1.0055
Y 2.50618em sx 0.9953

Line 3, DESIGN, --b 0.00000em, --dy -0.00281em, --sy 0.9918
D -1.77928em sx 1.0751
E -1.09091em sx 0.9983
S -0.48284em sx 1.0123 k 1.0055
I 0.11501em sx 1.0530
G 0.32558em sx 1.0231 k 1.0055
N 1.03138em sx 1.0062

Responsive
Break on composition, not a generic device width.

When max-aspect-ratio is 114/100 (portrait-leaning tablets and phones):
- --small-min 12px
- --m clamp(16px, 3.2vw, 32px)
- --bar-top calc(var(--m) * .64)
- logo, tagline, contact, and actions use that top; logo left and actions right use --m
- photo width becomes var(--vh) * 138.6, top var(--vh) * 15, and the mask switches to a top fade: transparent 0, black at 11%
- services top is var(--vh) * 44; first label left --m, second left 50%, third right --m
- rule top is var(--vh) * 44 + 2.1em, font-size var(--small)
- headline font-size is (100vw - 2 * var(--m)) / 6.3063, bottom max(0.49140em, 18px + safe-area-inset-bottom)

When that aspect also has max-width 679px, move to two rows:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --bar-top includes safe-area-inset-top
- logo width 104px
- actions gap 14px
- tagline left --m, top 70px plus safe-area top, spans stay block
- contact right --m, same top, text-align right

When that aspect also has max-width 309px:
- contact drops to 70px + 3em + 12px plus safe-area top
- service labels may wrap, width min-content; center is centered, right is right-aligned
- photo top --ptop is the max of 15vh and the min of (150px + safe-area top) and (71vh minus the headline bottom offset minus 2.30em of headline size minus 56px), using --F = (100vw - 2 * --m) / 6.3063
- services top is --ptop + 29vh
- rule top is --ptop + 29vh + 3.1em

Landscape phones, max-height 479px and min-aspect-ratio 1141/1000, keep the desktop composition:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --mL max(16px, safe-area left), --mR max(16px, safe-area right)
- --bar-top 16px * .64
- logo left --mL
- tagline left is --mL + 96px + 2em
- contact is right-anchored at --mR + 8.83em + 2em
- actions right --mR
- services use the safe-area margins, with the center label centered in the remaining width
- headline is centered in that same safe width, bottom max(0.49140em, 8px + safe-area bottom)

If that landscape case is also under 560px wide, contact moves under the controls: right --mR, top --bar-top + 2.6em, text-align right.

On coarse pointers, enlarge hit areas without changing the drawn shapes. .lang, .menu, .logo, and the contact link get a centered ::after at least 44px tall. Lang extends 12px left and half the action gap right. Menu extends half the gap left and 10px right. Logo extends 10px each side. The mail link extends 6px each side, height max(100%, 32px).

Entrance, once on load
Before first paint, if motion is allowed, add class is-entering to the html element and set a 4500ms failsafe that removes is-entering and is-playing. If prefers-reduced-motion is reduce, skip the class. If JS never runs, the page is simply static.

The video and grid never animate. Only the foreground does, and only while html.is-entering is present. Animations start paused via --au-state:paused, then run when is-playing is added.
Easings:
- --e-expo: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)
- --e-quint: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)
- --e-sweep: cubic-bezier(.76, 0, .24, 1)

Keyframes:
- au-rise: translate from 0 var(--rise) to 0 0
- au-soft: that same rise plus opacity 0 to 1
- au-draw: scaleX 0 to 1
- au-wipe: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0)
- au-on: opacity 0 to 1

Timing:
- rule draws from the left, origin 0 50%, au-draw .85s --e-sweep, delay .24s
- each headline track rises 1em, au-rise 1.05s --e-expo; delays .10s, .18s, .26s. Clip is inset(-.8em -3.6em -.05em -3.6em)
- service labels rise by calc(100% + .6em), au-rise .8s --e-quint; delays .56s, .62s, .68s. Each li is clipped with inset(-.25em -.4em -.35em -.4em), and .rv is inline-block
- logo squares switch on in .14s ease-out. Delays by square order: 0.700s, 0.735s, 0.840s, 0.910s, 0.805s, 0.945s, 0.700s
- tagline lines, contact lines, and EN rise .55em with opacity, au-soft .75s --e-quint. Tagline delays .78s, .83s, .88s. Contact delays .88s, .93s. EN duration .6s, delay .98s
- Menu wipes open last, au-wipe .6s cubic-bezier(.25, 1, .5, 1), delay 1.02s
- will-change translate, transform on the headline tracks, rule, and service labels
- when motion is allowed, Menu background-color transitions in .15s

Playback script
After fonts are ready, or after 1200ms if they are not, add is-playing on the next frame. Wait for every animation whose name starts with "au-" to finish, and also set a 2200ms timeout. Then remove is-entering and is-playing and clear the failsafe so nothing keeps running. If reduced motion is set, remove autoplay from the hero video and pause it.

Do not add a menu panel, language menu, loader, footer, or extra copy. Menu and EN are visual controls only.

- --grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.0265)
- --menu-bg: #fcfcfc
- --menu-ink: #141414
- --small-min: 10px; at min-height 480px, --small-min becomes 11.28px
- --u: min(100vw / 1280, var(--vh) * 100 / 800)
- --small: max(var(--small-min), 12.6 * var(--u))
Heights map 1:1 to the screen. Extra width is absorbed by edge-anchored elements and the extended backdrop. Box-sizing border-box on everything.

Stage
.hero is position relative, isolation isolate, overflow hidden, width 100%, height 100vh and 100dvh, min-height 320px.
Its background is this exact vertical gradient:
linear-gradient(180deg, #0d0905 0%, #0f0a05 15%, #0d0a05 30%, #0d0905 45%, #0e0a06 60%, #0f0c07 75%, #130e08 90%, #130e09 100%)

Background video
Use this CloudFront URL and no other asset, local or remote:
https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_143740_52dbf3ef-ea20-4594-a1ad-91d6c2970159.mp4
It is a muted, looping, autoplaying, playsinline video of a figure seen from behind in a dark coat and a polished black mirrored helmet, with a thin amber arc behind the shoulders and low haze. Do not replace it with an image.

.hero__photo is role="presentation", position absolute, z-index -3.
- --pw: max(min(100vw, 1536 * var(--u)), var(--vh) * 160)
- --fade: clamp(0px, 100vw - var(--pw), var(--pw) * .08)
- top: var(--photo-top, 0px)
- left: (100vw - var(--pw)) * .5293, so the helmet stays at 52.93% across
- width var(--pw), aspect-ratio 16/10
- horizontal mask: transparent, black at --fade, black until 100% - --fade, transparent
The video fills the plate: display block, width and height 100%, object-fit cover, object-position center center.

Grid
48 hairline columns over the whole hero, z-index -1, pointer-events none.
Each column is an empty <i>. A 2px line sits at left: calc(75% - .5px), full height, color var(--grid). The first line is at three quarters of a column (20px at 1280).
Mask the grid with radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 95% at 50% 62%, rgba(0,0,0,0.83) 0%, #000 100%) so the lines recede behind the subject and headline.

Top bar
Logo: an <a href="#" class="logo" aria-label="Atelier Unit — home"> containing an inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 142.60 30.00, shape-rendering geometricPrecision, fill var(--logo-ink, #ffffff). Seven white squares, each 8.2 × 8.2:
- 0.00, 0.00
- 19.20, 0.00
- 76.80, 0.00
- 115.20, 0.00
- 57.60, 10.90
- 134.40, 10.90
- 0.00, 21.80
Logo position: left 20.65 * --u, top 12.8 * --u, width max(142.60 * --u, 96px).

Small type: font-size var(--small), line-height 1, weight 400, margin 0. Default letter-spacing --ls is -0.051em. Apply -webkit-text-stroke 0.022em currentColor on .small and .actions.

Tagline, class "tagline small", three stacked spans, left at 100% * 386.5 / 1280, top 12.6 * --u:
1. "Craftwork and brand systems." --ls -0.045em
2. "Shaped by culture. Built with detail" --ls -0.051em
3. "and technology." --ls -0.045em

Contact is an <address class="contact small">, font-style normal, left at 100% * 798.5 / 1280, top 12.5 * --u:
- mailto:hello@atelierunit.com, text hello@atelierunit.com, --ls -0.047em
- "Milano, EST 2013", --ls -0.069em

Actions, right 32 * --u, top 13 * --u, flex, align center, gap 1.22em, font-size var(--small):
- button.lang, type button, aria-label "Language: English", text EN, --ls -0.064em, line-height 1, translate(0em, 0.139em), text-stroke width 0.01em
- button.menu, type button, aria-expanded false, text "Menu" inside a span, --ls -0.055em. The button is 6.349em wide, 1.508em tall, background #fcfcfc, color #141414, text-align left, padding-left 0.33em, line-height 1.508em. The span is translated 0 on Y. On hover-capable devices the background becomes #fff.

Services and rule
A ul.services.small, aria-label Services, no list style, absolute, full width, top 211.75 * --u. Font size max(var(--small-min) * 1.06, 13.3 * --u), line-height 1. Each li is absolute, nowrap, text-stroke width 0.008em, and the words sit in a span.rv:
1. "Brand Direction", left 20 * --u, --ls -0.047em
2. "Digital Products", left 50% - 3 * --u, translateX(-50%), --ls -0.0485em
3. "Advanced Tech", right 33.25 * --u, --ls -0.064em
A .rule div, aria-hidden, full width, top 239 * --u, height 1px, background var(--rule), z-index -1, box-shadow 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.038), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.014).

Headline
An h1.hl, aria-label "Craftwork, technology, design". Position absolute, left 50%, bottom 0.49140em, margin 0, width 0, height 0, font-size 170.94 * --u, weight 700, line-height 1, letter-spacing 0, nowrap.
Each line is a span.hl__line containing span.hl__clip containing span.hl__track containing one span per letter. Lines are aria-hidden because the h1 already has the accessible name.
Letter placement is in em. Each letter is position absolute, left var(--x), top -0.909em, transform-origin 0 0, and this exact transform:
translateY(calc(0.909em + var(--dy, 0em))) scale(var(--sx), var(--sy)) translateY(-0.909em) translateY(0.5445em) scaleY(var(--k, 1)) translateY(-0.5445em)

Line 1, CRAFTWORK, --b 1.56780em, --dy -0.00275em, --sy 1.0063

R -2.35055em sx 1.0093

W 0.15715em sx 0.9612
O 1.01367em sx 0.9833 k 1.0055
R 1.69181em sx 1.0093
K 2.33501em sx 0.9371

Line 2, TECHNOLOGY, --b 0.78390em, --dy 0.00059em, --sy 0.9950
T -3.16648em sx 0.9516
E -2.64032em sx 0.9875
C -2.06523em sx 1.0678 k 1.0055

O -0.05103em sx 0.9833 k 1.0055
L 0.62228em sx 0.9965
O 1.14822em sx 0.9833 k 1.0055
G 1.85243em sx 1.0231 k 1.0055
Y 2.50618em sx 0.9953

Line 3, DESIGN, --b 0.00000em, --dy -0.00281em, --sy 0.9918
D -1.77928em sx 1.0751
E -1.09091em sx 0.9983
S -0.48284em sx 1.0123 k 1.0055
I 0.11501em sx 1.0530
G 0.32558em sx 1.0231 k 1.0055
N 1.03138em sx 1.0062

Responsive
Break on composition, not a generic device width.

When max-aspect-ratio is 114/100 (portrait-leaning tablets and phones):
- --small-min 12px
- --m clamp(16px, 3.2vw, 32px)
- --bar-top calc(var(--m) * .64)
- logo, tagline, contact, and actions use that top; logo left and actions right use --m
- photo width becomes var(--vh) * 138.6, top var(--vh) * 15, and the mask switches to a top fade: transparent 0, black at 11%
- services top is var(--vh) * 44; first label left --m, second left 50%, third right --m
- rule top is var(--vh) * 44 + 2.1em, font-size var(--small)
- headline font-size is (100vw - 2 * var(--m)) / 6.3063, bottom max(0.49140em, 18px + safe-area-inset-bottom)

When that aspect also has max-width 679px, move to two rows:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --bar-top includes safe-area-inset-top
- logo width 104px
- actions gap 14px
- tagline left --m, top 70px plus safe-area top, spans stay block
- contact right --m, same top, text-align right

When that aspect also has max-width 309px:
- contact drops to 70px + 3em + 12px plus safe-area top
- service labels may wrap, width min-content; center is centered, right is right-aligned
- photo top --ptop is the max of 15vh and the min of (150px + safe-area top) and (71vh minus the headline bottom offset minus 2.30em of headline size minus 56px), using --F = (100vw - 2 * --m) / 6.3063
- services top is --ptop + 29vh
- rule top is --ptop + 29vh + 3.1em

Landscape phones, max-height 479px and min-aspect-ratio 1141/1000, keep the desktop composition:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --mL max(16px, safe-area left), --mR max(16px, safe-area right)
- --bar-top 16px * .64
- logo left --mL
- tagline left is --mL + 96px + 2em
- contact is right-anchored at --mR + 8.83em + 2em
- actions right --mR
- services use the safe-area margins, with the center label centered in the remaining width
- headline is centered in that same safe width, bottom max(0.49140em, 8px + safe-area bottom)

If that landscape case is also under 560px wide, contact moves under the controls: right --mR, top --bar-top + 2.6em, text-align right.

On coarse pointers, enlarge hit areas without changing the drawn shapes. .lang, .menu, .logo, and the contact link get a centered ::after at least 44px tall. Lang extends 12px left and half the action gap right. Menu extends half the gap left and 10px right. Logo extends 10px each side. The mail link extends 6px each side, height max(100%, 32px).

Entrance, once on load
Before first paint, if motion is allowed, add class is-entering to the html element and set a 4500ms failsafe that removes is-entering and is-playing. If prefers-reduced-motion is reduce, skip the class. If JS never runs, the page is simply static.

The video and grid never animate. Only the foreground does, and only while html.is-entering is present. Animations start paused via --au-state:paused, then run when is-playing is added.
Easings:
- --e-expo: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)
- --e-quint: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)
- --e-sweep: cubic-bezier(.76, 0, .24, 1)

Keyframes:
- au-rise: translate from 0 var(--rise) to 0 0
- au-soft: that same rise plus opacity 0 to 1
- au-draw: scaleX 0 to 1
- au-wipe: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0)
- au-on: opacity 0 to 1

Timing:
- rule draws from the left, origin 0 50%, au-draw .85s --e-sweep, delay .24s
- each headline track rises 1em, au-rise 1.05s --e-expo; delays .10s, .18s, .26s. Clip is inset(-.8em -3.6em -.05em -3.6em)
- service labels rise by calc(100% + .6em), au-rise .8s --e-quint; delays .56s, .62s, .68s. Each li is clipped with inset(-.25em -.4em -.35em -.4em), and .rv is inline-block
- logo squares switch on in .14s ease-out. Delays by square order: 0.700s, 0.735s, 0.840s, 0.910s, 0.805s, 0.945s, 0.700s
- tagline lines, contact lines, and EN rise .55em with opacity, au-soft .75s --e-quint. Tagline delays .78s, .83s, .88s. Contact delays .88s, .93s. EN duration .6s, delay .98s
- Menu wipes open last, au-wipe .6s cubic-bezier(.25, 1, .5, 1), delay 1.02s
- will-change translate, transform on the headline tracks, rule, and service labels
- when motion is allowed, Menu background-color transitions in .15s

Playback script
After fonts are ready, or after 1200ms if they are not, add is-playing on the next frame. Wait for every animation whose name starts with "au-" to finish, and also set a 2200ms timeout. Then remove is-entering and is-playing and clear the failsafe so nothing keeps running. If reduced motion is set, remove autoplay from the hero video and pause it.

Do not add a menu panel, language menu, loader, footer, or extra copy. Menu and EN are visual controls only.

items.title: Atrium MTL
items.prompt_text:
Build ONE self-contained file: index.html — no build step, no npm, no React/Vue, no external CSS/JS libraries. Everything in a single document: inline <style>, inline SVG icons, vanilla JavaScript only. Page title: "ATRIUM MTL — An archive of light cast in stone". Viewport meta: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover.

IMPORTANT — MEDIA: There is NO <video> element and NO CloudFront video URL on this page. The right-hand mosaic uses four CloudFront WEBP photos + one CloudFront SVG grain texture (listed below). Continuous motion is pure CSS @keyframes on columns (14.6s loop), timed to match a reference recording (0.342 card-heights per second). Do not embed or link any video file.

Use these EXACT remote asset URLs in :root (do not substitute local paths for images/grain):

--img-sculpt: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fc524fc3-03c3-40a1-9954-22eab1322592.webp)
--img-man: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/1d56967e-0ed5-40f8-812d-9360e5ec1780.webp)
--img-visit: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5f3f6135-26b9-4c48-92ad-105161327cbc.webp)
--img-sil: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e7b68ae9-9240-4f52-a0a2-89082df4b8d0.webp)
--grain: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/40b7fef3-410d-4ef3-bd67-0a2fc7ee5a1d.svg)

FONTS — self-hosted @font-face (required for pixel match):
@font-face Archivo: weight 100–900, font-stretch 62%–125%, woff2 at assets/fonts/archivo.woff2
@font-face Inter: weight 100–900, woff2 at assets/fonts/inter.woff2
--display: "Archivo","Arial Black",Impact,system-ui,sans-serif
--sans: "Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif
font-display: block on both. Body uses --sans with antialiased/geometricPrecision.

DESIGN TOKENS (:root):
--paper #f5f4ef (page bg)
--ink #0f0f0e
--card-dark #151515, --card-cream #f9f6f1
--red #ef5d44, --yellow #fcdd71, --blue #9fd5f7
White header theme: --nav-bg/#ffffff, --nav-bar/#ffffff, --nav-fg/--ink, --nav-muted #62615d, --nav-line rgba(15,15,14,.08), --nav-rule rgba(15,15,14,.16), --nav-search #e8e7e2, --nav-cta var(--ink), --nav-cta-fg #fff
Grid desktop tokens: --col 205.33px, --gap 13px, --pitch 282.5px, --r 22px

OVERALL LAYOUT (editorial museum / brutalist archive):
Warm off-white full viewport. Floating white header card (rounded bottom corners 22px, subtle border + shadow). Left: oversized uppercase headline + body + CTAs. Right: 3-column staggered mosaic of rounded tiles (photos + solid color blocks) scrolling vertically forever; grid sits under header z-index. No page scroll on desktop/tablet/mobile — viewport-locked compositions using 100svh and overflow:hidden where specified.

DOM STRUCTURE (inside .stage):
1) .grid[aria-hidden=true] — 6 columns (.col): optional wide-screen .x3,.x2,.x1 (hidden by default) + main .c1,.c2,.c3. Each column has exactly 5 .cell children in this order:

x3: i-man, blue, dark, i-sculpt, yellow
x2: yellow, i-sil, cream, red, i-visit
x1: blue, i-man, red, i-sculpt, cream
c1: red, i-sculpt f-sculpt, i-man f-man, blue, i-visit
c2: yellow, i-visit f-visit visit, dark, i-sil, red
c3: blue, cream, i-sil f-sil, yellow, i-sculpt

Photo cells: .ph + .i-sculpt|.i-man|.i-visit|.i-sil — image via ::before { background: var(--pic) } where --pic maps to --img-* custom properties.
Solid cells: .red, .yellow, .blue, .cream (inset 1px #e9e6df), .dark (inset 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14)).
Grain overlay on solid tiles: ::after with background-image var(--grain), opacity .13 multiply; .dark ::after screen .035.

NUMERIC PHOTO CROPS (desktop hero tiles — ::before on .f-*):
.f-sculpt: width 124.19%, height 112.57%, left -16.07%, top -8.5%, background-size 100% 100%
.f-man: 113.48%, 103.36%, -5.36%, -3.54%
.f-visit: 110.07%, 100%, -3.9%, 8.5%; tile bg linear-gradient(90deg,#c6c5c3,#9b9a98 55%,#7a7977); ::after top fade rgba(0,0,0,.26)→0 at 13%
.f-sil: 139.29%, 126.37%, -8.77%, -56.64%
Mobile: .f-visit and .f-sil fall back to cover; .f-visit ::after hidden on mob.

COLUMN MARQUEE (CSS):
@keyframes colDown: translate3d 0→-50%; colUp: -50%→0
Default .col: colDown 14.6s linear infinite
.c2, .x1, .x3: colUp
.c1 left 0 top 86px; .c2 left calc(col+gap) top -11.5px; .c3 left calc(2*(col+gap)) top 86.5px
Extra cols: x1/x2/x3 at negative left offsets; display:none until html.desk.ex1|ex2|ex3
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .col animation none }

JS clones each column’s 5 cells once (duplicate appendChild) so 50% translate loops seamlessly.

DESKTOP MODE (html.desk):
Reference canvas 1280×800. .stage fixed, transform scale(--s) from origin 0 0, width calc(var(--W)*1px), height calc(var(--H)*1px).
--s = cover viewport: if vw/vh > 1280/800 then vh/800 else vw/1280 (no letterboxing).
--W = vw/s, --H = vh/s. class .tall if vh/s > 845.
Extra columns: extra = clamp(0..3, floor((vw/s - 1294)/218.33)); add ex1/ex2/ex3.
.grid: absolute right 62px top 0 bottom 0 width calc(3*col + 2*gap).

HEADER (desktop absolute positions — white theme):
.hdr: left/right 40px, height 142px, z-index 5, radius 0 0 22px 22px, shadow 0 0 0 1px nav-line, 0 16px 36px -24px rgba(15,15,14,.30)
Utility strip .util height 40px, border-bottom nav-line:
  Phone p1 tel:+14188386000 — "House of Brutalism : 418" line break "838-6000" (16px phone SVG)
  Vertical rule at 313px
  Phone p2 tel:+14188386001 — "Studio Exhibitions : 418" / "838-6001"
  .unav links (14px, weight 500): Programmes, Events, Photo-prints (two-line), Visits, Help preserve (two-line); search button 39×39 #e8e7e2, radius 5px 0 0 5px, magnifier SVG 13×13
Main row:
  Logo: ATRIUM MTL (Archivo 900, 31px, stretch 85%, stroke .35px) + small "AN ARCHIVE OF LIGHT CAST IN STONE" (8.6px, muted)
  Nav: Installations + 24px black circle arrow; separator; Interviews; Photographs; Menu burger + label
  CTA: black pill "Tickets" 116×63 radius 22px + 64×64 circle ticket SVG (rotated -45°)

HERO (desktop):
left 86px, top calc(200px + (var(--H,800)-800)*0.5px), width 480px
h1 four lines (each .ln inside span): "An archive" / "of light" / "cast in" / "stone"
Typography: Archivo 900, 80px, line-height 75.3px, letter-spacing -.06em, uppercase, stroke 1.1px; spans .95em, letter-spacing -.05em
p at top 344px, 460px wide, 18px/26.6px: "ATRIUM MTL archives old structures as raw photographs from across Montreal, a collection at an **Annual Photography Retrospective**, autumn 2026."
.acts at top 460px: Tickets pill + ticket circle + "Installations" bold link with 32px arrow circle (same ticket SVG style)

RESPONSIVE MODES — CSS-only --mode on :root, JS mirrors class on <html>:
Default --mode:mob
mob-l: min-width 560px AND aspect-ratio ≥ 1/1
tab-p: min-width 600px, min-height 820px, max-aspect-ratio 21/20

sections.content:

Viewport meta: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover.

IMPORTANT — MEDIA: There is NO <video> element and NO CloudFront video URL on this page. The right-hand mosaic uses four CloudFront WEBP photos + one CloudFront SVG grain texture (listed below). Continuous motion is pure CSS @keyframes on columns (14.6s loop), timed to match a reference recording (0.342 card-heights per second). Do not embed or link any video file.

Use these EXACT remote asset URLs in :root (do not substitute local paths for images/grain):

--img-sculpt: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fc524fc3-03c3-40a1-9954-22eab1322592.webp)
--img-man: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/1d56967e-0ed5-40f8-812d-9360e5ec1780.webp)
--img-visit: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5f3f6135-26b9-4c48-92ad-105161327cbc.webp)

@font-face Archivo: weight 100–900, font-stretch 62%–125%, woff2 at assets/fonts/archivo.woff2
@font-face Inter: weight 100–900, woff2 at assets/fonts/inter.woff2

DOM STRUCTURE (inside .stage):
1) .grid[aria-hidden=true] — 6 columns (.col): optional wide-screen .x3,.x2,.x1 (hidden by default) + main .c1,.c2,.c3. Each column has exactly 5 .cell children in this order:

x3: i-man, blue, dark, i-sculpt, yellow
x2: yellow, i-sil, cream, red, i-visit
x1: blue, i-man, red, i-sculpt, cream
c1: red, i-sculpt f-sculpt, i-man f-man, blue, i-visit
c2: yellow, i-visit f-visit visit, dark, i-sil, red
c3: blue, cream, i-sil f-sil, yellow, i-sculpt

Photo cells: .ph + .i-sculpt|.i-man|.i-visit|.i-sil — image via ::before { background: var(--pic) } where --pic maps to --img-* custom properties.
Solid cells: .red, .yellow, .blue, .cream (inset 1px #e9e6df), .dark (inset 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14)).
Grain overlay on solid tiles: ::after with background-image var(--grain), opacity .13 multiply; .dark ::after screen .035.

NUMERIC PHOTO CROPS (desktop hero tiles — ::before on .f-*):
.f-sculpt: width 124.19%, height 112.57%, left -16.07%, top -8.5%, background-size 100% 100%
.f-man: 113.48%, 103.36%, -5.36%, -3.54%
.f-visit: 110.07%, 100%, -3.9%, 8.5%; tile bg linear-gradient(90deg,#c6c5c3,#9b9a98 55%,#7a7977); ::after top fade rgba(0,0,0,.26)→0 at 13%
.f-sil: 139.29%, 126.37%, -8.77%, -56.64%
Mobile: .f-visit and .f-sil fall back to cover; .f-visit ::after hidden on mob.

COLUMN MARQUEE (CSS):
@keyframes colDown: translate3d 0→-50%; colUp: -50%→0
Default .col: colDown 14.6s linear infinite
.c2, .x1, .x3: colUp
.c1 left 0 top 86px; .c2 left calc(col+gap) top -11.5px; .c3 left calc(2*(col+gap)) top 86.5px
Extra cols: x1/x2/x3 at negative left offsets; display:none until html.desk.ex1|ex2|ex3
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .col animation none }

Reference canvas 1280×800. .stage fixed, transform scale(--s) from origin 0 0, width calc(var(--W)*1px), height calc(var(--H)*1px).

--W = vw/s, --H = vh/s. class .tall if vh/s > 845.
Extra columns: extra = clamp(0..3, floor((vw/s - 1294)/218.33)); add ex1/ex2/ex3.

Typography: Archivo 900, 80px, line-height 75.3px, letter-spacing -.06em, uppercase, stroke 1.1px; spans .95em, letter-spacing -.05em

items.title: Riverine
items.prompt_text:
Build one standalone HTML file, index.html, that is a full-viewport hero section and nothing else. Output the file exactly as specified below. Do not redesign, rename, restyle, or omit any element, rule, or script. One page, no framework, no external CSS or JS. The background must be this remote video URL only — do not download it and do not use a local image or video:

https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_182346_a590ff3b-72e5-41ce-8f69-a8c823eaecaa.mp4

<video autoplay muted loop playsinline>, object-fit cover, pointer-events none. Three shade overlays sit on top of the video. The page background is #03080B. The stage is exactly 100dvh, overflow hidden, no letterboxing.

Fonts, declared with @font-face and these exact stacks:
- "RV Display" weight 300 from assets/fonts/rv-display.woff2, fallback "Poppins", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif. Used for the headline.
- "RV Brand" weight 600 from assets/fonts/rv-brand.woff2, fallback "Urbanist", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif. Used for "riverine.ai".
- "RV Text" weight 400 from assets/fonts/rv-text.woff2, fallback "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif. Used for nav, lede, buttons, and the scroll cue.
font-display: block. If the woff2 files are not available, keep the @font-face rules and the fallback stacks exactly; do not substitute other typefaces.

All layout is measured from a 1280×960 reference through one unit:
--u: max(0.62px, min(100vw/1280, 100dvh/960)).
Colors: shade 3,8,11; ink #F5FAF6; ink-2 #ECF1EF; teal #88DECC; icon teal #7EC4B5; chevron #7CCBBA; moth #315352; cream pills #EEF1EA; pine discs #122B2A; logo disc #030909.

Desktop composition, positions in --u:
- Top left: a 104×46 glass pill (rgba(150,220,130,.035), blur 12). Inside it, a 46px disc containing a teal delta-tree drawn as seven strokes, and to its right a mirrored moth in #315352.
- Top right of center: a black 442×47 pill. Links, absolutely placed: Work, Regenerate (current, with a small chevron), Nature, Earth, News. Then a cream "Partner" pill with a dark disc and a white right chevron.
- Far top right: a 48px blurred dark circle, speaker icon, aria-label "Ambient river sound", aria-pressed true. Clicking toggles aria-pressed; when false the two sound waves drop to opacity .25. No audio file.
- Bottom left hero: "riverine.ai" in teal; headline on three lines, "Where" / "Regeneration Fuels" / "Future Thinking", light weight, nowrap, per-line letter-spacing; lede on two lines, "Living waterways reveal a hidden logic of renewal" and "Nature's patterns guide more caring AI".
- Actions: cream pill "Shape our Future" linking to #future, with a dark disc and white chevron; text link "Discover the Rivers" linking to #rivers.
- Bottom right: "Scroll for Details" linking to #details, with a teal chevron.
- Nav hrefs: #work, #regenerate, #nature, #earth, #news, #partner. Logo links to # and is labeled "riverine.ai home".
- Hover: text links and the cue turn #88DECC; the Partner and CTA discs turn #26504d.
- Focus-visible: 2px teal outline.

Shade layers, desktop:
- Horizontal gradient, left to right, shade alpha .683, .595, .458, .221, .039, .054 at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100%.
- Vertical gradient, top to bottom, shade alpha .060, .023, .152, .300, .394, .632 at those same stops.
- Bottom-left radial ellipse 93.8% by 41.3% at 0% 100%, shade from 1 to 0.
Video object-position 50% 40%. At min-aspect-ratio 16/9, object-position 50% 24%.

Responsive, components keep desktop proportions and only placement changes:
- At max-width 649.98px or max-height 500px: --u is clamp(0.94px, 100vw/390, 1.2px); gutter clamp(18px, 5.6vw, 32px). Video object-position 63% 50%. Softer left shade and a stronger bottom shade; the corner radial is removed. Headline tracking switches to em values. Actions wrap. Touch padding on the text link and cue.
- At max-width 649.98px only: hide the nav pill. Header is logo, then a 48px black menu button, then the sound button. The menu button is three bars that become an X when aria-expanded is true. The nav becomes a black rounded panel under the header, hidden until .is-open. Links stack at 48px tall, 17px type. Partner sits under the links. Hero is inset by the gutter and sits above the scroll cue, which stays bottom-right. Title size is min(clamp(32px, 10.4vw, 60px), (100vw - 2 gutters) / 8.7). Honor safe-area insets.
- Menu behavior: click toggles the panel; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button; a click outside closes it; choosing a link closes it; when opened, focus the first link.
- Short landscape phones, max-height 500px and min-aspect-ratio 1/1: --u is clamp(0.82px, 100dvh/415, 0.94px). Keep the desktop nav when the screen is at least 650px wide. Hero stays bottom-left, title clamp(28px, 10dvh, 44px), actions do not wrap. Video object-position 50% 30%. Below 650px wide in that short landscape, the open menu is a two-column grid.
- Tablets, 650–1100px wide and at least 501px tall, and portrait screens at least 650px wide with max-aspect-ratio 4/5 and min-height 501px: stop shrinking and pin --u to 0.94px so type and the nav stay touch-safe. On the portrait case, scale the hero and cue by 1.1 and set video object-position to 58% 50%.
- prefers-reduced-motion: no transitions or animations, and skip the entrance.

Entrance, one pass after fonts are ready and the video has loaded data. If reduced motion is set, show the finished page immediately. A 3.5s failsafe removes the hidden state. While waiting, logo, nav, sound, menu, brand, title, lede, actions, and cue are opacity 0.
Timeline, using the Web Animations API with fill backwards, then remove the classes so no inline style remains:

items.title: Anveril
items.prompt_text:
Build one standalone file, index.html, that reproduces the Novaryn homepage section exactly. Output only that file. Do not redesign, restyle, rename classes, rewrite copy, swap the video, add sections, or simplify the motion. Keep every measurement, color, selector, keyframe, delay, easing, and script behavior below.

Page
- Title: Novaryn — Acceleration Through Vision™
- Language: en
- Viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover
- One screen on desktop: a top editorial band plus a video stage that fills the remaining height. The video is flush to the bottom of the viewport. Side inset is 20 design units. Top corners of the video are slightly rounded; bottom corners are square.
- Background of the page: #f7f8f3. Text and logo: #25251d.
- Font: @font-face family "Novaryn Sans", src url(assets/novaryn-sans.ttf) format("truetype"), font-weight 300 900, font-display block. Body stack: "Novaryn Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif. Antialiased, geometricPrecision.
- Design unit --u is min(100vw / 1280, 100svh / 800), with 1vh as the fallback where svh is unsupported. Desktop positions are absolute and sized in --u against a 1280×800 reference. The top band is 345u tall.

Desktop composition, all positions absolute inside .top unless noted
- A 4u-wide vertical hairline sits on the horizontal center, full band height. Gradient left to right: #f5f6f1 0–25%, #f3f4ef 25–75%, #f5f6f1 75–100%.
- Logo, top-left, 20u from the left and 21u from the top, z-index 90. Mark is an inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 39 26, two filled paths: "M0 26V0h6.9l18.2 17.2V0H32v26h-6.6L6.9 8.7V26Z" and "M34 20h5v6h-5Z". Word "Novaryn" at 34.5u, weight 350, line-height 1, letter-spacing -0.003em. A 6.4u four-point star sits as the registered mark: path "M5 0 6.25 3.75 10 5 6.25 6.25 5 10 3.75 6.25 0 5 3.75 3.75Z". Link aria-label "Novaryn home", href "#".
- Menu button, top-right, 20u from the right and top, height 35u, gap 16.5u, no background or border, font inherited. Label is a two-layer stack: "Menu" and "Close". Icon is a 36u SVG, viewBox -18 -18 36 36, nine dots of radius 2.3 on a circle (angles every 45°, radius 15) plus a center dot radius 2.45. A CSS X is hidden until open. Button aria-label "Open navigation menu", aria-controls "site-menu", aria-expanded false.
- Pill "See Further", href "#contact", id contact. Dark #25251d, fully rounded, text #edefe8, weight 350, size max(12px, 16.5u), letter-spacing -0.02em. Position right 20u, top 144.5u, height 41u, padding 4u 19.5u 0 20.8u.
- Headline, left 20u, top 207.6u, size 62.14u, weight 450, letter-spacing -0.015em, line-height 60u, nowrap. Two lines: "Acceleration" then "Through Vision" with a ™ at 0.83em, raised -6.3u, margin-left 2.1u. id vision.
- Lead, right 20u, top 228u, width 520u, padding-left 21u, size max(13px, 20.5u), weight 400, letter-spacing 0.004em, line-height 1.3171. A 2.4u rule, minimum 1.5px, color #1c1c1c, sits on the left of the paragraph. Three nowrap lines, exactly: "We imagine with pathfinders to discover frontiers" / "unfold worlds and shape technologies beyond physical" / "boundaries." id systems.

Video stage
- main.media, id research, flex 1, min-height 0, margin 0 20u, border-radius 5u 5u 0 0, overflow hidden, isolation isolate.
- Fallback fill: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 52% 45%, #334a5f 0%, #142333 48%, #05090f 100%).
- The only media is this video, id hero, autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline, preload auto, object-fit cover, object-position 50% 45%, inset 0. Aria-label: "Photonic lens focusing neural light into a violet beam". Use this exact src and no local video or poster:
  https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_183134_2d4380fd-64a0-459c-a1eb-add70a3e1a7b.mp4
- If prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove autoplay and pause the video.
- News bar over the video, centered, bottom 30u, width 800u, min-height 56u, radius 2u, padding 8u 8u 8u 20u, background rgba(189,191,177,0.985), backdrop-filter blur(24px) saturate(1.1). Copy: "Novaryn presents the blueprint for the next era of AI infrastructure." Weight 350, size max(12px, 17.5u), letter-spacing -0.02em. Pill "View Next", href "#", width 118u, height 40u, text #d2d3c7, size max(12px, 16.75u).

Entrance, once, only when reduced motion is off
- Before first paint add class motion-pending on html. Remove it after the sequence, with a 3000ms fallback.
- While pending, hide the divider (scaleY 0 from the top), logo, menu, CTA, lead, and news. Logo and menu start 8px up. CTA and lead start 10px down. Each headline line starts clipped from the bottom and 0.72em down. News starts translated 10px down and scaled 0.96 on X.
- Then Web Animations, fill both, then cancel and clear the class:
  divider 820ms delay 20ms, easing cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), scaleY 0 to 1
  logo 560ms delay 90ms, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
  menu 520ms delay 170ms, same settle easing
  "Acceleration" 790ms delay 250ms, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), clip-path reveal upward
  "Through Vision™" 840ms delay 360ms, same reveal
  lead 620ms delay 570ms, settle
  See Further 520ms delay 730ms, from translateY(10px) scale(.985)
  news 720ms delay 920ms, reveal easing, from translate 0 10px and scale .96 1
- The video does not enter. It is already the stage.

Orbit menu
- Accent #7b3cff. Opening adds html.menu-open and locks overflow. The wash is rgba(247,248,243,.90) with blur(16px) saturate(.9), and expands as a circle from the menu glyph: clip-path from circle(0) to circle(radius) over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.62,0,.18,1). Closing reverses over 1s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.25,1) with a 250ms delay, then visibility hidden after 1.3s.
- "Menu" slides up and "Close" slides in, 800ms cubic-bezier(.65,0,.2,1). The dot icon fades out immediately. The X rotates from -90deg scale(.3) to 0 scale(1), delayed 450ms, 900ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).
- Six destinations, angles and notes:
  01 About, 315°, "Who we are", #top
  02 Vision, 45°, "Why we exist", #vision
  03 Systems, 90°, "What we shape", #systems
  04 Research, 135°, "How we learn", #research
  05 Journal, 225°, "Notes from the frontier", #research
  06 Contact, 270°, "Begin together", #contact
- Also draw non-link dots at 0°, 180°, and the center. Center radius collapses to 0 once html.menu-settled, 1700ms after open (0ms if reduced motion).
- Desktop: dots leave the glyph and land on a circle centered at 50% width and 50% height + 18px. Radius is max(110, min(20% of width, 37% of (height − 190))). Active dots are 14px, idle dots 7px, center 12px. Spokes draw outward in ink at 50% opacity and inward in accent. Labels sit past the outer spoke, weight 350, letter-spacing -0.025em, size clamp from about 22px to 40px. Numbers are 11px, weight 500, tracking 0.08em. Labels blur in from 8px and travel along their angle, staggered from 0.95s by 0.06s per item.
- Hover or focus a destination: that label and its dot turn accent, the dot scales to 1.5, both spokes turn accent and the inward spoke scales to full length, everything else drops to about 38% opacity. Caption at the lower left changes from "Index / 06 destinations" / "Hover a point to preview" to "Index / 0N — 06" and that item's note. Caption is 12px, index 10px uppercase tracking 0.14em, fading in at 1.2s.
- A circular preview sits in the middle, diameter 1.24× the orbit radius, background #e9eae3, clip-path circle opening at 1.05s. Images, in order, cover the circle and crossfade: assets/menu-about.webp, assets/menu-vision.webp, assets/menu-systems.webp, assets/menu-research.webp, assets/menu-journal.webp, assets/menu-contact.webp. About is visible first.
- Click the wash, the logo, a destination, or press Escape to close. Tab cycles the trigger and the six links. Resize recomputes the orbit. Logo and menu stay above the wash (z-index 90; menu overlay z-index 50). On tablet and below, html.menu-open .top uses isolation auto so the logo and trigger stay above the wash.
- Below 680px the preview, spokes, and caption are hidden. Links stack in a left column from the glyph: order 0°, 315°, 45°, 90°, 135°, 225°, 270°, 180°, center. Titles use clamp(25px, 8vw, 34px).

Responsive, desktop rules stay untouched above these breakpoints
- Apply the tablet rewrite at max-width 959.98px, or max-height 599.98px, or portrait. --u becomes clamp(0.85px, 100vw / 1280, 1px). Body overflow visible. Page height auto with min-height 100dvh. Outer margin --gx clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 28px). Column gap --gc clamp(40px, 6.5vw, 72px).
- The band becomes a 2-column grid: logo | menu, empty | See Further, headline | lead. Min-height 36svh. Headline size clamp(34px, (50vw − gx − gc/2) / 7.3, 96px), line-height 0.9655. Lead wraps, size clamp(16px, 0.55vw + 12px, 19px), line-height 1.42, max-width 30em. Video min-height max(300px, 50svh). News width min(800u, 100% − 2gx). Enlarge hit areas with a -6px pseudo inset, not the drawn size.
- At max-width 679.98px, gx is 20px. Grid becomes logo | menu, headline full width, lead full width, then See Further on the right. Band min-height 44svh. Headline clamp(32px, (100vw − 40px) / 7.3, 54px). Lead 16.5px, max-width 32em. Video min-height max(300px, 46svh). News is inset 12px on the left, right, and bottom, width auto, padding 10px 8px 10px 14px, gap 12px.
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables transitions and animations. Focus-visible is a 2px ink outline, offset 3px, accent when inside the menu.

Implement this as one HTML document with the CSS and the three scripts inline: the pre-paint motion class, the entrance timeline, the reduced-motion video pause, and the orbit layout and interaction. Preserve the exact copy, SVG paths, CloudFront URL, asset paths, timings, and breakpoints.

- Logo, top-left, 20u from the left and 21u from the top, z-index 90. Mark is an inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 39 26, two filled paths: "M0 26V0h6.9l18.2 17.2V0H32v26h-6.6L6.9 8.7V26Z" and "M34 20h5v6h-5Z". Word "Novaryn" at 34.5u, weight 350, line-height 1, letter-spacing -0.003em. A 6.4u four-point star sits as the registered mark: path "M5 0 6.25 3.75 10 5 6.25 6.25 5 10 3.75 6.25 0 5 3.75 3.75Z". Link aria-label "Novaryn home", href "#".
- Menu button, top-right, 20u from the right and top, height 35u, gap 16.5u, no background or border, font inherited. Label is a two-layer stack: "Menu" and "Close". Icon is a 36u SVG, viewBox -18 -18 36 36, nine dots of radius 2.3 on a circle (angles every 45°, radius 15) plus a center dot radius 2.45. A CSS X is hidden until open. Button aria-label "Open navigation menu", aria-controls "site-menu", aria-expanded false.
- Pill "See Further", href "#contact", id contact. Dark #25251d, fully rounded, text #edefe8, weight 350, size max(12px, 16.5u), letter-spacing -0.02em. Position right 20u, top 144.5u, height 41u, padding 4u 19.5u 0 20.8u.
- Headline, left 20u, top 207.6u, size 62.14u, weight 450, letter-spacing -0.015em, line-height 60u, nowrap. Two lines: "Acceleration" then "Through Vision" with a ™ at 0.83em, raised -6.3u, margin-left 2.1u. id vision.
- Lead, right 20u, top 228u, width 520u, padding-left 21u, size max(13px, 20.5u), weight 400, letter-spacing 0.004em, line-height 1.3171. A 2.4u rule, minimum 1.5px, color #1c1c1c, sits on the left of the paragraph. Three nowrap lines, exactly: "We imagine with pathfinders to discover frontiers" / "unfold worlds and shape technologies beyond physical" / "boundaries." id systems.

Video stage
- main.media, id research, flex 1, min-height 0, margin 0 20u, border-radius 5u 5u 0 0, overflow hidden, isolation isolate.
- Fallback fill: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 52% 45%, #334a5f 0%, #142333 48%, #05090f 100%).
- The only media is this video, id hero, autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline, preload auto, object-fit cover, object-position 50% 45%, inset 0. Aria-label: "Photonic lens focusing neural light into a violet beam". Use this exact src and no local video or poster:
  https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_183134_2d4380fd-64a0-459c-a1eb-add70a3e1a7b.mp4
- If prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove autoplay and pause the video.
- News bar over the video, centered, bottom 30u, width 800u, min-height 56u, radius 2u, padding 8u 8u 8u 20u, background rgba(189,191,177,0.985), backdrop-filter blur(24px) saturate(1.1). Copy: "Novaryn presents the blueprint for the next era of AI infrastructure." Weight 350, size max(12px, 17.5u), letter-spacing -0.02em. Pill "View Next", href "#", width 118u, height 40u, text #d2d3c7, size max(12px, 16.75u).

Entrance, once, only when reduced motion is off
- Before first paint add class motion-pending on html. Remove it after the sequence, with a 3000ms fallback.
- While pending, hide the divider (scaleY 0 from the top), logo, menu, CTA, lead, and news. Logo and menu start 8px up. CTA and lead start 10px down. Each headline line starts clipped from the bottom and 0.72em down. News starts translated 10px down and scaled 0.96 on X.
- Then Web Animations, fill both, then cancel and clear the class:
  divider 820ms delay 20ms, easing cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1), scaleY 0 to 1
  logo 560ms delay 90ms, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
  menu 520ms delay 170ms, same settle easing
  "Acceleration" 790ms delay 250ms, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), clip-path reveal upward
  "Through Vision™" 840ms delay 360ms, same reveal
  lead 620ms delay 570ms, settle
  See Further 520ms delay 730ms, from translateY(10px) scale(.985)
  news 720ms delay 920ms, reveal easing, from translate 0 10px and scale .96 1
- The video does not enter. It is already the stage.

Orbit menu
- Accent #7b3cff. Opening adds html.menu-open and locks overflow. The wash is rgba(247,248,243,.90) with blur(16px) saturate(.9), and expands as a circle from the menu glyph: clip-path from circle(0) to circle(radius) over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.62,0,.18,1). Closing reverses over 1s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.25,1) with a 250ms delay, then visibility hidden after 1.3s.
- "Menu" slides up and "Close" slides in, 800ms cubic-bezier(.65,0,.2,1). The dot icon fades out immediately. The X rotates from -90deg scale(.3) to 0 scale(1), delayed 450ms, 900ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).
- Six destinations, angles and notes:
  01 About, 315°, "Who we are", #top
  02 Vision, 45°, "Why we exist", #vision
  03 Systems, 90°, "What we shape", #systems
  04 Research, 135°, "How we learn", #research
  05 Journal, 225°, "Notes from the frontier", #research
  06 Contact, 270°, "Begin together", #contact
- Also draw non-link dots at 0°, 180°, and the center. Center radius collapses to 0 once html.menu-settled, 1700ms after open (0ms if reduced motion).
- Desktop: dots leave the glyph and land on a circle centered at 50% width and 50% height + 18px. Radius is max(110, min(20% of width, 37% of (height − 190))). Active dots are 14px, idle dots 7px, center 12px. Spokes draw outward in ink at 50% opacity and inward in accent. Labels sit past the outer spoke, weight 350, letter-spacing -0.025em, size clamp from about 22px to 40px. Numbers are 11px, weight 500, tracking 0.08em. Labels blur in from 8px and travel along their angle, staggered from 0.95s by 0.06s per item.
- Hover or focus a destination: that label and its dot turn accent, the dot scales to 1.5, both spokes turn accent and the inward spoke scales to full length, everything else drops to about 38% opacity. Caption at the lower left changes from "Index / 06 destinations" / "Hover a point to preview" to "Index / 0N — 06" and that item's note. Caption is 12px, index 10px uppercase tracking 0.14em, fading in at 1.2s.
- A circular preview sits in the middle, diameter 1.24× the orbit radius, background #e9eae3, clip-path circle opening at 1.05s. Images, in order, cover the circle and crossfade: assets/menu-about.webp, assets/menu-vision.webp, assets/menu-systems.webp, assets/menu-research.webp, assets/menu-journal.webp, assets/menu-contact.webp. About is visible first.
- Click the wash, the logo, a destination, or press Escape to close. Tab cycles the trigger and the six links. Resize recomputes the orbit. Logo and menu stay above the wash (z-index 90; menu overlay z-index 50). On tablet and below, html.menu-open .top uses isolation auto so the logo and trigger stay above the wash.
- Below 680px the preview, spokes, and caption are hidden. Links stack in a left column from the glyph: order 0°, 315°, 45°, 90°, 135°, 225°, 270°, 180°, center. Titles use clamp(25px, 8vw, 34px).

Responsive, desktop rules stay untouched above these breakpoints
- Apply the tablet rewrite at max-width 959.98px, or max-height 599.98px, or portrait. --u becomes clamp(0.85px, 100vw / 1280, 1px). Body overflow visible. Page height auto with min-height 100dvh. Outer margin --gx clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 28px). Column gap --gc clamp(40px, 6.5vw, 72px).
- The band becomes a 2-column grid: logo | menu, empty | See Further, headline | lead. Min-height 36svh. Headline size clamp(34px, (50vw − gx − gc/2) / 7.3, 96px), line-height 0.9655. Lead wraps, size clamp(16px, 0.55vw + 12px, 19px), line-height 1.42, max-width 30em. Video min-height max(300px, 50svh). News width min(800u, 100% − 2gx). Enlarge hit areas with a -6px pseudo inset, not the drawn size.
- At max-width 679.98px, gx is 20px. Grid becomes logo | menu, headline full width, lead full width, then See Further on the right. Band min-height 44svh. Headline clamp(32px, (100vw − 40px) / 7.3, 54px). Lead 16.5px, max-width 32em. Video min-height max(300px, 46svh). News is inset 12px on the left, right, and bottom, width auto, padding 10px 8px 10px 14px, gap 12px.
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables transitions and animations. Focus-visible is a 2px ink outline, offset 3px, accent when inside the menu.

Implement this as one HTML document with the CSS and the three scripts inline: the pre-paint motion class, the entrance timeline, the reduced-motion video pause, and the orbit layout and interaction. Preserve the exact copy, SVG paths, CloudFront URL, asset paths, timings, and breakpoints.

items.title: Sakura QR
items.prompt_text:
Build a single standalone HTML file (index.html): a dark-mode hero section for an AI assistant called "Iris", with an interactive 3D robot mascot rendered in Three.js. The robot's whole head turns toward the mouse, its pupils follow the cursor, and its two floating arms bob up and down. Everything goes in ONE file (inline CSS + one inline Imports in the module: THREE from "three"; GLTFLoader from "three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js"; EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass from "three/addons/postprocessing/..."; mergeVertices from "three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js". 3D models (Higgsfield-generated GLB files on CloudFront, CORS-enabled; load these exact URLs directly): const HEAD_GLB = "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261018_172206_0181329a-86e2-41c9-8ab8-c496f29aaa53.glb"; const ARM_GLB = "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261018_172137_cd6086ec-07ef-44dc-bd15-95a450ddaa8c.glb"; HEAD_GLB = spherical robot head with ear caps and two antenna rods (one mesh, ~9 MB). ARM_GLB = one smooth pill/egg-shaped arm (one mesh), used twice. Iris — Smart AI Assistant, , viewport meta with viewport-fit=cover. ================================================== 2. HTML STRUCTURE ==================================================
Iris
Overview · Ecosystem · Socials · Help (4 )
Get Iris
same 4 links

Introducing a
Smart AI Assistant

Easy to start. Effortless to explore.
Capable in every conversation.

Start free
================================================== 3. CSS (exact values) ================================================== :root { --bg:#0b0b11; --nav:#12131a; --line:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); --text:#fff; --muted:#a3a3b2; --link:#c8c8d4; --violet:#7c4dff; --violet-2:#8f66ff; --nav-h:62px; } * { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0 } html, body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--text) } body { font-family:"Figtree", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; overflow-x:hidden } a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none } NAV .nav: position fixed, top/left/right 0, z-index 20, height var(--nav-h), background rgba(18,19,26,0.86), backdrop-filter blur(14px) (+ -webkit-), border-bottom 1px solid var(--line). .nav-inner: max-width 1344px, height 100%, margin 0 auto, padding 0 68px, flex, align-items center, justify-content space-between. .brand: flex, gap 11px, font-weight 600, 21px, letter-spacing -0.01em. .brand-orb: 26×26 circle, background radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #c9b8ff 0%, #8b6cff 38%, #5b3df0 72%, #3a24b8 100%), box-shadow 0 0 14px rgba(124,77,255,.55), inset -2px -3px 6px rgba(20,8,70,.55). .nav-right: flex, align center, gap 30px. .nav-links: flex, gap 38px, 14px, weight 500, color var(--link); hover → #fff (transition color .2s). .btn-open: background #fff, color #0b0b11, weight 600, 14px, padding 10px 19px, radius 999px; hover translateY(-1px) + box-shadow 0 6px 20px rgba(255,255,255,.15). .menu-btn: display none by default; 40×40, radius 12px, background rgba(255,255,255,.06), border 1px solid var(--line). Hamburger icon = the plus ::before/::after: three 16×1.6px white bars spaced 5px apart. When .nav has class .open: span turns transparent, ::before rotates 45deg and ::after -45deg (top 0) to form an X. .mobile-panel: display none; position absolute, top calc(var(--nav-h) + 8px), left/right 16px, background rgba(20,21,30,.96), 1px border var(--line), radius 18px, padding 8px, flex-direction column, box-shadow 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5). Links: padding 14px 16px, radius 12px, weight 500, color var(--link); hover background rgba(255,255,255,.05), color #fff. .nav.open .mobile-panel → display flex. JS: clicking #menuBtn toggles .open on #nav and updates aria-expanded. HERO .hero: position relative, min-height 100vh AND 100svh, overflow hidden, isolation isolate. #stage: position absolute, inset 0, 100%×100%, display block, z-index 0, touch-action pan-y. .hero::after (z-index 1, pointer-events none, inset 0): background = repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.012) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px) (faint vertical lines) layered with radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, transparent 55%, rgba(0,0,0,.45) 100%) (vignette). .hero-inner: relative, z-index 2, pointer-events none, max-width 1344px, margin 0 auto, min-height inherit, padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 40px) 68px 80px, flex column, justify-content center. .copy: max-width 600px, pointer-events auto. h1: font-size clamp(40px, 5.1vw, 70px), line-height 1.04, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.025em. .sub: margin-top 26px, color var(--muted), font-size clamp(17px, 1.65vw, 22px), line-height 1.55, weight 400. .btn-try: inline-flex centered, margin-top 36px, height 59px, padding 0 38px, radius 999px, background linear-gradient(180deg, #8f66ff, #7c4dff), color #fff, weight 600, 20px, letter-spacing -0.005em, box-shadow ONLY inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22) (NO outer glow), transition transform .25s. Hover: translateY(-2px) + filter brightness(1.08). Reveal animation: .reveal starts opacity 0, translateY(18px), animation "rise" .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards; delays .d1 .08s, .d2 .2s, .d3 .32s; @keyframes rise { to { opacity:1; transform:none } }. .loader: absolute, z-index 2, 46×46 circle, border 2px solid rgba(143,102,255,.18), border-top-color #8f66ff, spin 1s linear infinite (keyframes keep translate(-50%,-50%) and rotate 360deg), transform translate(-50%,-50%), transition opacity .5s; .hide → opacity 0. JS positions it at the robot anchor point. RESPONSIVE @media (max-width:1100px): .nav-inner and .hero-inner left/right padding 40px; .nav-links gap 26px. @media (max-width:860px): hide .nav-links; show .menu-btn (inline-flex); .nav-right gap 10px; .hero-inner justify-content flex-end, text-align center, align-items center, padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px) 24px 56px; .copy max-width 560px; h1 font-size clamp(36px, 9.2vw, 56px); .sub margin-top 16px; .btn-try margin-top 26px. (Text sits at the bottom, robot above it.) @media (max-width:480px): .nav-inner padding 0 16px; .hero-inner padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px) 16px 40px; .brand 19px; .btn-open padding 9px 15px, 13px; .btn-try height 54px, padding 0 32px, 18px. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): .reveal no animation, fully visible. ================================================== 4. THREE.JS SCENE ================================================== Renderer: WebGLRenderer({ canvas:#stage, antialias:true, powerPreference:"high-performance" }), pixelRatio min(devicePixelRatio, 2), ACESFilmicToneMapping, exposure 1.0, SRGBColorSpace. scene.background = #0b0b11. Camera: PerspectiveCamera(fov 28, near 0.1, far 100). Helper radialTexture(stops, size=256): canvas radial gradient from centre to edge with the given [offset, color] stops → CanvasTexture (SRGB). glowTex = radialTexture([[0,"rgba(160,120,255,1)"],[0.25,"rgba(124,77,255,.55)"],[0.6,"rgba(90,50,230,.12)"],[1,"rgba(60,30,200,0)"]]). Environment (a dark studio, NOT RoomEnvironment): build a separate scene with background #030305 and emissive "softboxes" made from SphereGeometry(0.5,32,16) meshes with MeshBasicMaterial(color × intensity), each scaled (w, h, 0.3) and lookAt(0,0,0): - white 5×3.2 at (-3, 4.5, 4) ×3.2 (key, top-left) - white 1.2×6 at (6, 0.5, 2) ×1.1 (strip, right) - white 3×1 at (1.5, 5, -1) ×0.8 (top) - #7c4dff 4×5 at (-5, 0, -4) ×1.0 (violet back-left) - #7c4dff 4×5 at (5, 0, -4) ×1.0 (violet back-right) - #5b30ff 6×3 at (0, -5, 1) ×0.35 (violet floor bounce) scene.environment = PMREMGenerator.fromScene(envScene, 0.02).texture; environmentIntensity 1.0. Use round softboxes (spheres), not planes, and NO point lights: both cause square bloom artifacts. Lights: HemisphereLight(0xdcd8f0, 0x1a0f3a, 2.3) + DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.55) at (-3, 4, 5). Post-processing: EffectComposer → RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass(strength 0.55, radius 0.4, threshold 0.92) → OutputPass. Resize the composer and bloom with the canvas. Fresnel rim shader rimMaterial(color, power, strength): ShaderMaterial, additive blending, transparent, depthWrite false. Vertex: pass the view-space normal and view direction. Fragment: f = pow(1 - max(dot(N, V), 0), power); gl_FragColor = vec4(color*f*strength, f). Added as a child "shell" mesh sharing each model mesh's geometry (renderOrder 2) for the lavender edge light. Rig: robot (Group: float/bob/intro scale) → body (Group: partial turn, holds the arms) → head (Group: full turn). Background haze: Sprite(glowTex, color 0x7a55ff, opacity 0.06, additive, toneMapped false, depthWrite false), scale 7.5, position (0, 0.1, -3). Floor glow: PlaneGeometry(1,1) facing the camera (NOT laid flat), MeshBasicMaterial(glowTex, color 0x8f6bff, opacity 0.95, additive, depthWrite false), position (0, -2.05, -0.6), scale (3.4, 0.42). ================================================== 5. MODEL PREP ================================================== prepareModel(root, {glossy, rim, tint, useMap, smooth}): collect the meshes FIRST into an array, then loop over it (adding children inside traverse recurses forever). If smooth: clone the geometry, delete normal/uv/uv1/tangent/color, mergeVertices(g, 1e-3), computeVertexNormals. Replace the material with MeshPhysicalMaterial: map only if useMap; color = tint; glossy → metalness 0.1, roughness 0.3, clearcoat 1.0, clearcoatRoughness 0.16, envMapIntensity 0.9; non-glossy → metalness 0, roughness 0.48, clearcoat 0.3, clearcoatRoughness 0.4, envMapIntensity 0.55. Add the rim shell if rim is given. HEAD: normaliseHead → scale so bbox depth (size.z) = 2, then position = (-centre.x, -(min.y + 1), -centre.z) so the sphere centre is at the origin. prepareModel with glossy:true, useMap:false (ignore the baked texture), tint "#4a4a56", rim {0x8a5cff, power 4.5, strength 0.32}. Then in mountHead: a) Raycast from (0,0,5) toward -Z; R = clamp(hit distance from origin, 0.85, 1.1) (sphere radius). b) sphereNormals: for every vertex whose distance from the head centre is within 7% of R, set its normal to the normalised position (converted with the mesh's inverse-transpose matrix), so reflections are perfectly smooth. c) addVisor(R): build a rounded-rectangle Shape, tessellate it (ShapeGeometry(shape, 48) → non-indexed → 3 rounds of 4-way midpoint subdivision), then wrap every vertex onto the sphere: z = sqrt(radius² - x² - y²); normals = normalised positions. - bezel: w 1.86, h 1.12, corner 0.46, centreY -0.07, radius R×1.03, MeshPhysical color #0c0c10, roughness 0.3, metalness 0.3, clearcoat 0.8, polygonOffset factor/units -6, renderOrder 3. - glass: w 1.74, h 1.0, corner 0.4, centreY -0.07, radius R×1.036, MeshPhysical color #000000, roughness 0.12, clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.1, envMapIntensity 0.9, polygonOffset -8/-8, renderOrder 4. d) Eyes (procedural so they can track): at x = ±0.43, y = -0.08, z = sqrt((R×1.055)² - x² - y²); orient each eye group with quaternion.setFromUnitVectors((0,0,1), position.normalize()). Each eye group contains: - halo: CircleGeometry(0.42) with glowTex, color 0x8a5cff, opacity 0.24, additive, z -0.004, renderOrder 9 - ring: RingGeometry(0.168, 0.212, 64), MeshBasic color new THREE.Color(1.1, 0.88, 2.0) - iris: CircleGeometry(0.17), map = radialTexture([[0,"#d7c9ff"],[0.45,"#a07bff"],[0.8,"#7646f2"],[1,"#5c2fe0"]]), color (1.0, 0.95, 1.15), z 0.001 - pupilWrap group (moves with the cursor): pupil CircleGeometry(0.083) #07040f at z 0.003, plus a white glint CircleGeometry(0.022) at (0.032, 0.034, 0.005) - ALL eye materials: toneMapped false, depthWrite false, depthTest false, renderOrder 10, so the eyes are never hidden behind the visor glass when the head turns. e) Antenna balls: collect head-local vertices with y > 0.75 and |x| > 0.15; per side, find the top-most point, average the vertices within 0.2 of it to get the ball centre (y at least top.y - 0.1). Add there a SphereGeometry(0.118) with MeshPhysical color #8b62ff, emissive #6a3dff, emissiveIntensity 1.5, roughness 0.22, clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.14, plus a glow Sprite(glowTex, color 0x9a6bff, opacity 0.85, additive, scale 0.5). LAYOUT (robot placement) ================================================== ResizeObserver on #hero → layout(): W, H = hero size; isMobile = W <= 860; set renderer/composer/bloom size.
