Pause rendering with an IntersectionObserver when the hero is off-screen. Render with composer.render(). ================================================== 8. LOOK & FEEL CHECKLIST ================================================== - Near-black page (#0b0b11). Big bold white two-line headline "Introducing a / Smart AI Assistant" on the left, grey subline, violet pill button "Start free" with no glow. Glossy charcoal spherical robot on the right half, vertically centred. - The robot reads as polished dark-graphite plastic with smooth curved reflections, a clearly darker glossy black glass visor, two lavender-ringed violet eyes with a soft (not overpowering) glow, violet glowing antenna balls, a faint lavender edge light, a subtle violet haze behind it and a soft violet ellipse glow under it. - On ≤860px: hamburger menu, robot centred at the top, text and button centred at the bottom, no horizontal scroll down to 360px wide.

sections.title: Sakura QR — Master Specification
sections.content:
Build a single standalone HTML file (index.html): a dark-mode hero section for an AI assistant called "Iris", with an interactive 3D robot mascot rendered in Three.js. The robot's whole head turns toward the mouse, its pupils follow the cursor, and its two floating arms bob up and down. Everything goes in ONE file (inline CSS + one inline Imports in the module: THREE from "three"; GLTFLoader from "three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js"; EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass from "three/addons/postprocessing/..."; mergeVertices from "three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js". 3D models (Higgsfield-generated GLB files on CloudFront, CORS-enabled; load these exact URLs directly): const HEAD_GLB = "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261018_172206_0181329a-86e2-41c9-8ab8-c496f29aaa53.glb"; const ARM_GLB = "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261018_172137_cd6086ec-07ef-44dc-bd15-95a450ddaa8c.glb"; HEAD_GLB = spherical robot head with ear caps and two antenna rods (one mesh, ~9 MB). ARM_GLB = one smooth pill/egg-shaped arm (one mesh), used twice. Iris — Smart AI Assistant, , viewport meta with viewport-fit=cover. ================================================== 2. HTML STRUCTURE ==================================================
Iris
Overview · Ecosystem · Socials · Help (4 )
Get Iris
same 4 links

Introducing a
Smart AI Assistant

Easy to start. Effortless to explore.
Capable in every conversation.

Start free
================================================== 3. CSS (exact values) ================================================== :root { --bg:#0b0b11; --nav:#12131a; --line:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); --text:#fff; --muted:#a3a3b2; --link:#c8c8d4; --violet:#7c4dff; --violet-2:#8f66ff; --nav-h:62px; } * { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0 } html, body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--text) } body { font-family:"Figtree", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; overflow-x:hidden } a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none } NAV .nav: position fixed, top/left/right 0, z-index 20, height var(--nav-h), background rgba(18,19,26,0.86), backdrop-filter blur(14px) (+ -webkit-), border-bottom 1px solid var(--line). .nav-inner: max-width 1344px, height 100%, margin 0 auto, padding 0 68px, flex, align-items center, justify-content space-between. .brand: flex, gap 11px, font-weight 600, 21px, letter-spacing -0.01em. .brand-orb: 26×26 circle, background radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #c9b8ff 0%, #8b6cff 38%, #5b3df0 72%, #3a24b8 100%), box-shadow 0 0 14px rgba(124,77,255,.55), inset -2px -3px 6px rgba(20,8,70,.55). .nav-right: flex, align center, gap 30px. .nav-links: flex, gap 38px, 14px, weight 500, color var(--link); hover → #fff (transition color .2s). .btn-open: background #fff, color #0b0b11, weight 600, 14px, padding 10px 19px, radius 999px; hover translateY(-1px) + box-shadow 0 6px 20px rgba(255,255,255,.15). .menu-btn: display none by default; 40×40, radius 12px, background rgba(255,255,255,.06), border 1px solid var(--line). Hamburger icon = the plus ::before/::after: three 16×1.6px white bars spaced 5px apart. When .nav has class .open: span turns transparent, ::before rotates 45deg and ::after -45deg (top 0) to form an X. .mobile-panel: display none; position absolute, top calc(var(--nav-h) + 8px), left/right 16px, background rgba(20,21,30,.96), 1px border var(--line), radius 18px, padding 8px, flex-direction column, box-shadow 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5). JS positions it at the robot anchor point. RESPONSIVE @media (max-width:1100px): .nav-inner and .hero-inner left/right padding 40px; .nav-links gap 26px. @media (max-width:860px): hide .nav-links; show .menu-btn (inline-flex); .nav-right gap 10px; .hero-inner justify-content flex-end, text-align center, align-items center, padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px) 24px 56px; .copy max-width 560px; h1 font-size clamp(36px, 9.2vw, 56px); .sub margin-top 16px; .btn-try margin-top 26px. (Text sits at the bottom, robot above it.) @media (max-width:480px): .nav-inner padding 0 16px; .hero-inner padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px) 16px 40px; .brand 19px; .btn-open padding 9px 15px, 13px; .btn-try height 54px, padding 0 32px, 18px. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): .reveal no animation, fully visible. ================================================== 4. # Prompt: RidgeAI hero

Build a single-file, full-viewport **AI app-builder landing hero** for a fictional company, **RidgeAI** ("ship real apps from a plain idea"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step.

## Look and feel

- **Background:** a full-bleed cinematic photograph of snowy alpine peaks at sunrise, with a low sun on the right, a calm blue sky across the upper half, and glowing amber circuit-like light paths tracing the dark forested valleys and converging at the bottom centre.
  - Over it sits a slow looping video of the same scene, where the light pulses through the paths and clouds drift.
  - On top of that are two screen-blended CSS layers: an amber bloom over the valleys that swells and fades (4.6s, alternate), and a soft light band that sweeps across them (6.5s).
  - A faint dark radial shade sits behind the centre copy so white text stays readable over the bright peaks.
- **Type:** **Inter** (variable, self-hosted).
  - headline 400 weight, white
  - nav ink `#2e2e2e`
  - accent amber `#ff8a12` (CTA, send button, "AI" in the logo)
  - prompt placeholder `#9389cf`
  - perk sparkles lime `#8fd61b`
- **Blueprint frame:** thin white lines (`rgba(255,255,255,.28)`) form an architectural grid over the photo:
  - two rails on each side and two horizontal rules
  - small white square handles at the intersections
  - diagonal hatching in two cells, upper-right and lower-left

## Layout (desktop)

Every size is in design units of a **1372×872 reference**, where `u = clamp(.5px, min(max(100vw/1372, .8px), 100vh/872), 2px)`.

1. **Top bar:** a white bar inset 27.8u from the sides and 20.8u from the top, 53.5u tall.
   - **Left:** an amber hexagon logo and the wordmark **Ridge**, with **AI** in amber, in Inter 600, 23.5u, with tight tracking.
   - **Centre:** the links **Product · Templates · Pricing · Changelog**.
   - **Right:** an amber **Start Climbing** button (115×29u, radius 3.4u) with a warm glow beneath it.
2. **Centre column:**
   - **Badge:** a glass pill with a sparkle icon, "Now with multi-agent app builders".
   - **Headline:** two lines at 60u / 61u line-height, **Ship Real Apps / from a Plain Idea.**
   - **Subline:** two lines at 14.9u: "Turn one sentence into a working app with auth, data, and payments. No code / to write. Describe the tool you need and RidgeAI builds, then ships."
   - **Prompt box:** white, 511×112u, radius 6u, with the placeholder "Build a booking app for a salon" and a 31u amber send button with a › chevron. It sends nothing.
   - **Perks:** three items with lime sparkle icons: No credit card required · Free plan available · Live in one click.
   - **Social proof:** five overlapping 34u circular **initial avatars** (MK, JL, AS, RT, EV, each on its own gradient, with white rings), and "Loved by 40,000 builders" under them.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** pure CSS, run once.
  - The bar drops in, then the badge settles.
  - Each headline line rises out of a clip mask, 0.13s apart.
  - The subline settles, then the prompt box with a 1.5% scale.
  - The perks, then the social-proof row, fade up last.
- **Reduced motion:** nothing animates and the still photo shows.

## Smaller screens (< 900px)

- The bar becomes a compact white bar with the logo, the Start Climbing button and a menu button that opens a white dropdown.
- The frame collapses to the two outer rails and two rules, with small hatched corner blocks.
- The copy stacks centred: the headline wraps (clamp 30–58px), the prompt box goes full width, and the perks wrap.

## Media (use these URLs)

- **Background still:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fab71b48-e739-4ff3-b93a-232b2bb5b74f.jpg` (1920×1086 JPEG)
- **Background loop:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d7dbb9fc-403e-411f-b640-58716b95355f.mp4` (1276×720, 5s, muted, loops, first frame = last frame). Use `object-fit: cover` and the same position as the still so the two align exactly.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- **Top:** the white bar sits at the top with the amber CTA.
- **Middle:** the blueprint grid frames the screen, and the centred headline, prompt box, perks and avatar row read clearly over the alpine scene.
- **Bottom:** the amber light paths in the valleys visibly pulse and glow, and a light band sweeps across them.
- **Content:** no real company or person names appear anywhere.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: KAIRN Alpine 26 hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a premium ski-goggle brand**, **KAIRN** (collection "Alpine 26"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is light-mode winter editorial: a full-bleed photo of a model in an all-white puffer suit and white knit beanie, seated in the snow and looking up, wearing mirrored **ice-blue goggles** that reflect glacier peaks. The background is a calm, almost studio-clean pale icy sky with only a faint low mountain ridge and light snow.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the background is ONE 16:10 photo (1728×1080): `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/18a4a3c1-2af7-4c4a-9045-f6ddff26f4ca.jpg`. `object-fit:cover`, position 50% 30% (phones: 50% 18%, then 50% 0).
- **Motion:** a 5s muted looping video of the same plate plays over it with **identical cover rules**: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/823d013d-bf03-4967-b08f-63c3752df435.mp4` (1152×720). Snow drifts across the frame, the model turns her head slightly and the goggle reflections glint.
  - Fade it in once its first frame is ready.
- **Readability:** a soft, cool navy side-shade (`rgba(22,52,84,.34)` → 0 by 55% from the left, and .2 at the far right) keeps white type readable on the pale sky.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Type and colour

- **Display:** **Anybody** (variable width), set wide (font-stretch 115–150%), for the logo, nav, headline, card titles and buttons.
- **Text:** **Inter** for small text.
- **Colours:** text white, accent **ice cyan `#44DAFD`**, cream card `#F3F1E9`, ink black.

## Layout (desktop: a measured 1546×1017 canvas scaled by --k = min(vw/1546, vh/1017))

- **Top left:** the text wordmark **"KAIRN"** at 28px, wide, with "KA" in cyan and "IRN" in white.
- **Top centre:** "COLLECTION / OUR WORLD", wide caps, 15.4px.
- **Top right:** an account icon, "BAG" and a round white counter "0".
- **Middle left:**
  - three slider dots (the first cyan)
  - the eyebrow "BUILT FOR THE WHITEST DAYS"
  - a huge wide, thin headline at about 106px: **"FORM." / "FUNCTION."**, then **"VISION"** in outline letters with a cyan stroke
- **Middle right, a 2×2 tile cluster:**
  - **Lens card** (cyan): "01 / LENS EDITION", a large bold "BLUE / FROST" and "A cooler perspective".
  - **Beside it:** "ALPINE / 26" in large wide type.
  - **Glass circle:** a frosted cool-blue circle with a ↗ arrow and "01 / 04" with a progress ring (cyan arc).
  - **Product card** (cream): the ice-blue mirrored goggles, then "MODEL 03" and "EXPLORE THE FRAME".
- **Bottom left:** a frosted navy glass story card with a skier thumbnail, "GLACIER COLLECTION" in cyan, and "Crafted for the summits. / KAIRN goggles sharpen every / view. Read more".
- **Bottom centre:** a cyan "EXPLORE COLLECTION" button sitting on a thin horizontal rule across the page.
- **Bottom right:** "FOLLOW US" and three round outline social icons (X, Facebook, Instagram), the first ringed in cyan.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS entrance, about 2.2s.
  - The logo and nav settle; the dots, then the eyebrow.
  - Each headline line types up in turn.
  - The lens card, ALPINE 26, the glass circle and the product card arrive.
  - Then the story card and the button; the rule draws across; the social links fade in last.
- **Hover:** the button lightens to `#6FE3FF`.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone

- **Tablet:** a one-screen portrait composition: a header row, the photo, the headline, the story card with the 2×2 tiles, and the action row.
- **Phone:**
  - a viewport-height hero with the photo masked into the page
  - the nav moves into a burger menu
  - below come the 2×2 tiles, the story card and the social row

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The pale icy hero shows the white-suited model with blue goggles in the centre, the big wide FORM / FUNCTION / VISION on the left and the cyan / cream tile cluster on the right.
- Snow visibly drifts and the goggles glint in the loop.
- **Content:** no real brand names.

# Prompt: Wander Far travel hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **travel-booking landing hero** for a fictional travel site: "Wander far. Rest easy." Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The design is clean, white and editorial: a huge black headline, a quiet search bar, and below them a wide cinematic photo panel of a Norwegian fjord at blue hour that comes alive with motion.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts** (self-hosted woff2):
  - Inter Display 700 for the headline (tight, about −0.035em)
  - Inter 400/500/600 for the UI
  - a small mono for the coordinate
- **Colours:**
  - **Base:** background `#FEFEFE`, headline ink `#0B0E0C`, text `#222223`, labels `#111313`
  - **Grey text:** muted `#6E7070`, lede `#727274`, hairlines `#E6E6E7`
  - **Accent:** fjord navy `#00286E` for the button, with `#0A2A72` for the field icons and the active-tab underline

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the layout is authored at **1446×1088** with `--u = min(100vw/1446, max(100dvh/1088, .78px))`.
- **Height:** the page is exactly one viewport tall; the photo panel absorbs the spare height.

## Layout (desktop)

1. **Header row:**
   - **Left:** the headline **"Wander far. / Rest easy."** on two lines, about 90u.
   - **Right:** a right-aligned grey lede in two lines: "Find quiet fjords, cozy cabins, and the slow, wild / mornings you came for, all here in one place."
2. **Tabs:** Stays (active: semibold, with a navy underline) · Flights · Experiences, each with a thin line icon.
3. **Search bar:** one long hairline-bordered panel split into four cells.
   - **Fields:** each has a tiny caps label and a value with a navy icon. Where to? · Molde | Dates · Jun 18 – Jun 24 | Travelers · 3 travelers.
   - **Button:** a navy "Search" button with a magnifier icon.
4. **Photo panel:** full content width, filling the rest of the screen, square corners.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Eclipsio hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a personal-website builder** for a fictional product, **Eclipsio** ("Launch a Personal Brand That Outshines Every Résumé"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's pure black space with a total solar eclipse rising from the bottom edge: a dark sphere ringed by a blazing amber-orange corona, with solar flares curling off its rim and a few orange embers in the dark.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the eclipse is ONE 1448×1086 image: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b4b7e033-b082-4f09-8ec4-2fabca30c4b4.webp`.
  - **Composition:** the sphere fills the bottom of the frame, its rim apex about two thirds of the way down, and everything above it is black.
  - **Placement:** anchor it to the bottom of the screen at the reference height, centred, wider than the viewport if needed. It sits in its own clipped layer so it never causes sideways scroll.
- **Motion:** a 5s muted looping video of the same plate plays over it: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/48106c12-33c9-4cea-9780-4a080477405e.mp4` (1280×720). The corona boils and a large flare erupts and arcs off the rim; the sphere stays still.
  - The video is the plate mirror-padded 241/1448 on each side to 16:9. Give it the same height as the plate, **aspect-ratio 1930/1086**, centred the same way, so it lines up exactly.
  - Fade it in once it is playing.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the layout is authored in a **1448×1086** reference with `--u = min(100vw/1448, 100dvh/1086)`.
- **Stack:** nav 124.5u · hero copy · logo strip · eclipse zone that takes the remaining height. The page is exactly one screen tall.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:** **Inter** (variable) for everything; **Poppins 600** for the partner-logo names.
- **Colours:** black `#000`, white headline, sub-copy `#bcbcbe`, accent orange `#ee7f20` (button gradient `#f28a2a → #ec7a1c`).

## Layout (reference units)

1. **Nav** (top 34u, 37.7u tall):
   - **Logo:** a white rounded "U-n" stroke mark and "Eclipsio" at 27.8u, left 68u.
   - **Links:** Work · Showcase · Members · Journal, 16.25u, weight 600, centred, 42.6u apart.
   - **Button:** a white "Start Creating" pill, right 62u.
2. **Badge:** a dark warm-glass pill, 43.9u tall.
   - **Text:** a glowing peach dot `#f7c69b`, then "Shine Your Name Brighter Tonight" in 15.6u grey.
   - **Edge:** an orange rim lit from the lower-left, with a soft inner glow and a hairline sheen along the top.
3. **Headline:** two lines at 78.8u / 81u line-height, weight 750: **"Launch a Personal Brand That / Outshines Every Résumé"**.
4. **Subline:** 22.6u / 36u, tracking .031em: "Whether you're a designer, developer, or creator, Eclipsio will help / you glow brighter with a site that feels polished, and you."
5. **Buttons** (55.4u tall, 14u apart):
   - **"Start Creating":** a filled orange pill with a hairline white border.
   - **"View Samples":** black, with a gradient border running grey → burnt orange.
6. **Logo strip:** a frosted-glass pill, 892×56u.
   - **Glass:** a faint white gradient fill, a 1px warm border `rgba(255,190,140,.16)`, a 14px backdrop blur, and edges fading to black.
   - **Marquee:** an infinite 46s marquee of grey partner logos (Layers, Circooles, Quotient, Hourglass, Catalog), each a 34u grey icon plus its name. It pauses on hover.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS sequence. The logo and nav fade in, the badge settles, each headline line rises, then the subline, the two buttons (staggered) and the logo strip.
- **Hover:** the orange button gains an orange glow, and the outline button brightens.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance, no marquee, no video.

## Phones

- **Nav:** the links collapse into a round menu button with a dropdown.
- **Copy:** the headline wraps to four lines, and the buttons sit side by side at full width.
- **Logo strip:** becomes a plain full-width soft-edged marquee (no pill).
- **Eclipse:** fills the bottom.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The black hero matches the layout above, with the orange-rimmed badge and the orange "Start Creating" button.
- The frosted logo strip scrolls, and the eclipse below it flares and boils in motion.
- **Content:** no real brand names.

# Prompt: Meadowbell hero

Build a single-file **landing hero for an animated kids' farming series**, "Hollyoak's Plucky Sprout Squad", from a fictional studio, **Meadowbell**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a sunny hand-painted anime (Ghibli-like) afternoon: a boy and his beagle lie on a grassy hillside looking up at a big blue sky full of cumulus clouds, with a green valley far off on the right.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole scene is ONE 9:8 background image (2160×1920): `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/3ca5d10d-ea2f-4907-876f-33bde169469e.jpg`.
  - **Sky:** a deep-to-light blue sky across the top 60%, with a tall cumulus cloud on the left, another on the right, and wispy streaks top-right.
  - **Hillside:** the boy (messy brown hair, white shirt, blue shorts, hands behind his head) and a brown-and-white beagle lie at the left, looking up. Grass and wildflowers fill the bottom third, softly blurred at the very bottom.
- **Motion:** the scene moves only through a looping video of the same plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d2cb5bef-f92b-4e91-ae93-8dc6555e56ac.mp4` (960×960, 5s, muted, loops; first frame = last frame).
  - The grass ripples in steady waves, daisies nod, the boy's hair and shirt flutter, the dog's ears lift, and the clouds drift right.
  - The video was rendered square from the plate mirror-padded 120/1920 at the top and bottom. Lay it over the plate at **100% width, 112.5% height, top −6.25%** so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** the hero is **one 1440×1280 frame** (9:8) that scales with the viewport width: `--u = 100vw/1440`, height 1280u. On a 1440×900 screen the headline, buttons and the boy and dog show first, and the chapters row sits just below the fold.
- **Placement:** every element below is placed in frame units.

## Type and colour

- **Display:** **Grandstander 900**, a rounded, slightly bouncy display face, all white. It's used for the logo, the kicker, the headline and the section title.
- **Everything else:** **Inter** 400/500. Self-host the latin woff2 files.
- **Colours:** text is white with a soft blue shadow `0 4u 18u rgba(28,70,120,.28)` on the headline. Button text green is `#5b875c`.

## Layout (1440×1280 frame)

  - **Join us:** a white pill, 105×45 at (1311, 14), green Inter 500 18.5px.
- **Copy, centred:**
  - **Kicker:** "HOLLYOAK'S" 40.5px, cap top at y = 203.
  - **Headline:** **"PLUCKY / SPROUT SQUAD"**, 143.5px on a 118px line pitch, cap top at y = 261.
  - **Subline:** Inter 21.2px / 27px, three lines: "Learn the Ways of the Meadow with / Hollyoak's Plucky Sprout Squad! Each chapter is / packed with play, chores, and wonder."
  - **Join us button:** white pill, 144×59 at (550, 617), green 22px.
  - **Watch preview button:** translucent mint pill `rgba(204,218,173,.6)` with blur, 184×58 at (707, 619). It has a white rounded play triangle and white 19.5px text.
- **Chapters row:**
  - **Title:** "CHAPTERS" 36px at (137, 866).
  - **Link:** "browse all chapters ›" 22px, right-aligned to x = 1308.
  - **Cards:** three 378×273 cards at x = 133, 531, 929 (y = 913), radius 15, soft shadow, each with a white rounded play triangle 20px in from the bottom-left. Card art:
    - a vegetable garden with tomato stakes and a cottage: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/cd2d844f-ae3f-4fa9-8067-b077530b6e71.webp

    - a girl in a straw hat flying a kite on a breezy hill: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/cde5384e-ce4d-423f-925a-451b779066e0.webp

Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a sunny hand-painted anime (Ghibli-like) afternoon: a boy and his beagle lie on a grassy hillside looking up at a big blue sky full of cumulus clouds, with a green valley far off on the right.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole scene is ONE 9:8 background image (2160×1920): `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/3ca5d10d-ea2f-4907-876f-33bde169469e.jpg`.
  - **Sky:** a deep-to-light blue sky across the top 60%, with a tall cumulus cloud on the left, another on the right, and wispy streaks top-right.
  - **Hillside:** the boy (messy brown hair, white shirt, blue shorts, hands behind his head) and a brown-and-white beagle lie at the left, looking up. Grass and wildflowers fill the bottom third, softly blurred at the very bottom.
- **Motion:** the scene moves only through a looping video of the same plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d2cb5bef-f92b-4e91-ae93-8dc6555e56ac.mp4` (960×960, 5s, muted, loops; first frame = last frame).
  - The grass ripples in steady waves, daisies nod, the boy's hair and shirt flutter, the dog's ears lift, and the clouds drift right.
  - The video was rendered square from the plate mirror-padded 120/1920 at the top and bottom. Lay it over the plate at **100% width, 112.5% height, top −6.25%** so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** the hero is **one 1440×1280 frame** (9:8) that scales with the viewport width: `--u = 100vw/1440`, height 1280u. On a 1440×900 screen the headline, buttons and the boy and dog show first, and the chapters row sits just below the fold.
- **Placement:** every element below is placed in frame units.

## Type and colour

- **Display:** **Grandstander 900**, a rounded, slightly bouncy display face, all white. It's used for the logo, the kicker, the headline and the section title.
- **Everything else:** **Inter** 400/500. Self-host the latin woff2 files.
- **Colours:** text is white with a soft blue shadow `0 4u 18u rgba(28,70,120,.28)` on the headline. Button text green is `#5b875c`.

## Layout (1440×1280 frame)

- **Nav:**
  - **Logo:** "Meadowbell" 29.5px with a small white two-leaf sprout icon, at (31, 23).
  - **Nav pill:** a translucent sage pill `rgba(173,196,174,.45)` with backdrop blur, 546×50 at (443, 13), radius 25. Inside: Farm · Gear · Chapters · Our Crew, Inter 500 19.5px, 54px apart, starting 49px in.
  - **Join us:** a white pill, 105×45 at (1311, 14), green Inter 500 18.5px.
- **Copy, centred:**
  - **Kicker:** "HOLLYOAK'S" 40.5px, cap top at y = 203.
  - **Headline:** **"PLUCKY / SPROUT SQUAD"**, 143.5px on a 118px line pitch, cap top at y = 261.
  - **Subline:** Inter 21.2px / 27px, three lines: "Learn the Ways of the Meadow with / Hollyoak's Plucky Sprout Squad! Each chapter is / packed with play, chores, and wonder."
  - **Join us button:** white pill, 144×59 at (550, 617), green 22px.
  - **Watch preview button:** translucent mint pill `rgba(204,218,173,.6)` with blur, 184×58 at (707, 619). It has a white rounded play triangle and white 19.5px text.
- **Chapters row:**
  - **Title:** "CHAPTERS" 36px at (137, 866).
  - **Link:** "browse all chapters ›" 22px, right-aligned to x = 1308.
  - **Cards:** three 378×273 cards at x = 133, 531, 929 (y = 913), radius 15, soft shadow, each with a white rounded play triangle 20px in from the bottom-left. Card art:
    - a vegetable garden with tomato stakes and a cottage: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/cd2d844f-ae3f-4fa9-8067-b077530b6e71.webp
    - a boy and dog on a hill path among sheep above the sea: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/48f5b97e-c27c-4afd-9427-eb35aebd1751.webp
    - a girl in a straw hat flying a kite on a breezy hill: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/cde5384e-ce4d-423f-925a-451b779066e0.webp

## Motion (UI only)

- **Entrance**, one Web Animations timeline, run once:
  - the logo, nav and Join us drop in
  - the kicker un-blurs
  - each headline line springs up out of a blur, 0.16s apart
  - then the subline, both buttons, the chapters title and link, and the three cards rise in turn
- **Hover:** the cards lift 8u and their art zooms to 1.05. The pills rise 2u, and the chevron nudges right.
- **Reduced motion:** no video and no transitions.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Nav:** compact, with the logo and Join us.
- **Copy:** stacked and centred in flow, with the headline at 51px.
- **Chapters:** a swipeable row of cards.
- **Scene:** the 9:8 plate and video sit in one 9:8 box sized to the hero's height and shifted so the boy and dog stay in view (left 18%, translateX(−18%)).

## Acceptance check (1440×1280)

- The text, pills and cards sit at the coordinates above over the hillside scene.
- The grass visibly ripples, the boy's hair and the dog's ears move, and the clouds drift.
- The video lines up exactly with the still.

# Prompt: murmur podcast hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a daily podcast** from a fictional show, **murmur** ("Daily Murmur Podcast"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The mood is calm and cinematic: blue hour seen through a rain-streaked apartment window, with a blurred city skyline in violet and pink, warm bokeh lights, and dark monstera leaves in the lower corners.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole background is ONE 16:10 image: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/7a7598ba-a6f8-42b4-ac39-98279dac4192.jpg`.
  - **Window:** a dark wooden window frame fills the middle and right. Its glass is covered in raindrops, with a blurred skyline behind it.
  - **Room:** a soft curtain hangs at the left, and big monstera leaves fill the lower-left and lower-right corners.
- **Motion:** the scene moves through a looping video of the same plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d41b8c1d-f175-43b3-af22-7081133aa8de.mp4` (1280×720, 5s, muted, loops; first frame = last frame), with drops sliding and lights shimmering.
  - The video was rendered 16:9 from the plate mirror-padded 96/1728 on each side. Lay it at **111.11% width, left −5.556%** so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
  - **Lighting layers** (screen-blended, lighting only, never drawn objects):
    - **Bloom:** three soft radial glows over the city lights (pink, amber and periwinkle) breathe between 35% and 100% over 5.2s.
    - **Sweep:** a pale diagonal light band sweeps across the room every 7s, like headlights passing below.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** one **1440×900 frame** that covers the viewport: `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`, centred. Every element below is placed in frame units.

## Type and colour

- **Wordmark:** "murmur" in **Newsreader 500** (a bookish serif with moderate contrast), white, 139px, tracking +.05em, with a soft navy shadow.
- **Sans:** **Inter** 400/500. The subtitle is lavender `#dfe3fb`; the episode title is white.
- **Mono:** **IBM Plex Mono** 400 for the label, date line, About text and platform row. The label is `#b9c4ea` and the date line `#7583bd`.
- **Card:** deep navy glass `rgba(8,21,62,.84)` with an 18px blur, a 1px periwinkle border `rgba(132,146,255,.38)` and a deep shadow.

## Layout (1440×900 frame)

- **Wordmark:** "murmur", centred, x-height top at y = 133.
- **Subtitle:** "Daily Murmur Podcast", 33px, centred, at y = 225.
- **Label:** "LISTEN TO THE LATEST EPISODE", 12.6px mono, tracking .05em, centred 10px right of centre, at y = 319.
- **Player card:** 623.5×190 at (412.5, 350), radius 16.
  - **Cover:** 158×156 at (18.5, 16) inside the card, radius 7. The art is rooftop gardens over a dusk skyline, `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/6f03fd17-7c05-4c28-a079-6c53f2d397e6.webp`, with a white serif "murmur" over its lower left.
  - **Title:** "Why Cities Are Planting Forests / on Rooftops", Inter 500 20.6px on a 25.5px line, at (202.5, 33).
  - **Date line:** "Apr 25 · Daily Murmur Podcast", 11.2px mono, at y = 99.5.
  - **Waveform:** 62 thin rounded bars (1.9px) across 335×34 at (203, 138). Most are quiet; there's a tall bright burst at about 25%, softer bumps at 33% and 68%, and a colour drift from blue `#5560FF` through periwinkle `#86A2FF` to violet `#A083FF`, with a faint glow.
  - **Play button:** a 37px off-white circle with a navy play triangle at (566.5, 136.5).
- **About:** "ABOUT", 13px mono at (414, 595). Below it, four mono lines at 13.72px on a 19.3px pitch: "Every weekday morning, murmur slows the noise down to the four stories / worth carrying into your day: twenty quiet minutes of science, designs, / cities and culture, told by hosts who stay so curious about the / small things that make a city a home."
- **Platform row:** "LISTEN ON YOUR FAVORITE PODCAST PLATFORM", 11.4px mono at (414, 760). Four 21.5px round white icons start at x = 710 with an 11.7px gap: an outlined podcast mic, a sound-bars disc, a headphones disc and another bars disc. Use generic glyphs only, no real brand logos.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline.
  - The wordmark develops out of an 18px blur with a slight scale.
  - The subtitle rises, and the label's tracking tightens from .3em to .05em.
  - The card rises out of a blur, and the waveform wipes in left to right.
  - The About lines rise one by one, then the platform row.
- **Loops:** the waveform bars breathe on staggered 1.6s loops (scaleY .72↔1.08).
- **Hover:** the play button grows to 1.08 with a halo, and the icons lift 2px.
- **Reduced motion:** no video, no bloom or sweep, no breathing.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Background:** the plate and video cover the screen behind everything.
- **Copy:** stacks centred: a 60–100px wordmark, the subtitle and the label.
- **Card:** compact. The cover sits beside the title and date, the waveform runs full width below, and play sits at the bottom-right.
- **Below the card:** the About block and the platform row, left-aligned.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- Every element sits at the coordinates above over the rainy-window plate.
- The loop lines up with the still, the city glow breathes, and a light band sweeps the room.
- **Content:** no real brands, logos or people.

# Prompt: Corvana AI hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for an AI copilot that runs clinic front desks** for a fictional company, **Corvana AI**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's bright, clean and warm: a white page, a coral accent, a pixel-art heartbeat line running behind the main button, and a strip of three tall rounded panels (a laughing patient, a check-ins chart and a patient-trust widget over a coral peony).

## Type and colour

- **Type:** a tight neo-grotesk (Inter / Inter Display style) for everything, self-hosted woff2 at 400/500/600. The headline is 500 weight with very tight tracking (about −0.045em).
- **Page:** white `#FEFEFE`, ink `#000`, nav ink `#3A3C40`, muted `#5E6064`.
- **Accents:** coral `#F8533F`, announcement coral `#FA6E5C`, data violet `#7A5CF0`, chip lavender `#F1EDFE→#E8E2FD` with violet text `#6A4CEB`.

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the composition is authored in reference px of a **1514×1039** artboard: `--u = min(100cqw/1514, max(100svh/1039, .68px))`, centred.
- **Below 1024px wide or portrait:** the page re-flows into one locked screen with real px and a swipeable panel strip with dots.

## Layout (desktop, reference px)

1. **Announcement bar:** coral, 38px tall. "30% off for all new clinics." plus the underlined link "CLAIM THE DEAL NOW".
2. **Nav:** white, 68px, with a hairline bottom border.
   - **Left:** a blue-violet gradient "V" mark and "Corvana AI".
   - **Centre:** Care (current, bold) · Features · Clinics · Customers · Careers.
   - **Right:** a light-grey "Watch a Demo" pill.
3. **Headline:** two centred lines, about 72u, **"The AI Copilot Made For Calmer / Clinical Coordination"**.
4. **Subline:** about 22.4u / 31u, two lines: "From first check-in to aftercare reminders, take over routine tasks / and paperwork while giving every patient a warm welcome."
5. **Main button:** a 233×71.5u glass ring (translucent white, hairline border, soft drop shadow) around a black pill, "Start Your Trial", 22u.
6. **Heartbeat field:** behind the button, a pixel ECG trace spans the whole 1514u width.
   - **Pixels:** 6.2u squares on a 9.6u grid, coral `#F8533F` with lighter `#FB7565` baseline dots.
   - **Shape:** the baseline sits 9u below the button centre. Four heartbeats at −462, −225, +231 and +468u from centre each have a small P bump, a Q dip, a tall R spike (≈60u up), an S drop (≈47u down) and a T bump. Draw every spike as a vertical pixel staircase.
   - **Ends:** the baseline thins to sparse dots and fades toward both ends.
7. **Panel strip:** 1313.5×429.5u, radius 16, three columns 436.5 / 425.5 / 436.5u with 7.5u gaps.
   - **Patient panel:** a laughing older woman with wavy silver hair, gold hoops and a coral knit sweater, on a smooth **mint-green → pale sky-blue studio gradient**.
     - Still: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/c43c6772-ae79-45f3-a2ff-90a401f03b48.webp
     - Loop on top: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/39c69b84-0ac5-485f-ae42-3bd7d521989e.mp4` (960×960, 5s, muted, loops; first = last frame). She laughs, her shoulders shake, and her hair sways.
     - The loop is the portrait mirror-padded 47/1208 on each side to a square. Lay it at **107.78% width, left −3.89%, full height** over the 1208:1302 portrait frame so it aligns exactly. Fade it in once it is playing.
   - **Metric panel:** `#EAEAEA` with a white 339×316u card.

# Prompt: Skyprompt hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for an online course on AI image generation** for a fictional school, **Skyprompt** ("Prompt-to-Pixel Art, No Cost!"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's bright, playful and airy: a floating grassy island with a waterfall hangs in a clear blue sky above a bank of clouds, and a fan of four art cards rests on the island.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole scene is ONE background image, a 1440×900 composition: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/dc4ac5c7-4eee-48ab-814c-cbba3c9fd1b7.jpg`.
  - **Sky:** a clear blue gradient, deeper at the top (#3195e0 → #49a9f3).
  - **Island:** one small floating island, centred, its grassy top at about y = 560, with a waterfall falling from its underside into the clouds.
  - **Clouds:** fluffy clouds along the bottom edge and the lower corners.
- **Motion:** the scene moves only through a looping video of that same plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/81764d30-8120-4ab5-8491-4dd852b82496.mp4` (1280×720, 5s, muted, loops; first frame = last frame).
  - It shows the waterfall flowing, small yellow butterflies fluttering across the sky, a larger butterfly passing, the clouds drifting and the grass swaying. The island itself never moves.
  - The video was rendered 16:9 from the plate mirror-extended 96/1728 on each side. Lay it over the plate at **111.11% of the frame width, left −5.556%**, so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** everything sits in one **1440×900 frame** sized by `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`. The frame covers the viewport, centred horizontally and anchored to the top, and every element below is placed in frame units.
- **Nav:** pinned to the viewport edges with its own fit unit, `--n = clamp(.62px, min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900), 1.6px)`.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** DM Serif Display 400, white, with a 1.1u white text-stroke for weight.
- **Everything else:** Poppins 400/600/700. Self-host the latin woff2 files.
- **Labels:** Poppins **700**, letter-spacing −.015 to −.02em, dark ink `#161c08`, set on a **rough yellow highlighter swipe**: an SVG brush shape with jagged edges, filled `#f6f03b`, stretched behind the text, plus a soft `drop-shadow(0 0 1.5u rgba(246,240,59,.75))` paint bleed. Never use clean boxes.

## Layout (1440×900 frame coordinates)

- **Nav:**
  - **Logo:** a white six-petal flower, 44×44 at (118, 22).
  - **Links:** Story · Study Plan · Showcase · Classroom · Q&A, white, 17px, centred at y = 44, 35.5px apart.
  - **X button:** a 50px translucent white circle, 283 from the right.
  - **Pill:** a white "Begin the Journey" pill, 168×44, 107 from the right.
- **Headline block:**
  - Highlighter **"Begin"**: 131×44 at (657, 117), 40px.
  - Headline **"Prompt-to-Pixel Art"**: 103px, centred, top 140.
  - Highlighter **"No Cost!"**: 176×45 at (638, 241), 39px.
  - **Subline:** 17.2px / 24.5px, centred, top 312, two lines: "Turn plain words into images you love — lesson / by lesson, from first idea to finished piece."
- **Cards:** four 132×162 cards with a 5px white border, radius 12 and a soft shadow, each tilted:
  - (472, 419) at −12°: cottage on a sea cliff
  - (601, 407) at −4°: orange kitten in a blue beanie and scarf
  - (711, 409) at 4°: smiling succulent in a terracotta pot
  - (827, 419) at 12°: golden retriever in a cowboy hat and red bandana
  - Card art: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/37b0e4f8-9780-409b-9aa4-f855a9a4ef24.webp, https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/02be94e0-6903-4edd-b5ec-a10eb62d166e.webp, https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/73e9f810-8b43-4548-a4b1-830b1b99cdfd.webp, https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fde79b9a-ae7c-439f-9a96-f727754defb7.webp
- **Labels and arrows:**
  - Highlighter label **"Starts from Zero!"** at (395, 424), rotated −11°, with a hand-drawn yellow arrow curving into the first card.
  - Highlighter label **"Real Client Results"** at (927, 518), rotated −6°, with one arrow curling up to the dog card and a double arrow curling down.
- **Call to action, on the island:**
  - Highlighter **"Zero Cost"**: 96×25 at (672, 584).
  - White pill **"Begin the Journey"**: 195×44 at (622, 624), 17px Poppins 600.
  - Note **"No art skills needed to start."**: 15.6px, centred at top 682.

## Motion (UI only)

- **Already visible at load:** the scene, the cards and the call to action.
- **Entrance**, one Web Animations timeline, run once:
  - the logo and the nav buttons fade in
  - at 0.35s, "Begin" is marked in: the yellow swipes left to right (clip-path on `::before`), then the word lands
  - at 0.7s, the headline develops out of a 14px blur with a 1.04 → 1 scale
  - at 1.45s, "No Cost!" is marked the same way
  - at 1.85s, the subline settles out of a soft blur
- **Hover:** cards lift 18u, straighten and grow to 1.07.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Top:** a compact nav (logo, the pill and a round menu button), then the copy in flow, centred.
- **Below:** the same frame, scaled to 100vw/720 and cropped around the island, with its top edge fading into a page gradient sampled from the plate's sky.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The copy and the card fan sit at the coordinates above.
- The waterfall flows and butterflies cross the sky.
- The island stays still and the cards stay seated on it.
- All labels are bold on rough highlighter swipes.

# Prompt: Reelmark hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a short-form video creator marketplace**, **Reelmark** ("Captivate Crowds with Snackable Reels"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is soft mint studio: a warm off-white page `#F5F8EF`, deep forest-green accents `#08482D`, a mint badge `#DAE7C7`, a big bold black headline, and an arched row of seven tall video cards playing bright sage-green product clips, with hand-drawn green notes and arrows.

## Frame

- **Frame:** one **1440×1080** frame, contained and centred: `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/1080)`. Every element is placed in frame units.

## Type

- **Headline:** **Inter Tight 700**, 88u on a 92u line, tracking −0.035em (−0.022em on line 2), ink `#101410`.
- **UI:** **Inter** 400/500. The subline is `#5E5E61`.
- **Notes:** **Caveat 600** for the hand-drawn notes, in forest green.

## Layout (1440×1080)

- **Top bar:**
  - **Logo:** a green leaf mark with "Reelmark", at (37, 36).
  - **Nav:** Brands · Creators · Pricing · Use Cases · Contact, Inter 16.4u, starting at x = 505 with a 31u gap.
  - **Buttons:** a white "Log in" pill, 92×40 at (1211, 29), and a forest-green "Sign up" pill, 97×40 at (1304, 29).
- **Badge:** a mint pill, 292×37 at (575, 115): "Trusted by 120,000+ indie makers", Inter 500 16.6u in green.
- **Headline:** centred, top 176: **"Captivate Crowds / with Snackable Reels"**.
- **Subline:** centred, top 394, 20.8u / 32u, three lines: "Grow your brand with short, snappy product clips by / our handpicked video makers. Our crew is ready to / lift your next launch higher."
- **Notes:**
  - a "//" doodle at (263, 377)
  - a handwritten "Be seen / with clips" rotated 16° at (1212, 310), with a long curving arrow down to the cards
  - "Zero cost" rotated 24° at (521, 937), with a small arrow pointing to the button
  - the doodle strokes draw themselves in
  - the "Be seen" arrow starts **below** the note (it never crosses the words) and curls down to the cards
- **Card row: a curved video carousel.** Ten tall cards scroll continuously **right → left** (about 50u per second, looping seamlessly). The row is draggable with the pointer or touch: it follows the drag 1:1, coasts with momentum after release (velocity decays about 95% per second), then the slow auto-scroll carries on. The cursor is grab / grabbing.
  - **Curve:** each card's geometry comes from its x position relative to the centre, like the inside of a cylinder.
    - Normalised distance d = |x − 720| / 706.
    - Width = (170 + 48·d²)u. Cards sit on an even 196u pitch, then each centre is pushed outward: x = 720 + t·(1 + 0.083·(t/706)²), where t is the unpushed offset from the centre. This keeps about a 26u gap even at the edges.
    - Each vertical edge's height = (280 + 92·q^2.6)u, where q is that edge's own normalised distance.
    - The vertical centre sits at (687 − 12·d²)u.
  - **Result:** centre cards are upright 170×280 rectangles, and cards near the screen edges grow to about 370u tall with their outer edge taller than the inner edge.
  - **Drawing:** each card is a rounded quad (`clip-path: path()`, 15u corners) recomputed every frame.
  - **Details:** no drop shadow, a small frosted round play icon at each card's bottom-left, and cards clipped by the frame edges.
- **Button:** a forest-green "Make a Reel" pill (172×58) inside a dashed green outline ring (190×74) at (626, 901).

## Card media (one video for all ten)

- **Grid:** all card clips live in ONE 16:9 **5×2 grid** (10 tiles of 384×540, edge to edge):
  - **Still poster:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b7ebb74a-8c8a-4f7e-8f80-55e2d74ecd05.webp`
  - **Loop:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/04fd3d5f-99d7-476e-98a4-46c08518ffb3.mp4` (1280×720, 5s, muted, loops)
- **Tiles** (row-major) are the sneaker, skincare splash, latte pour, headphones, plant shop, florist bouquet, pottery wheel, serum splash, latte top-down and headphones on a stand. Each tile animates on its own.
- **Each card:** shows its own tile, cover-fitted. Inside the clipped card, place a `<video>` and a poster layer sized 5 × tile width by 2 × tile height, offset to that tile, where the tile height is max(card height, card width / 0.7111).
- **Sync:** every card uses the same src, so it downloads once. Keep all ten on the same timestamp, and fade each in when its first frame is ready.
- **Clock:** drive the carousel from a long-running Web Animations clock (`document.documentElement.animate(…, {duration: 1e9})`) so the scroll is time-based.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time Web Animations sequence.

# Prompt: Reelmark hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a short-form video creator marketplace**, **Reelmark** ("Captivate Crowds with Snackable Reels"). The look is soft mint studio: a warm off-white page `#F5F8EF`, deep forest-green accents `#08482D`, a mint badge `#DAE7C7`, a big bold black headline, and an arched row of seven tall video cards playing bright sage-green product clips, with hand-drawn green notes and arrows.

## Frame

- **Frame:** one **1440×1080** frame, contained and centred: `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/1080)`. Every element is placed in frame units.

## Type

- **Headline:** **Inter Tight 700**, 88u on a 92u line, tracking −0.035em (−0.022em on line 2), ink `#101410`.
- **UI:** **Inter** 400/500. The subline is `#5E5E61`.
- **Notes:** **Caveat 600** for the hand-drawn notes, in forest green.

## Layout (1440×1080)

- **Top bar:**
  - **Logo:** a green leaf mark with "Reelmark", at (37, 36).
  - **Nav:** Brands · Creators · Pricing · Use Cases · Contact, Inter 16.4u, starting at x = 505 with a 31u gap.
  - **Buttons:** a white "Log in" pill, 92×40 at (1211, 29), and a forest-green "Sign up" pill, 97×40 at (1304, 29).
- **Badge:** a mint pill, 292×37 at (575, 115): "Trusted by 120,000+ indie makers", Inter 500 16.6u in green.
- **Headline:** centred, top 176: **"Captivate Crowds / with Snackable Reels"**.
- **Subline:** centred, top 394, 20.8u / 32u, three lines: "Grow your brand with short, snappy product clips by / our handpicked video makers. Our crew is ready to / lift your next launch higher."
- **Notes:**
  - a "//" doodle at (263, 377)
  - a handwritten "Be seen / with clips" rotated 16° at (1212, 310), with a long curving arrow down to the cards
  - "Zero cost" rotated 24° at (521, 937), with a small arrow pointing to the button
  - the doodle strokes draw themselves in
  - the "Be seen" arrow starts **below** the note (it never crosses the words) and curls down to the cards
- **Card row: a curved video carousel.** Ten tall cards scroll continuously **right → left** (about 50u per second, looping seamlessly). The row is draggable with the pointer or touch: it follows the drag 1:1, coasts with momentum after release (velocity decays about 95% per second), then the slow auto-scroll carries on. The cursor is grab / grabbing.
  - **Curve:** each card's geometry comes from its x position relative to the centre, like the inside of a cylinder.
    - Normalised distance d = |x − 720| / 706.
    - Width = (170 + 48·d²)u. Cards sit on an even 196u pitch, then each centre is pushed outward: x = 720 + t·(1 + 0.083·(t/706)²), where t is the unpushed offset from the centre. This keeps about a 26u gap even at the edges.
    - Each vertical edge's height = (280 + 92·q^2.6)u, where q is that edge's own normalised distance.
    - The vertical centre sits at (687 − 12·d²)u.
  - **Result:** centre cards are upright 170×280 rectangles, and cards near the screen edges grow to about 370u tall with their outer edge taller than the inner edge.
  - **Drawing:** each card is a rounded quad (`clip-path: path()`, 15u corners) recomputed every frame.
  - **Details:** no drop shadow, a small frosted round play icon at each card's bottom-left, and cards clipped by the frame edges.

# Prompt: Lauberhorn Ridge trail dashboard hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **hiking trail guide dashboard hero** for a fictional alpine trail, **Lauberhorn Ridge** (above Interlaken, Switzerland), seen by a signed-in hiker, **Mira Holt**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a bright autumn travel app: a full-bleed photo of a golden larch valley with a turquoise lake under snowy peaks, and soft cream glass widgets floating over it.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole background is ONE 16:10 photo (1728×1080), stretched to the frame: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4e84f7cd-8250-48e6-8dfa-746b13b73bfb.jpg`.
  - Golden larch forest on both slopes, a turquoise glacial lake winding into the valley, snow-capped peaks and a clear blue sky at the top.
- **Motion:** a muted looping drone shot of the same valley plays over it: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/48d4c209-86b6-4b1c-b972-4f57e3dafe89.mp4` (1280×720, 10s, loops seamlessly because it plays forward then reversed). The camera glides forward over the larches toward the lake, with a slow push-in and slight parallax.
  - The video was rendered 16:9 from the plate mirror-padded 96/1728 on each side. Lay it at **111.11% width, left −5.556%** so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** one **1440×900 frame** that covers the viewport: `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`, centred. Every element below is placed in frame units.

## Type and colour

- **Sans:** **Inter Tight** 300/400. The trail title is Inter Tight 300.
- **Mono:** **JetBrains Mono** 500, uppercase, tracking .06em, for labels, chips, tabs and values. Card labels start with a tight "::" prefix.
- **Colours:**
  - card cream glass `rgba(244,240,233,.94)` with a 14px backdrop blur
  - inner panels `#EAE6DE`
  - ink `#2E2D2A`
  - amber `#F6B733` and light amber `#FBD06A`
  - orange pin `#F59E0B`, violet pin `#7C6CF2`
- **Shadows:** no drop shadows on cards or the photo. Only a faint text shadow on the white title and breadcrumb.

## Layout (1440×900 frame)

- **Logo tile:** 41×38 cream tile at (15, 14), radius 12, with a six-spoke asterisk glyph.
- **User pill:** at (62, 14), 38 tall, radius 12: "::", then "Mira Holt" (18px) and a small orange ring (status dot).
- **Breadcrumb:** white mono at 12.6px, not uppercase, at (15, 73): "Back to Explore  Switzerland / Interlaken / Jungfrau Region /".
- **Title:** "Lauberhorn Ridge", white, Inter Tight 300, 96px, tracking −.045em, at (20, 86).
- **Chips:** at (15, 198), 32 tall, peach `rgba(248,232,205,.92)`, radius 9, 14px mono:
  - "4.7 (198 REVIEWS)" with an orange star disc
  - "ALPINE LARCH FORESTS" with an orange mountain glyph
- **Search card:** 359×137 at (15, 462).
  - "Hey, Mira!" at 25px.
  - "Interlaken, Switzerland ˄" at 14.5px.
  - A 37-tall panel field: "SEARCH BY ANYTHING" with a magnifier at the right.
- **Points of interest card:** 358×215 at (15, 612).
  - Label "::POINTS OF INTEREST".
  - A topographic map fills it: 16 thin wavy contour lines `#c9c5bc`, and a dark winding route that climbs to a sharp peak near the right.
  - A violet pin with a white mountain glyph marks the start; an orange pin marks the summit.
- **Photo card:** 336×215 at (383, 612), radius 16, cover-filled with a hiker in an orange jacket and backpack looking over the larch valley and lake: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/8097efdf-745f-4a23-8b33-0bed6ee16bc7.jpg` (position 72% 50%).
  - Bottom-left: a 38px white play button, then a light amber chip "211 Photos" (sans 14px) with a photo icon.
- **Altitude card:** 387×215 at (728, 612).
  - Label "::ALTITUDE". Top right: "TOTAL GAIN" with two small legend dots, "● HIKE" (amber) and "● DESCENT" (grey).
  - A line chart with a baseline:
    - the hiked part is a thick dark line that rises steeply then levels out
    - the rest is a grey dotted line that slopes down, with amber dots at waypoints
    - small mono axis labels: "0 km", "1,25 km", "2,800 m"
  - A panel tab bar at the bottom: "SLOPES", "ALTITUDE" (active, light amber with a mountain glyph), "SEASONS" (snowflake) and "TYPES". Tabs switch on click.
- **Weather card:** 303×380 at (1126, 12). Label "::WEATHER".
  - **Gauge panel**, 242 tall:
    - a centred "ENTIRE TRAIL" pill
    - a thick semicircle arc with a gradient from `#E7E1D3` through `#F8C44C` to `#F6B12A`, white knobs at both ends, and a thin white progress arc inside it
    - a big "19°" (74px) in the middle
    - "-3°" left, "Sunny" centre, ". 20°" right
  - **Two tiles:** "WIND" (orange disc) "14 km/h" and "SUNSET" (light amber disc) "17:52", values in mono 18.5px.
- **Trail info card:** 303×425 at (1126, 402). Label "::TRAIL INFO". Three 118-tall stacked panels, each with an amber-tint icon square, a big value and a caption:
  - "6.5 km", DISTANCE
  - "2.5-3 hr", DURATION
  - "350 m", ELEVATION GAIN

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline, about 2.8s.
  - The logo and user pill drop in; the breadcrumb fades.
  - The title rises out of a 10px blur; the chips follow.
  - The weather and trail info cards slide in from the right, staggered.
  - The bottom cards rise up in turn (search, points of interest, photo, altitude).
  - The gauge's white progress arc draws; the map route and the hiked chart line draw on.
  - The temperature counts up from 0° to 19°.
- **Hover:** the play button grows to 1.08.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Hero:** the photo and video fill the top 62% of the screen.
- **Header:** the logo and user pill share the first row, then the breadcrumb, a 46–64px title and the chips wrapped over the photo.
- **Cards:** below, full width and stacked: search, points of interest, photo, altitude, weather and trail info.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- Every widget sits at the coordinates above over the golden larch valley.
- The drone glide visibly moves the camera and loops without a jump.
- **Content:** no real brands, logos or people.

# Prompt: Gridwork Co create-account hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **create-account onboarding hero** for a fictional freelance marketplace, **Gridwork Co**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is fresh and botanical: a large photo card of a young woman tending plants in a bright glass greenhouse on the left, and a clean off-white form on the right asking "What tools do you use?", with sage and forest-green accents.

## Media

- **Photo:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/61db05ee-e08b-47b7-8ab6-541c5c510237.jpg` (1356×1528). A woman with dark hair in a low bun, a cream knit sweater and an olive apron, working with leafy plants in a sunlit greenhouse with hanging plants.
- **Motion:** a muted 10s loop of the same shot plays over the photo with identical cover rules: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/221f7a06-5ecc-40b6-9ece-26f1f982db64.mp4` (1020×1150).
  - The camera dollies in and orbits around her until she faces the lens, while her hands lift and part the leaves and the hanging plants sway. The clip plays forward then reversed, so it loops without a jump.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the photo is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** every size is in reference pixels of a 1447×1087 artboard, multiplied by `--u = clamp(.7px, min(100vw/1447, 100vh/1087), 2.4px)`.
- **Grid:** the shell fills the viewport. Columns are `minmax(0,1fr)` for the photo and `max(508.7u, 45%)` for the form. Padding is 11.5u top, 15.7u bottom and 15.6u left, so the photo card keeps an even margin to the edges.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** **Inter** 400/500/600/700 everywhere.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#FDFEFD`
  - ink `#101A20`; secondary text `#6E767C`, `#8A9196`
  - lines `#DCE0DD`
  - forest green `#1F4D37` (wordmark, log-in link) and `#1D4A35` (selected border and check)
  - button `#20513A`, hover `#2A6247`
  - sage tint `#ECF2EC` for selected cards

## Photo card (left)

- **Shape:** fills the left column. Top-left corner square; the other corners have a 24u radius. Photo `object-fit:cover`, position 50% 22%.
- **Tile pattern** in the top-left corner, on a 61u grid (4×4 cells):
  - six frosted tiles (61u, radius 15u, `rgba(255,255,255,.5)` with an 8u blur) at column/row (2,0), (3,1), (0,2), (2,2), (1,3) and (3,3)
  - page-coloured cut-outs: cell (0,0) and the rounded notches along the card edge, so the pattern reads as squares punched out of the corner
- **Bottom glass:** a 360u band with a 22u backdrop blur and a forest tint gradient (0 → .30 → .22), masked in from transparent.
- **Testimonial:** white, 40u side padding.
  - Quote: Inter 500, 31.35u on 45.5u, max 772u wide: "I landed multiple paid projects within a couple of days–way more traction than I ever got elsewhere. Definitely my go-to freelance platform now!"
  - Name "Sofia Hernández" (600, 20.5u) and role "Garden Designer, Portland, OR" (500, 16.25u).
  - Two 59u round outline arrow buttons (white 1.5u circle and arrow) at the bottom right, 31u apart.

## Form (right)

- **Column:** 432u wide, centred vertically and horizontally.
- **Wordmark:** a two-leaf mark (dark and mid forest green, with a thin pale vein) and "Gridwork Co" in Inter 600, 24u, forest green.
- **Heading:** "What tools do you use?" in Inter 700, 26u, tracking −.65u, 50.5u below the wordmark. Below it, "We’ll connect you with the best jobs." (17.15u, grey).
- **Tool grid:** 2×3, 34u below the subline, gaps 19u × 18u. Each card is 130.5u tall, radius 11u, with a 1u inset line. Contents:
  - a 41u app icon tile, the tool name (600, 16.75u) and the domain (400, 16.75u, grey) with an external-link icon
  - a 20u round checkbox at the top right
- **The six tools use their real app icons:**
  - **Figma:** the five-colour mark on dark `#1E1E1E`
  - **Framer:** the white glyph on black
  - **Adobe XD:** pink `#FF61F6` "Xd" on plum `#470137`
  - **Webflow:** the white W on blue `#146EF5`
  - **Relume:** the dark hexagon-cube on pink
  - **Canva:** the teal-to-violet gradient circle with the white script, on white
- **Selected state:** Figma, Webflow and Relume start selected. A selected card gets the sage fill, a 2u forest border and a filled forest checkbox with a white tick. Cards toggle on click.
- **Button:** a full-width 53u pill "Create account", 43u below the grid. Below it, "Already have an account? **Log in**" with the link in forest green, underlined.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline, about 2s, started when the fonts are ready. The photo and its pattern never move.
  - The quote wipes up out of a top-down clip; its footer follows.
  - The wordmark rises, then the heading wipes up and the subline rises.
  - The tool cards rise row by row (155ms per row, 55ms per column), then the button, then the log-in line.
- **Hover:** the arrows get a faint white fill; the button lightens.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone

# Prompt: Gridwork Co create-account hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **create-account onboarding hero** for a fictional freelance marketplace, **Gridwork Co**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is fresh and botanical: a large photo card of a young woman tending plants in a bright glass greenhouse on the left, and a clean off-white form on the right asking "What tools do you use?", with sage and forest-green accents.

## Media

- **Photo:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/61db05ee-e08b-47b7-8ab6-541c5c510237.jpg` (1356×1528). A woman with dark hair in a low bun, a cream knit sweater and an olive apron, working with leafy plants in a sunlit greenhouse with hanging plants.
- **Motion:** a muted 10s loop of the same shot plays over the photo with identical cover rules: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/221f7a06-5ecc-40b6-9ece-26f1f982db64.mp4` (1020×1150).
  - The camera dollies in and orbits around her until she faces the lens, while her hands lift and part the leaves and the hanging plants sway. The clip plays forward then reversed, so it loops without a jump.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the photo is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** every size is in reference pixels of a 1447×1087 artboard, multiplied by `--u = clamp(.7px, min(100vw/1447, 100vh/1087), 2.4px)`.
- **Grid:** the shell fills the viewport. Columns are `minmax(0,1fr)` for the photo and `max(508.7u, 45%)` for the form. Padding is 11.5u top, 15.7u bottom and 15.6u left, so the photo card keeps an even margin to the edges.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** **Inter** 400/500/600/700 everywhere.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#FDFEFD`
  - ink `#101A20`; secondary text `#6E767C`, `#8A9196`
  - lines `#DCE0DD`
  - forest green `#1F4D37` (wordmark, log-in link) and `#1D4A35` (selected border and check)
  - button `#20513A`, hover `#2A6247`

  - Two 59u round outline arrow buttons (white 1.5u circle and arrow) at the bottom right, 31u apart.

- **Column:** 432u wide, centred vertically and horizontally.
- **Wordmark:** a two-leaf mark (dark and mid forest green, with a thin pale vein) and "Gridwork Co" in Inter 600, 24u, forest green.
- **Heading:** "What tools do you use?" in Inter 700, 26u, tracking −.65u, 50.5u below the wordmark. Below it, "We’ll connect you with the best jobs." (17.15u, grey).

  - The wordmark rises, then the heading wipes up and the subline rises.
  - The tool cards rise row by row (155ms per row, 55ms per column), then the button, then the log-in line.
- **Hover:** the arrows get a faint white fill; the button lightens.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Lumora "Cadet Skyranger" interactive 3D hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **interactive character hero** for a fictional 3D studio, **Lumora**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a cinematic space poster: a glossy Pixar-quality 3D cartoon boy cadet in a chunky white, orange and teal space suit rises from the bottom of the screen in front of a glowing orange planet horizon in deep navy space. A huge glowing italic headline floats above him.

The star of the page is the interaction:
- **Head follows the cursor:** his head and eyes turn to follow the mouse, left to right.
- **Helmet:** clicking the red **PUSH ME** button on his chest closes a glass bubble helmet over his head.
- **Cursor:** a ring cursor with a dot replaces the pointer.

## Media

- **Plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a194141a-44ba-44bb-8372-e6720af994ca.jpg` (1920×1080). The cadet looks straight ahead: messy auburn hair, freckles, big hazel eyes, a white suit with orange shoulders and a teal chest panel, and a collar ring around his neck. Behind him is a curved orange-gold planet horizon under deep navy space.
- **Head-turn clip:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e1b48476-24ab-456a-bb12-13e63bc60973.mp4` (580×600, 5.04s, 24fps, muted, a keyframe every 4 frames for fast seeking).
  - It's a crop of the same scene around his head: frame 0 looks toward the left of the screen, the last frame toward the right, and his head turns at an even speed in between.
  - It is **never played**: the cursor scrubs it.
- **Helmet:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e8c78660-4497-41b9-82ae-a4738a5edd11.jpg` (960×958). A clear glass bubble dome with white and soft-blue reflections on pure black, blended with `mix-blend-mode: screen` so only the glass shows.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn in code. The head moves only through the clip, and the helmet is the image.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** one **1440×810 (16:9) frame** that covers the viewport: `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/810)`, centred with `left: calc(50% - 720u)` and `top: calc(50% - 405u)`. Don't use a transform, so fixed-position elements still pin to the screen on phones.
- **Placement:** every element below is in frame units. The plate fills the frame.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** **Archivo** Black Italic (variable, wdth 94%, weight 900), 100u, tracking −.02em, white, with a three-layer glow: white 14u, pale blue 34u, blue 70u.
- **Sans:** **Urbanist** 600/700 for everything else.
- **Colours:** text white; muted text `#CDD2E6`; page `#02040D`.

## Layout (1440×810 frame)

- **Logo:** a 35u round gradient disc (cyan → blue → violet → pink, conic) and "Lumora" (Urbanist 600, 29.5u), at (55, 54).
- **Menu:** three 25u white bars at the top right, at (1358, 55).
- **Copy block**, centred, top 122:
  - eyebrow "CADET", Urbanist 700, 18u, tracking .46em, muted
  - headline "SKYRANGER" (cap box about 402–1042 × 166–236)
  - subtitle "Past the Stars and Further", Urbanist 600, 23u, muted, 9u below
- **Captions:** "3D Interaction" bottom-left at (55, 745) and "@studio.design" bottom-right, Urbanist 700, 12.2u.
- **Head clip:** placed at (510, 255), 435×450, `object-fit: fill`. It has a soft radial mask (`ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 46%`, solid to 72%, clear at 99%) so its edges melt into the plate.
  - It starts hidden and fades in (0.6s) on its first seek.
- **Helmet:** 360×360 at (533, 288), hidden at first. A bottom mask (solid to 76%, clear at 92%) tucks it behind the collar ring.
- **PUSH ME button:** a real `<button>` laid exactly over the printed one on his chest. It's a 75u circle at (675, 720) with a glossy red radial gradient, a dark 4u ring plus a faint white outer ring, and "PUSH / ME" in Urbanist 700 at 16.5u.

## Interaction

- **Loading the clip:** fetch the whole clip as a blob and use an object URL as its source, so every seek is instant. Streamed seeks wait on the network and lag. Fall back to the URL if the fetch fails.
- **Head follow:**
  - Map the pointer's x across the frame (14% to 86%) to the clip time 0 → end.
  - Each animation frame, ease the shown time toward the target (×0.14) and set `currentTime` whenever it's not already seeking.
  - After 3.5s without movement, the gaze drifts slowly side to side on its own (a sine around the middle, ±32% of the clip).
- **Cursor:**
  - On fine pointers, hide the system cursor over the stage.
  - A 7px white dot sits exactly on the pointer, and a 44px ring (1.5px white border) eases after it (×0.55 per frame).
- **Helmet:**
  - Clicking PUSH ME presses it (scale .88 and back, 320ms) and toggles the dome.
  - The dome drops from −70u above with a slight overshoot and fades in over 720ms; it reverses to remove it.
  - While on, the button glows red and has `aria-pressed="true"`.
- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline, about 1.8s.
  - The logo and menu drop in, then the eyebrow's tracking tightens from .9em.
  - The headline rises out of a 14px blur, then the subtitle and captions follow.
  - The button pops in last.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no head clip; the plate stays.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Background:** the frame still covers the screen, so the cadet fills the lower part.
- **Header:** the logo and menu are pinned to the top corners.
- **Copy:** centred near the top: a 40–64px headline, 14px eyebrow and 16px subtitle.
- **Captions:** pinned to the bottom corners.

## Acceptance check (1440×810)

- The cadet sits centred in front of the glowing orange horizon, with the glowing "SKYRANGER" headline above him.
- Moving the mouse from the far left to the far right turns his head and eyes smoothly from left to right, with no seam around the head.
- Clicking PUSH ME drops a clear glass helmet over his head, and clicking again lifts it off.
- **Content:** no real brands, logos or existing characters.

The look is warm and cinematic: a full-bleed upward view between golden glass skyscrapers at sunset fills the page. A big white headline sits over the photo on the left, and a clean white log-in card with amber accents fills the right side.

## Media

- **Plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e781b542-a83d-4cf2-a66a-44085485865d.jpg` (2048×1360, 3:2). Looking straight up between glass towers that reflect amber and copper sunset light, a deep blue sky with bright clouds, and a sun flare low on the left. Use `background-size: cover`, centred.
- **Motion:** a muted 4s loop of the same shot covers the plate with the same cover rules: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/197f7e27-faac-4bdc-916c-615ac962bf86.mp4` (1600×1064).
  - The camera glides slowly forward and upward between the towers at a steady speed; clouds drift and the reflections slide.
  - The last second blends into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Readability:** soft shades keep the white type readable: a 150u dark wash from the left, 140u from the top, and a warm `rgba(20,10,0,.38)` → 0 rising 420u from the bottom.
- **Rule:** nothing in the photo is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** every desktop size is in reference pixels of a 1672×941 artboard, multiplied by `--u = max(.62px, min(100vw/1672, 100dvh/941))`. The photo and the card stretch to the edges at other ratios, so there are never letterbox bands.
- **Layout:** a two-column flex row. The hero column fills the left. The card panel on the right is 742.4u wide and sits 18u from the top and right and 22.5u from the bottom, an even margin all round.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** a geometric grotesk (General Sans or Red Hat Display style), variable 300–900.
- **Colours:**

  - lines `#E2E4E7` / `#E9EAEC`, card `#FEFEFE`
  - button `#161515`
  - amber `#F59A08`, and lighter amber `#FBAE05` for the link on the photo

## Hero (left, white text)

- **Top bar** (57u from the top, 92.5u from the left):
  - **Logo:** a 48u black rounded tile (radius 12u) holding a thick amber-gradient "C" (`#FFC233` → `#F58A07`), then "Cutora" at weight 680, 35.5u, tracking −.95u.
